name: pow_sub_one_bound
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : z ^ (n+1) - 1 = z ^ n * (z - 1) + (z ^ n - 1) := by ring
    rw [he]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖z ^ n * (z - 1)‖ + ‖z ^ n - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖z - 1‖ + n * ‖z - 1‖ := by
        simpa only [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, one_mul] using
          add_le_add_right ih ‖z - 1‖
      _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

name: phaseSum_sub_bound
proof:
by
  have he : phaseSum z N - (N : ℂ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (z^n-1) := by
    simp [phaseSum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖z^n-1‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range N, (N : ℝ) * ‖z-1‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact (pow_sub_one_bound z hz n).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_range.mp hn).le)
          (norm_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

name: phaseSum_lower
proof:
by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hb := phaseSum_sub_bound z hz N
  have he : (N : ℝ)^2 * ‖z-1‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)/2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sq_nonneg (N : ℝ))
    calc
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ)^2 * (1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))) := this
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have ht := norm_sub_norm_le (N : ℂ) (phaseSum z N)
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at ht
  have hn : ‖(N : ℂ)‖ = (N : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [hn] at ht
  linarith

name: phase_energy
proof:
by
  calc
    _ = (phaseSum z N * conj (phaseSum z N)).re := by
      rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [phaseSum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      change Complex.reCLM (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, _) = _
      simp only [map_sum]
      rfl

name: pow_mul_conj_pow
proof:
by
  nth_rw 1 [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hji]
  rw [pow_add, mul_assoc, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_pow,
    hz, one_pow, one_pow, Complex.ofReal_one, mul_one]

variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (z : X → ℂ) (hz : Measurable z) (hu : ∀ x, ‖z x‖ = 1)

include hz hu

name: integrable_pair
proof:
by
  apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simp [hu])

omit hz in

name: pair_moment_bound
proof:
by
  by_cases he : i = j
  · subst j
    have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^i)) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
      funext x
      simpa using pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) (le_refl i)
    rw [he, integral_const]
    simp [hc]
  · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
    by_cases hji : j ≤ i
    · have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^j)) = fun x => z x^(i-j) := by
        funext x
        exact pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) hji
      rw [he]
      exact (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (hm (i-j) (by omega) (by omega))
    · have he : (fun x => z x^i * conj (z x^j)) =
          fun x => conj (z x^(j-i)) := by
        funext x
        rw [← pow_mul_conj_pow (z x) (hu x) (by omega : i ≤ j)]
        simp only [map_mul, starRingEnd_self_apply]
        exact mul_comm _ _
      rw [he, integral_conj]
      exact (Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (by simpa using hm (j-i) (by omega) (by omega))

name: phase_energy_integral_bound
proof:
by
  simp_rw [phase_energy]
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          (∫ x, z x^i * conj (z x^j) ∂μ).re := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [integral_finsetSum]
        · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          exact (integral_re (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j))
        · intro j _
          exact (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j).re
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          ((if i=j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + c) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        exact pair_moment_bound μ z hu hc hm (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left hi])]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
  · intro i _
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (integrable_pair μ z hz hu i j).re)

name: integrable_energy
proof:
by
  have h : ∀ x, ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖ ≤ N := by
    intro x
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ‖z x ^ n‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = N := by simp [hu]
  apply Integrable.of_bound (by unfold phaseSum; fun_prop) ((N : ℝ)^2)
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h x) 2)

/-- A quantitative finite-moment bound for the small arc about 1. -/

name: small_arc_bound
proof:
by
  have hNp : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hs : {x | ‖z x-1‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))} ⊆
      {x | (N : ℝ)^2 / 4 ≤ ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖ ^ 2} := by
    intro x hx
    have hh := phaseSum_lower (z x) (hu x) hN hx
    change (N : ℝ)^2 / 4 ≤ _
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (phaseSum (z x) N)]
  have hmark := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg ‖phaseSum (z x) N‖))
    (integrable_energy μ z hz hu N) ((N : ℝ)^2/4)
  have he := phase_energy_integral_bound μ z hz hu hc hm
  have hreal := measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hs
  have hm' : (N : ℝ)^2/4 * μ.real {x | ‖z x-1‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ))} ≤
      N + (N : ℝ)^2*c :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by positivity)).trans (hmark.trans he)
  calc
    _ ≤ (N + (N : ℝ)^2*c)/((N : ℝ)^2/4) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by nlinarith [hm'])
    _ = _ := by field_simp

local instance : MeasurableSpace Circle := borel Circle
local instance : BorelSpace Circle := ⟨rfl⟩

omit [MeasurableSpace X] hz hu in
/-- The source's qualitative choice, with explicit constants. -/

name: exists_small_arc_constants
proof:
by
  let N := 64*m^2
  have hN : 0 < N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hNp : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hmp : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  refine ⟨1/(8*N), 1/N, N, by positivity, by positivity, hN, ?_⟩
  intro ω _ hω
  have hco : Continuous (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ)) := continuous_subtype_val
  have hcm : Measurable (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ)) := hco.measurable
  have hb := small_arc_bound ω (fun w : Circle => (w : ℂ))
    hcm Circle.norm_coe hN (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/N)
    (fun n hn hnN => (hω n hn (le_of_lt hnN)).le)
  have hr : 4*(1/(8*(N : ℝ))) = 1/(2*N) := by ring
  rw [hr]
  apply hb.trans_lt
  have he : (N : ℝ) = 64*(m : ℝ)^2 := by dsimp [N]; push_cast; rfl
  rw [he]
  field_simp
  norm_num

end

actual conditional samples lie in them by the measurable positive-atom event. -/
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor.SampledAtoms

variable {X Y G : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
  [MeasurableSpace G] [MeasurableEq G]

name: measurable_atom_mass
proof:
by
  classical
  let η : Kernel (Y × G) G := κ.comap Prod.fst measurable_fst
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : (Y × G) × G =>

name: four_endpoint_sequence_false
proof:
by
  classical
  let t : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have ht : t≠0 := by dsimp [t]; split <;> decide
  have hRaN := four_gap_shift_subset c hc hw hx hlr hgap
    (show a+sixty∈Icc (l+sixty) (r+sixty) from by rcases haEnd with rfl|rfl <;> constructor <;> linarith)
  have hRa : a+sixty∈fourSupport c hc x t := by
    change a+sixty∈fourNonSingleton c hc x at hRaN
    rw [four_other_union c hc x hs] at hRaN
    exact hRaN.resolve_left (four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hs ha)
  obtain ⟨b0,hb0,b1,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,hv01⟩ := exists_transportVelocity_lt
    (four_support_positive c hc hw hx ht) hHa
  have hp : ∃b b',b∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧ b'∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧
      Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (b'-a)≠0 ∧
      ((a=l ∧ 0<transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b') ∨
       (a=r ∧ transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b'<0)) := by
    rcases haEnd with hal|har
    · exact ⟨b1,b0,hb1,hb0,hb1a,hb0a,Or.inl ⟨hal,sub_pos.mpr hv01⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨b0,b1,hb0,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,Or.inr ⟨har,sub_neg.mpr hv01⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b,b',hb,hb',hab,hab',hvel⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨bn,hbn,hbt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hb'
  obtain ⟨dn,hdn,hdt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hRa
  let Hn := fun n => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)
  have hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self,map_zero,Function.comp_def] using
      Complex.equivRealProdCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hy.sub_const x)
  let cn := fun n => (sumTransport hab (Hn n) (a,b)).1
  have hcn : Tendsto cn atTop (𝓝 a) := (sumTransport_tendsto hab hH tendsto_const_nhds).fst_nhds
  have hneg : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  let un := fun n => (sumTransport hab' (-Hn n) (cn n,bn n)).1
  have hun : Tendsto un atTop (𝓝 a) :=
    (sumTransport_tendsto hab' hneg (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt)).fst_nhds
  have huGap : ∀ᶠn in atTop,un n∈Ioo l r := normalized_increment_endpoint_gap hlr hδ hvel hun
    (sumTransport_double_increment hab hab' hH hbt hδ hdir)
  obtain ⟨P,V,hP,hP0,hV,haV,K,hbranch⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab
  have hcN : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourNonSingleton c hc (yn n) := by
    filter_upwards [hH.eventually (hP.mem_nhds hP0)] with n hn
    exact (four_support_transport c hc hw hx (hyn n) hs ha hb hab hV haV hbranch hn).1
  obtain ⟨P',V',hP',hP0',hV',haV',K',hbranch'⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab'
  have hcNot : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∉fourSupport c hc (yn n) s := by
    filter_upwards [hneg.eventually (hP'.mem_nhds hP0'),
      (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt).eventually (hV'.mem_nhds haV'),huGap] with n hn hqn hgn hcu
    have hcenter : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x-yn n)= -Hn n := by
      dsimp [Hn]
      rw [← map_neg,neg_sub]
    have htr := four_support_transport_general c hc hw (hyn n) hx hs hab' hcu (hbn n)
      hV' hqn hbranch' (hcenter.symm ▸ hn)
    rw [hcenter] at htr
    exact hgap hgn htr.1
  have hcT : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    filter_upwards [hcN,hcNot] with n hn hnot
    rw [four_other_union c hc (yn n) hs] at hn
    exact hn.resolve_left hnot
  let vn := fun n => if h : cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t then cn n
    else (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose
  have hvn : ∀n,vn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    intro n
    dsimp [vn]
    split
    · assumption
    · exact (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose_spec
  have hvlim : Tendsto vn atTop (𝓝 a) := hcn.congr' (by
    filter_upwards [hcT] with n hn
    simp only [vn,dite_eq_left hn])
  exact four_support_sequence_no_unit c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hvlim hdt hvn hdn (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: triple_subset_pair
proof:
by
  by_cases hab : a=b
  · subst b
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa using hsub))
  by_cases ha : a∈S
  · by_cases hb : b∈S
    · left
      intro x hx
      by_contra hn
      have hxne : x≠a ∧ x≠b := by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hn
      have : 3 ≤ S.card := by
        have hh : ({a,b,x} : Finset α) ⊆ S := by simp only [Finset.insert_subset_iff,Finset.singleton_subset_iff]; exact ⟨ha,hb,hx⟩
        have hc := Finset.card_le_card hh
        simpa [hab,hxne.1.symm,hxne.2.symm] using hc
      omega
    · right; left
      intro x hx
      have := hsub hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this ⊢
      rcases this with h|h|h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact False.elim (hb (h ▸ hx))
      · exact Or.inr h
  · right; right
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_insert.mp (hsub hx)).resolve_left (fun h => ha (h ▸ hx))

name: triangle_binary
proof:
by
  filter_upwards [palette_cardinality c hc hw x,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hab,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw had,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hbd] with t ht hab had hbd
  by_contra hn
  have hnot : i∉palette c hc x t ∧ j∉palette c hc x t := by
    simpa only [mem_palette,not_or] using hn
  have hsub : palette c hc x t ⊆ {a,b,d} := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hns
    have : s∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by rw [← hcomp]; simp [hns]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this
    rcases this with rfl|rfl
    · exact hnot.1 hs
    · exact hnot.2 hs
  rcases triple_subset_pair ht.2 hsub with h|h|h
  · exact hab h
  · exact had h
  · exact hbd h

name: triangle_centers_separated

  exact ⟨δ,hδ,fun x z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 hne => hsep x z i j

/-- Uniform local isolation of a value on a dense subset of a connected metric
space propagates globally. This is the manuscript dense-set chain argument. -/

name: dense_isolated_value_constant
proof:
by
  let A : Set E := {x | x∈G ∧ f x=b}
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := hne
  have hAopen : IsOpen (closure A) := by
    apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx ε hε
    have hsub : Metric.ball a ε∩G⊆A := by
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨hy.2,hl a ha.1 ha.2 y hy.2 (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hy.1)⟩
    have hball : Metric.ball a ε⊆closure A := by
      intro y hy
      apply closure_mono hsub
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter_closure ⟨hy,hG y⟩
    exact ⟨Metric.ball a ε,hball,Metric.isOpen_ball,had⟩
  have hfull : closure A=univ := (show IsClopen (closure A) from ⟨isClosed_closure,hAopen⟩).eq_univ
    (hAne.mono subset_closure)

name: binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t
proof:
by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (binaryQ d) (2*d*Real.sin t) t := by
    convert (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul (2*d)).const_sub 1).add_const (d^2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | ring
  have hat := (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).const_mul d).div
    (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul d).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp t ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (Real.pi/3)).add hat).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (binaryCircleMap d) _ t at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryB,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  have hnum : d*Real.cos t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(d*-Real.sin t)=
      d*(Real.cos t-d) := by linear_combination -d^2*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (d*(Real.cos t-d)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*(d*(Real.cos t-d)) := by ring
      _ = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring

name: binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d
proof:
by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryQ s t) (2*(d-Real.cos t)) d := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (2*Real.cos t)).const_sub 1).add ((hasDerivAt_id d).pow 2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | (funext s; dsimp only [binaryQ,Pi.add_apply,Pi.pow_apply,id_eq]; ring) |
        (try dsimp only [id_eq]; ring)
  have hat := (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.sin t)).div
    (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.cos t)).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp d ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (hat.const_add (t+Real.pi/3)).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) _ d at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryM,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  simp only [one_mul]
  have hnum : Real.sin t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(Real.cos t)=Real.sin t := by ring
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*Real.sin t := by ring
      _ = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring

a proper `k`-labelling of `E` already produces a measurable almost-everywhere proper
`k`-colouring of the whole plane. This is the form proved by the construction below. -/

name: proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic
proof:
by
  let ω : PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.Space k := ⟨c,hc⟩
  obtain ⟨H,hm,hp,ho⟩ := PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.exists_label_field k ω
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hunit⟩ := sample_field (PlaneFiveColor.LabelModel.measure k ω) angularMeasure
    direction direction_continuous.measurable
    H hm hp (fun x t => ho x (AddCircle.toCircle t))
  exact ⟨d,hd,hd.aemeasurable,hunit⟩

name: proper_to_borel_weak
proof: proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic (c := fun x => c x) fun x y h => hc x y h

name: proper_to_weak
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d,_,h⟩ := proper_to_borel_weak hc
  exact ⟨d,h⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

name: support_good_sequence
proof:
by
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃t,dist t a<1/((n:ℝ)+1) ∧ P t := by
    have hp : 0<volume (Metric.ball a (1/((n:ℝ)+1))∩A) := by
      simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball] using
        (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall a).mp ha _ (Metric.ball_mem_nhds a (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hpt⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hp.ne').and_eventually hP).exists
    exact ⟨t,ht.1,hpt ht.2⟩
  choose t hd hpt using hex
  refine ⟨t,?_,hpt⟩
  rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
  exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun n => (hd n).le) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: state_support_avoiding_trace
proof:
by
  have he := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_circle_palette_exclusion c hc hw x)
  have ht := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_circle_typicalSampling c hc x)
  have hp : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈A → TypicalSampling c (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 ∧
      ∀i∈J,sample c hc (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 i=0 := by
    filter_upwards [he,ht,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (fun hi : i∈J => hA.2 i hi))] with t he ht hJ hta
    refine ⟨ht,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [sample_ae c hc (x+direction (t : Angles)) 1 i,he,Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure] with v hv he hz
    rw [hz,hv]
    have hne : c (x+direction (t : Angles)+direction v)≠i := by
      intro hh
      apply he
      rw [hh]
      exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mpr (hJ i hi hta)
    simp only [sampleFn,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,ite_eq_right hne,Pi.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hp⟩ := support_good_sequence ha hp
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (x+direction (t n : Angles)) 1)))
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => x+direction (t n : Angles)) atTop (𝓝 (x+direction (a : Angles))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.add (direction_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ((AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi)).continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht))
  refine ⟨b,trace_of_realization c hc (fun n => (hp (φ n)).1) (hlim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) tendsto_const_nhds hb,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hh := traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hb i (traceValue b i)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,traceValue_sampleCode,(hp _).2 i hi,inner_zero_left] at hh
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hh).symm

name: avoiding_trace_palette
proof:
by
  have hs : (fun t => ∑i,traceValue b i t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure](fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc hb).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hz (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,i∈J → traceValue b i t=0 := by
    by_cases hi : i∈J
    · rw [hJ i hi]
      exact (Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure).mono fun _ hh _ => hh
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ hh => (hi hh).elim
  filter_upwards [hs,ae_all_iff.mpr hz,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x i ⟨b,hb⟩)] with t hs hz hp hsub
  have hn : ∀i : Fin k,traceValue b i t≤0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra! hpos
    have hm := hsub ((mem_palette c hc x t i).mpr (hp i hpos))
    linarith [hz i hm]
  have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hn i)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: sample_region_ae
proof:
by
  have hq : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun p : ℂ × Angles => p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2)
      ((volume : Measure ℂ).prod angularMeasure) volume :=
    QuasiMeasurePreserving.prod_of_left
      (measurable_fst.add (measurable_const.mul (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)))
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℂ)
        ((r : ℂ)*direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving)
  exact Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod (hq.ae hW)
include hc in

name: sampling_near_region
proof:
by
  let U : Set (ℂ × Angles) := {p | p.1+(r : ℂ)*direction p.2∈W}
  have hU : IsOpen U := ho.preimage (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul (direction_continuous.comp continuous_snd)))
  obtain ⟨V,T,hV,_,hxV,hKT,hVT⟩ := generalized_tube_lemma (isCompact_singleton (x := x)) hK hU
    (by rintro ⟨y,t⟩ ⟨hy,ht⟩; change y=x at hy; subst y; exact hmem t ht)
  have hv : x∈V := hxV (mem_singleton x)
  have hpos : 0<volume (V∩Metric.ball x δ) := (hV.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).measure_pos volume
    ⟨x,hv,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyp,hyW⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hpos.ne').and_eventually
    ((ae_typicalSampling c hc hr).and (sample_region_ae c r hW))).exists
  refine ⟨y,hy.2,hyp,hyW.mono fun t ht htK => ht ?_⟩
  exact hVT (show (y,t)∈V×ˢT from ⟨hy.1,hKT htK⟩)

name: weak_limit_zero_on
proof:
by
  have ht' := ht (indicatorConstLp 2 hK (measure_ne_top angularMeasure K) 1)
  have he (v : RealL2 angularMeasure) :
      ⟪v,indicatorConstLp 2 hK (measure_ne_top angularMeasure K) 1⟫=∫t in K,v t∂angularMeasure := by
    rw [real_inner_comm,L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one]
  simp only [he] at ht'
  have hf0 (n) : ∫t in K,f n t∂angularMeasure=0 := by
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    exact (ae_restrict_iff' hK).mpr (hf n)
  simp only [hf0] at ht'
  have hzero : ∫t in K,b t∂angularMeasure=0 := (tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds ht').symm
  have hz := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae hb)
    ((Lp.memLp b).integrable (by norm_num)).integrableOn).mp hzero
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' hK).mp hz

name: trace_region_palette
proof:
by
  have hex (n : ℕ) := sampling_near_region c hc (hr n) hK ho hW (hmem n)
    (δ := 1/((n:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)
  choose y hy hyt hyJ using hex
  have hyl : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) (fun n => (hy n).le) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  obtain ⟨b,_,φ,hφ,hb⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (TraceVector k))).isSeqCompact.subseq_of_frequently_in
    (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun n => Set.mem_univ (sampleCode c hc (y n) (r n))))
  have htrace := trace_of_realization c hc (fun n => hyt (φ n)) (hyl.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    (hrt.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hb
  have hz (i : Fin k) (hi : i∉J) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈K → traceValue b i t=0 := by
    apply weak_limit_zero_on hK.measurableSet
      (by simpa only [traceValue_sampleCode] using traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp hb i)
      ((trace_bounds c hc htrace).1 i)
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hyJ (φ n),sample_ae c hc (y (φ n)) (r (φ n)) i] with t ht he htK
    simp only [Function.comp_apply,traceValue_sampleCode]
    rw [he]
    unfold sampleFn
    split_ifs with htcol
    · exact (hi (htcol ▸ ht htK)).elim
    · rfl
  have hs : (fun t => ∑i,traceValue b i t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure](fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue b)
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc htrace).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hz i)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x i ⟨b,htrace⟩)] with t hs hz hp htK
  by_contra! hn
  have hn' : ∀i,traceValue b i t≤0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra! hpos
    have hi : i∈palette c hc x t := (mem_palette c hc x t i).mpr (hp i hpos)
    by_cases hiJ : i∈J
    · have hh := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi,hiJ⟩
      rw [hn] at hh
      exact Finset.notMem_empty i hh
    · linarith [hz i hiJ htK]
  have hh := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hn' i)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: outer_strip_trace
proof:
by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1+(δ/2)/(n+1)
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,add_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).add
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (δ/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith)
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(δ/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hn : (1:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)+1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
      have hb := div_le_self (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤δ/2) hn
      dsimp [r]
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)

name: inner_strip_trace
proof:
by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let ε := min δ (1/2)
  have he : 0<ε := lt_min hδ (by norm_num)
  have heδ : ε≤δ := min_le_left _ _
  have he1 : ε≤1/2 := min_le_right _ _
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1-(ε/2)/(n+1)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (ε/2)/(n+1)≤ε/2 := div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (ε/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith) (r n) (hr n)
    · dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(ε/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

/-- The source local binary rigidity on arbitrary one-sided strips, allowing
independent choices of radial side at the two equilateral neighbors. -/

name: binary_strip_rigidity
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hpv⟩ := radial_unit_contact he hδ bv hstripV
  obtain ⟨w,hpw,hw',hd⟩ := open_two_unit_directions hV hv hpv
  let W : Set ℂ := {p | p+v∈V ∧ p+w∈V}
  have hW : IsOpen W := (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).inter
    (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hbox⟩ := polarBox_small hδ hW ⟨hpv,hpw⟩ hstripU he
  obtain ⟨i,hi,_⟩ := connected_local_ae_constant (polarBox_connected x e bu hε) (fun p hp => by
    have hp' := hbox hp
    obtain ⟨r,hr,j,hj⟩ := binary_open_local_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc hp'.1 hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2 hv hw' hd
    exact ⟨j,Metric.ball p r,Metric.isOpen_ball,Metric.mem_ball_self hr,hj⟩)
  have hab : i=a ∨ i=b := by
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := (polarBox_connected x e bu hε).nonempty
    have hpos := (hU.inter (essentialLocalSet_open c i)).measure_pos (volume : Measure ℂ)
      ⟨p,(hbox hp).1,hi hp⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqa⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne'
      (ae_restrict_of_ae (hUc.and (essentialLocalSet_ae c i)))
    simpa only [hqa.2 hq.2] using hqa.1 hq.1
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hh⟩ := polarBox_contains_strip he bu hε
  exact ⟨i,hab,η,hη,fun e' he' hh' r _ hr hside => hi (hh e' he' hh' r hr hside)⟩
/-- The resulting fixed outsider is actually in the maximal palette on an
angular neighborhood, by one-sided radial weak traces. -/

name: binary_strip_palette_rigidity
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,η,hη,hs⟩ := binary_strip_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc (direction_norm t) hδ bu bv hstripU hstripV
  have hmono : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈essentialLocalSet c i → c q∈({i} : Finset (Fin k)) :=
    (essentialLocalSet_ae c i).mono fun q hq hqi => by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using hq hqi
  have hex : ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → (palette c hc x u∩{i}).Nonempty := by
    cases bu
    · apply inner_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr hrη hr1
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r hr _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    · apply outer_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr1 hrη
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r (by linarith) _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨A,hA,ht,hae⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨i,hi,A,hA,ht,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hu hAu
  rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hj with ⟨hjp,hji⟩
  simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hji] using hjp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- If two unit rays can never be simultaneously positive at a generic angle,
they are antipodal. This avoids any assumption about multiplicities of ray lines. -/

name: unit_antipodes_of_no_positive
proof:
by
  by_contra hne
  have hsum : v+w≠0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hne
    apply eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using hz
  have hvv : ⟪v,v⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hv]; norm_num
  have hww : ⟪w,w⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hw]; norm_num
  have hs : 0<⟪v+w,v+w⟫ := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hc := real_inner_comm v w
  simp only [inner_add_left,inner_add_right,hvv,hww] at hs
  have hvpos : 0<⟪v+w,v⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hvv]; linarith
  have hwpos : 0<⟪v+w,w⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hww]; linarith
  let e : ℂ := ‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w)
  have he : ‖e‖=1 := by
    simp only [e,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_inv,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (v+w))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hev : 0<⟪e,v⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hvpos
  have hew : 0<⟪e,w⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hwpos
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists he
  let U : Set Angles := {t | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,w⟫}
  have hUv : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hUw : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,w⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hU : IsOpen U := hUv.inter hUw
  have htU : t∈U := by change _∧_; rw [ht]; exact ⟨hev,hew⟩
  have hpos := hU.measure_pos angularMeasure ⟨t,htU⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hu'⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  exact hu' hu
/-- The source's all-generic split condition already forces opposite edge
positions to be actual antipodes; the collinear case is retained. -/

name: four_split_antipodes
proof:
by
  intro i
  exact unit_antipodes_of_no_positive (hv i) (hv (i+2)) (hsplit.mono fun _ ht => ht i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: toPlane_zero
proof: rfl

name: toPlane_one
proof: rfl

name: ofPlane_re
proof: rfl

name: ofPlane_im
proof: rfl

name: toPlane_sub
proof:
by
  ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [toPlane]

name: sq_norm_toPlane
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, toPlane_zero, toPlane_one]

name: sq_norm_complex
proof:
by
  rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring

name: norm_toPlane
proof:
by
  have h : ‖toPlane z‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by rw [sq_norm_toPlane, sq_norm_complex]
  calc ‖toPlane z‖ = Real.sqrt (‖toPlane z‖ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)).symm
    _ = Real.sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2) := by rw [h]
    _ = ‖z‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)

name: dist_toPlane
proof:
by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← toPlane_sub, norm_toPlane]

name: dist_ofPlane
proof:
by
  have h1 : dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, sq_norm_complex]
    simp [ofPlane]
  have h2 : dist x y ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, PiLp.sub_apply]
  have h : dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 := by rw [h1, h2]
  calc dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y)
      = Real.sqrt (dist (ofPlane x) (ofPlane y) ^ 2) :=
        (Real.sqrt_sq (dist_nonneg)).symm
    _ = Real.sqrt (dist x y ^ 2) := by rw [h]
    _ = dist x y := Real.sqrt_sq (dist_nonneg)

/-! ## transporting colourings between the two vocabularies -/

/-- A proper colouring of the bundle's plane pulls back to one of `ℂ`. -/

name: properColoring_of_plane
proof:
by
  intro x y hxy
  refine hc _ _ ?_
  rw [dist_toPlane, dist_eq_norm]
  exact hxy

/-- A proper colouring of `ℂ` pushes forward to one of the bundle's plane. -/

name: plane_of_properColoring
proof:
by
  intro x y hxy
  refine hd _ _ ?_
  rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_ofPlane]
  exact hxy

/-- The two vocabularies define the same property. -/

name: planeProperColoring_iff
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨fun z => c (toPlane z), properColoring_of_plane hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    exact ⟨fun p => d (ofPlane p), plane_of_properColoring hd⟩

/-! ## monotonicity in the number of colours -/

name: properColoring_mono
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun p => Fin.castLE hkm (c p), ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy hcontra
  exact hc x y hxy (Fin.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val hcontra))

/-! ## no colouring with at most five colours -/

/-- The five-colouring obstruction, stated for the bundle's own `ProperColoring`. -/

name: not_properColoring_five
proof:
by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := planeProperColoring_iff.mp h
  exact EuclideanFiveColor.no_proper_five_coloring ⟨d, hd⟩

name: not_properColoring_of_le
proof:
fun h =>
  not_properColoring_five (properColoring_mono hk h)

/-! ## the paper's displayed inequality  6 <= chi(R^2) <= 7 -/

name: six_le_planeChromaticNumber
proof:
by
  rw [planeChromaticNumber]
  refine le_csInf ⟨(7:ℕ), properColoring_seven⟩ ?_
  intro k hk
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  exact not_properColoring_of_le (by omega) hk

name: planeChromaticNumber_le_seven
proof:
by
  rw [planeChromaticNumber]
  exact Nat.sInf_le properColoring_seven

/-- The paper's Theorem 1.1, second sentence, as a statement about chi(R^2). -/

name: chromaticNumber_bounds
proof:
⟨six_le_planeChromaticNumber, planeChromaticNumber_le_seven⟩

end
end Problem160
end OAI

name: circleSum_strict
proof:
by
  have hc1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hc2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact ((hc1.const_smul r).add hc2).prodMk ((hs1.const_smul r).add hs2)

name: circleSum_continuous
proof: continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun p => (circleSum_strict r p).continuousAt

name: circleSumDeriv_injective
proof:
by
  apply (circleSumDeriv r p).toLinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro q hq
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hq
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hq
  change r * (-Real.sin p.1 * q.1) + -Real.sin p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h1
  change r * (Real.cos p.1 * q.1) + Real.cos p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h2
  have ha : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.1=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination Real.cos p.2*h1+Real.sin p.2*h2
  have hb : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.2=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -(r*Real.cos p.1)*h1-(r*Real.sin p.1)*h2
  exact Prod.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_left h) ((mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left h)
def circleSumDerivEquiv {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) :
    RealPlane ≃L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective (circleSumDeriv r p)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (circleSumDeriv_injective h))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr ((LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).mp
      (circleSumDeriv_injective h)))

name: circleSum_local_antilipschitz
proof:
by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv h
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum r) (L : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) p := circleSum_strict r p
  obtain ⟨s,hp,hs,ha⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  refine ⟨s,hs,hp,_,ha.antilipschitz ?_⟩
  right
  have hpos := L.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton RealPlane)
  exact half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr hpos)

name: realDirection_lipschitz
proof:
by
  simpa using Real.lipschitzWith_cos.prodMk Real.lipschitzWith_sin
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleInverseHomeo : OpenPartialHomeomorph RealPlane RealPlane :=
  (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
    (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
    (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).toOpenPartialHomeomorph (circleSum 1)
def circleInverse : RealPlane → RealPlane := by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).target.piecewise (circleInverseHomeo h).symm (fun _ => 0)

name: circleInverse_measurable
proof:
by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).continuousOn_invFun.measurable_piecewise continuous_const.continuousOn
    (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.measurableSet

name: circleInverse_eq
proof: by simp [circleInverse,hq]

name: circleInverse_at
proof:
by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target]
  exact hd.localInverse_apply_image

name: circleInverse_continuousAt
proof:
by
  apply ((circleInverseHomeo h).continuousAt_symm hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hq] with y hy
  exact circleInverse_eq h hy

name: circleInverse_strict
proof:
1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (circleSum 1 (t,u)) := by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  apply hd.to_localInverse.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target] with q hq
  exact (circleInverse_eq h hq).symm

name: circleInverse_right
proof:
by
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hq]
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).right_inv hq

name: circleInverse_regular
proof:
by
  have hc := (Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
    ((circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.snd.sub (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.fst))
  have hh : Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).1) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [circleInverse_at h]
  exact hc.eventually_ne hh
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
omit [CompleteSpace E] in

name: triangular_injective
proof:
by
  intro a b hab
  change (a.1,L a)=(b.1,L b) at hab
  have hab₁ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.1) hab
  have hab₂ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.2) hab
  dsimp only at hab₁ hab₂
  have he : a-b=(0,a.2-b.2) := Prod.ext (by simp [hab₁]) rfl
  have hz : L (0,a.2-b.2)=0 := by rw [← he,map_sub,hab₂,sub_self]
  have hm : L (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2)*L (0,1) := by
    have h : (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2) • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [h,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hm] at hz
  exact Prod.ext hab₁ (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hc))
omit [CompleteSpace E] in

name: triangular_surjective
proof:
by
  intro b
  refine ⟨(b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1)),Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
  change L (b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1))=b.2
  have h (r : ℝ) : L (b.1,r)=L (b.1,0)+r*L (0,1) := by
    have he : (b.1,r)=(b.1,0)+r • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [he,map_add,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc]
  ring
/-- Joint strict differentiability and a nonzero fiber derivative give one inverse
Lipschitz bound simultaneously for every nearby parameter. -/

name: strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz
proof:
by
  let T := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L
  let H : E × ℝ → E × ℝ := fun q => (q.1,S q)
  let Q : (E × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (E × ℝ) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective T
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (triangular_injective L hc))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (triangular_surjective L hc))
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt H (Q : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] E × ℝ) (p,t) :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.prodMk hS
  obtain ⟨V,hpt,hVo,hA⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  have hK := hA.antilipschitz (Or.inr (half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr
    (Q.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton (E × ℝ))))))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,I,hI,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hVo.mem_nhds hpt)
  obtain ⟨P',hP'P,hP'o,hp⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨I',hI'I,hI'o,ht⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI
  refine ⟨P',I',hP'o,hp,hI'o,ht,(‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ - ‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ / 2)⁻¹,?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro a b
  have ha : (q,a.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I a.2⟩
  have hb : (q,b.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I b.2⟩
  have h := hK.le_mul_dist ⟨(q,a.1),ha⟩ ⟨(q,b.1),hb⟩
  simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq,domRestrict,H,Prod.dist_eq,dist_self,max_eq_right (dist_nonneg)] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
abbrev CircleParameter := RealPlane × ℝ
abbrev CircleJet := CircleParameter × ℝ
def jetCenter : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetRadius : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetAngle : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ CircleParameter ℝ
def circleTarget (q : CircleJet) : RealPlane := q.1.1+q.1.2 • (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)
def circleTargetDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  jetCenter + (q.1.2 • (((-Real.sin q.2) • jetAngle).prod (Real.cos q.2 • jetAngle)) +
    jetRadius.smulRight (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2))

name: circleTarget_strict
proof:
by
  have hc := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact jetCenter.hasStrictFDerivAt.add (jetRadius.hasStrictFDerivAt.smul (hc.prodMk hs))

name: circleTarget_continuous
proof:
continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun q => (circleTarget_strict q).continuousAt
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleEndpoint (q : CircleJet) : ℝ := (circleInverse h (circleTarget q)).1
def circleEndpointDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp
    (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane).comp
      (circleTargetDeriv q))

name: circleEndpoint_measurable
proof: measurable_fst.comp ((circleInverse_measurable h).comp circleTarget_continuous.measurable)

name: circleEndpoint_strict
proof:
by
  have hi := circleInverse_strict h
  rw [← he] at hi
  exact hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.comp q (hi.comp q (circleTarget_strict q))

name: inverse_tangent_first_ne
proof:
1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm
      (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)).1 ≠ 0 := by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)
  intro hq
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (t,u) q=(-Real.sin a,Real.cos a) := L.apply_symm_apply _
  have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change q.1=0 at hq
  change 1*(-Real.sin t*q.1) + -Real.sin u*q.2 = -Real.sin a at h₁
  change 1*(Real.cos t*q.1) + Real.cos u*q.2 = Real.cos a at h₂
  simp only [hq,mul_zero,zero_add] at h₁ h₂
  apply ha
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination (Real.cos u)*h₁+(Real.sin u)*h₂

name: circleEndpoint_fiber_ne
proof:
by
  have he : circleTargetDeriv q (0,1)=(-Real.sin q.2,Real.cos q.2) := by
    simp [circleTargetDeriv,jetCenter,jetRadius,jetAngle,hr]
  change (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm
    (circleTargetDeriv q (0,1))).1) ≠ 0
  rw [he]
  exact inverse_tangent_first_ne h ha

name: circleEndpoint_uniform
proof:
strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz (circleEndpoint_strict h he) (circleEndpoint_fiber_ne h hr ha)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)

name: circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨P₀,I₀,hP₀,hp₀,hI₀,ha₀,K,hK⟩ := circleEndpoint_uniform h he hr ha
  have hc : ContinuousAt circleTarget (p,a) := circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt
  have hi := (circleEndpoint_strict h he).continuousAt
  have hs : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleEndpoint h w ∈ Metric.ball t 1 := by
    have hb : Metric.ball t 1 ∈ 𝓝 (circleEndpoint h (p,a)) := by
      have ht : circleEndpoint h (p,a)=t := by simp [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_at]
      rw [ht]
      exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num)
    exact hi hb
  have ht : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleTarget w ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target := by
    apply hc
    rw [he]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds
      ((show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
        (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
        (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target)
  have hn : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).1) ≠ 0 := by
    exact hc.eventually (by simpa only [he] using circleInverse_regular h)
  obtain ⟨P₁,hP₁,I₁,hI₁,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (ht.and (hn.and hs))
  obtain ⟨P₂,hP₂,hP₂o,hp₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP₁
  obtain ⟨I₂,hI₂,hI₂o,ha₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI₁
  let P := P₀ ∩ P₂
  let I := I₀ ∩ I₂ ∩ Ioo (a-Real.pi) (a+Real.pi)
  refine ⟨P,I,hP₀.inter hP₂o,⟨hp₀,hp₂⟩,(hI₀.inter hI₂o).inter isOpen_Ioo,
    ⟨⟨ha₀,ha₂⟩,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩,?_,K,?_,?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨hv.2.1,by linarith [hv.2.2]⟩
  · intro q hq
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro v w
    exact (hK q hq.1).le_mul_dist ⟨v.1,v.2.1.1⟩ ⟨w.1,w.2.1.1⟩
  · intro q hq v hv
    have hh := hsub (show (q,v) ∈ P₁ ×ˢ I₁ from ⟨hP₂ hq.2,hI₂ hv.1.2⟩)
    exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.1,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hh.2.2⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: volume_preimage_bound
proof:
by
  have he : Subtype.val '' ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A) = F ⁻¹' A ∩ s := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hq,q.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hp,hs⟩; exact ⟨⟨p,hs⟩,hp,rfl⟩
  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ × ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image
    (Or.inl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2)) ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A)
  have ha := hF.hausdorffMeasure_preimage_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2) A
  rw [he,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real] at hi
  rw [← hi,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ENNReal.rpow_two] at ha
  exact ha

name: map_restrict_volume_le
proof:
by
  apply Measure.le_iff.mpr
  intro A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hA,Measure.restrict_apply (hm hA),Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.restrict_apply hA,smul_eq_mul,ENNReal.coe_pow]
  have he : F ⁻¹' A ∩ s = F ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) ∩ s := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨⟨hx.1,himage hx.2⟩,hx.2⟩,fun hx => ⟨hx.1.1,hx.2⟩⟩
  rw [he]
  exact volume_preimage_bound hF (A ∩ B)

name: antilipschitz_small_perturbation
proof:
by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro x y
  have h1 := hf.le_mul_dist x y
  have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul x y
  have h3 : dist (F x) (F y) ≤ dist (F x+a • G x) (F y+a • G y) + ‖a‖*dist (G x) (G y) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right,dist_smul₀] using

name: tendsto_integral_of_local_cover
proof:
by
  classical
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K,hKU,hK,hμK⟩ := (isOpen_iUnion hVo).measurableSet.exists_isCompact_sdiff_lt
    (measure_ne_top μ _) (by exact ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (half_pos hε)))
  have hδ : μ Kᶜ < ENNReal.ofReal (ε/2) := by
    have he : (Kᶜ : Set X) =ᵐ[μ] ((⋃ i, V i) \ K : Set X) := by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with x hx
      exact propext ⟨fun h => ⟨hx,h⟩,fun h => h.2⟩
    exact (measure_congr he).trans_lt hμK
  have hδr : μ.real Kᶜ < ε/2 := by
    have hh := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _) (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).mpr hδ
    simpa only [Measure.real,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_of_lt (half_pos hε))] using hh
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover V hVo hKU
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_finsetSum J (fun i _ => hlocal i)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hmaj : (∫ x, F n x ∂μ) ≤ (∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) + μ.real Kᶜ := by
    have hJJ : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i ∈ J, (V i).indicator (F n) x) μ :=
      integrable_finsetSum J (fun i _ => (hF n).indicator (hVo i).measurableSet)
    have hCC : Integrable (Kᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
      (integrable_const _).indicator hK.measurableSet.compl
    have hi := integral_mono (hF n) (hJJ.add hCC) (fun x => by
      have hs (i : I) : 0 ≤ (V i).indicator (F n) x := indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => (hb n y).1) x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ K
      · obtain ⟨i,hi,hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hJ hx)
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hs j) hi
        simp only [Pi.add_apply,indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ Kᶜ from not_not.mpr hx),add_zero]
        exact (by simpa only [indicator_of_mem hxi] using hsum)
      · change F n x ≤ (∑ i ∈ J, (V i).indicator (F n) x) + Kᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x
        rw [indicator_of_mem hx]
        linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ J) => hs i), (hb n x).2])
    apply hi.trans_eq
    refine (integral_add hJJ hCC).trans ?_
    apply congrArg₂ (·+·)
    · exact (integral_finsetSum J (fun i _ => (hF n).indicator (hVo i).measurableSet)).trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => integral_indicator (hVo i).measurableSet))
    · rw [integral_indicator hK.measurableSet.compl]
      simp only [integral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_one,Measure.real,Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => (hb n x).1)]
  have hh := hN n hn
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => integral_nonneg (fun x => (hb n x).1)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg hs0] at hh
  linarith

    (fun n => bounded_difference_integrable (hf.comp (hT n)) (hf.comp hS)

    (fun n q => ⟨norm_nonneg _,by

      change -1 ≤ f (T n q)-f (S q) ∧ f (T n q)-f (S q) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hfb (T n q)).1,(hfb (T n q)).2,(hfb (S q)).1,(hfb (S q)).2]⟩)
    V hVo hfull
  intro p
  let B := Metric.closedBall x (4 : ℝ)
  let ν : Measure RealPlane := volume.restrict B
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := measurableSet_closedBall
  let : IsFiniteMeasure ν := ⟨by simpa [ν] using (isCompact_closedBall x 4).measure_lt_top⟩
  have hfi : Integrable f ν := Integrable.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun z => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hfb z).1]; exact (hfb z).2)
  have hmapT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((μ.restrict (V p)).map (T n)) ≤

    filter_upwards [circleSum_eventual_image hr hy,circleSum_eventual_antilipschitz (hK p) hr y] with n hn ha
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) (hT n)).trans

  have hmapS : ((μ.restrict (V p)).map S) ≤ (((2*K p)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • ν := by
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) hS).trans
    exact map_restrict_volume_le hS hB (circleSum_limit_antilipschitz (hK p) x)

def binaryPhi (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := t+Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))

proof:

  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t

  have hi := binary_arctan_identity d t
  have he : 1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2=binaryQ d t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2 := by
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
    nlinarith [hi]
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)=Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/(1-d*Real.cos t) := by
    rw [he,Real.sqrt_div hq.1.le,Real.sqrt_sq hq.2.2.le]
  have hcθ : Real.cos (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=(1-d*Real.cos t)/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.cos_arctan,hs]
    field_simp
  have hsθ : Real.sin (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=d*Real.sin t/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.sin_arctan,hs]
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
  dsimp [binaryPhi]
  simp only [Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,hcθ,hsθ]
  constructor
  · field_simp [hq.2.2.ne',hsq]
    linear_combination -d*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)

  have hiv : Integrable (fun x => f x*v x) μ := hv.mul_of_top_right hft

      filter_upwards [hfb] with x hx
      change ‖f x * v x - f x * g x‖ ≤ ‖v x - g x‖

    (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by positivity : 0 < ε/3))
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := g.exists_forall_norm_le
  have hg2 : MemLp g 2 μ := MemLp.of_bound g.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable C (Eventually.of_forall hC)
  have hgi : Integrable (fun x => g x) μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hgm
  have herr : (∫ x, ‖v x-g x‖ ∂μ) < ε/3 := by
    change (∫ x, ‖(v - (fun x => g x)) x‖ ∂μ) < ε/3
    rw [integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hv.sub hgi).aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm (hv.sub hgi).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (ne_top_of_lt hg) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hg |>.trans_eq (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity))
  have he (w : Lp ℝ 2 μ) : ⟪w,hg2.toLp g⟫ = ∫ x, w x*g x ∂μ := by
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hg2.coeFn_toLp] with x hx
    simp [hx, mul_comm]
  have htt := ht (hg2.toLp g)

        dist (∫ x, b x*g x ∂μ) (∫ x, b x*v x ∂μ) := by

  intro x hx y hy
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) (C ×ˢ C) :=
    (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd).norm.continuousOn
  have hpre : IsPreconnected ((fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C)) :=
    (hC.prod hC).image _ hcont
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    ⟨(x, x), ⟨hx, hx⟩, by simp⟩
  have hd : ‖x - y‖ ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    ⟨(x, y), ⟨hx, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ (fun p : E × E => ‖p.1 - p.2‖) '' (C ×ˢ C) :=
    hpre.Icc_subset h0 hd ⟨by norm_num, le_of_lt hcon⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩ := hone
  exact h p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 hpp

/-- **The connected-set exclusion used for `Delta(K_j)`** (paper, Proposition 7.1).

If `C` is preconnected and no point of `C` is at distance exactly one from `z`, then `C` cannot
have points both strictly inside and strictly outside the unit circle about `z`. Equivalently: a
set that is connected, lies in one colour class, and is hit by the circle of radius one at no
point, cannot straddle that circle.  This is the a.e. exclusion the paper applies with
`C = K_j` and `z` a point carrying an endpoint label of edge `j`. -/

name: not_straddle_of_isPreconnected
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨⟨q₁, hq₁, h₁⟩, q₂, hq₂, h₂⟩
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) C :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm.continuousOn
  have hpre : IsPreconnected ((fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C) := hC.image _ hcont
  have ha : ‖z - q₁‖ ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C := ⟨q₁, hq₁, rfl⟩
  have hb : ‖z - q₂‖ ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C := ⟨q₂, hq₂, rfl⟩
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ∈ (fun q : E => ‖z - q‖) '' C :=
    hpre.Icc_subset ha hb ⟨le_of_lt h₁, le_of_lt h₂⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1⟩ := hone
  exact h q hq hq1

/-- Consequence for colourings: the connected component of any point in a colour class of a
proper colouring is unit-free, hence has diameter at most one. -/

name: diam_le_one_connectedComponentIn_of_properColoring
proof:
by
  apply diam_le_one_of_preconnected_unitFree isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  have hx' : c x = i := hs x (connectedComponentIn_subset s z hx)
  have hy' : c y = i := hs y (connectedComponentIn_subset s z hy)
  exact hc x y hxy (by rw [hx', hy'])

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero
proof:
by
  let T : ℕ → Set X := fun N => ⋂ n ≥ N, E n
  have hT : ∀ N, μ (T N) = 0 := by
    intro N
    apply le_antisymm _ (by positivity)
    apply ge_of_tendsto hE
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    exact measure_mono (fun z hz => (mem_iInter.mp (mem_iInter.mp hz n)) hn)
  have hn : μ (⋃ N, T N) = 0 := measure_iUnion_null hT
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hn] with z hz
  rw [← not_eventually]
  intro he
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp he
  exact hz (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨N,mem_iInter.mpr fun n => mem_iInter.mpr (hN n)⟩)

/-- Pointwise differentiation plus vanishing exceptional sets gives the measure
exclusion used for both the mesh bound and the common continuum exclusions. -/

name: ae_ne_one_of_eventual_bound

by
  filter_upwards [hp,ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero hE] with z hz hgood hzU hf
  have hgt : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1-α < p n z :=
    hz.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by rw [hf]; linarith))
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hbnd,hlarge⟩ := (hgood.and_eventually ((hb z hzU).and hgt)).exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbnd hn)) hlarge
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit
proof:
by
  apply (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed L.isCompact.isClosed).mpr
  intro A B hA hB hcov hd
  by_contra hh
  push Not at hh
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.1
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyB⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.2
  have hxB := (hcov hx).resolve_left hxA
  have hyA := (hcov hy).resolve_right hyB
  obtain ⟨U,V,hU,hV,hAU,hBV,hUV⟩ := normal_separation hA hB hd
  have hL : (L : Set X)⊆U∪V := hcov.trans (union_subset_union hAU hBV)
  have hs : ∀ᶠn in l,(K n : Set X)⊆U∪V := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen (hU.union hV)).mem_nhds hL)
  have hu : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩U).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hU).mem_nhds ⟨y,hy,hAU hyA⟩)
  have hv : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩V).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hV).mem_nhds ⟨x,hx,hBV hxB⟩)
  obtain ⟨n,hnc,hns,hnu,hnv⟩ := (hc.and (hs.and (hu.and hv))).exists
  obtain ⟨z,_,hzU,hzV⟩ := hnc U V hU hV hns hnu hnv
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hUV hzU hzV

    hm.mono fun n hn => Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem hn
  have he : Metric.infDist y (L : Set X)=0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hh
    (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h0.symm)

one common subsequence of connected compact limits. -/

/-- One interface excludes both labels from the same straddling set and approaches
its center in an actual unit direction. -/
def CommonInterface (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (x : ℂ) (i j : Fin 5) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set ℂ, ∃v : ℂ, ‖v‖=1 ∧ Nonempty (ApproachingContinuum x K v) ∧
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle K) ∧ Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle K)

name: CommonInterface.symm
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hj,hi⟩

name: spatialSupport_perm
proof:
by
  have he : {z : ℂ | (e.symm ∘ c) z=i}={z : ℂ | c z=e i} := by
    ext z
    exact e.symm_apply_eq
  simp only [spatialSupport,he]

name: CommonInterface.perm
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,by rwa [spatialSupport_perm],by rwa [spatialSupport_perm]⟩

name: commonInterface_of_continuum
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,ha⟩ := continuum_has_approach hK hx hy hne
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,ha,hi,hj⟩

name: no_triangle_commonInterface
proof:
by
  let a : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2]
  let b : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,0]
  have h (i : Fin 3) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h20
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_triangle_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : triangleEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i

name: no_four_commonInterface
proof:
by
  let a : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2,3]
  let b : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,3,0]
  have h (i : Fin 4) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h30
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_four_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : fourEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i

name: no_five_commonInterface
proof:
by
  choose K v hv hK hi hj using h
  exact no_five_exclusion_continua c hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i)) (fun i => ⟨hi i,hj i⟩)
/-- All actual common-exclusion interfaces at a point form a forest. This
assembles triangle, four and five cases for arbitrary labels, not just canonical cycles. -/

name: commonInterface_graph_acyclic
proof:
by
  intro v p hp
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := cycle_standard_permutation hp
  have hm : Measurable (e.symm ∘ c) := (measurable_of_finite e.symm).comp hc
  have hw' := weak_relabel c e.symm hw
  have h (i j : Fin 5) (hij : G.Adj (e i) (e j)) : CommonInterface (e.symm ∘ c) x i j :=
    (hG _ _ hij).perm e
  rcases he with ⟨h01,h02,h12⟩|⟨h01,h12,h23,h30⟩|hfive
  · exact no_triangle_commonInterface hm hw' (h _ _ h01) (h _ _ h12) (h _ _ h02).symm
  · exact no_four_commonInterface hm hw' (h _ _ h01) (h _ _ h12) (h _ _ h23) (h _ _ h30)
  · exact no_five_commonInterface hm hw' (fun i => h _ _ (hfive i))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: finite_config_proper
proof:
by
  classical
  have hone : ∀ v : ι, DensityOne (Set.univ : Set ℂ) (z v) := by
    intro v
    have hb : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ),
        volume ((Set.univ : Set ℂ) ∩ Metric.closedBall (z v) r) /
          volume (Metric.closedBall (z v) r) = 1 := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
      rw [Set.univ_inter,
        ENNReal.div_self (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume (z v) hr).ne'
          (isCompact_closedBall (z v) r).measure_ne_top]
    exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' (hb.mono fun r hr => hr.symm) tendsto_const_nhds
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq⟩ := finite_density_realization (k := k) (c := c) hc hw z
    (fun _ => Finset.univ) (fun v => by simpa using hone v)
  exact ⟨q, fun v w h => hq v w h⟩

/-- Finite characterisation of colourings of the plane: if every finite set of points admits a
proper colouring, then the whole plane does (Tychonoff compactness in `ℂ → Fin k`). -/

name: exists_properColoring_of_finset
proof:
by
  classical
  letI : CompactSpace (ℂ → Fin k) := Pi.compactSpace
  let t : ℂ × ℂ → Set (ℂ → Fin k) := fun p =>
    {c | c p.1 ≠ c p.2} ∪ {c | ¬ ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1}
  have ht : ∀ p, IsClosed (t p) := by
    intro p
    apply IsClosed.union
    · have hcont : Continuous (fun c : ℂ → Fin k => (c p.1, c p.2)) :=
        (continuous_apply p.1).prodMk (continuous_apply p.2)
      exact (isClosed_discrete {q : Fin k × Fin k | q.1 ≠ q.2}).preimage hcont
    · by_cases hd : ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1 <;> simp [hd]
  have hfip : ∀ u : Finset (ℂ × ℂ), (⋂ p ∈ u, t p).Nonempty := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h (u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd)
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_iInter, t]
    intro p hp
    have h1 : p.1 ∈ u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd :=
      Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
    have h2 : p.2 ∈ u.image Prod.fst ∪ u.image Prod.snd :=
      Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
    by_cases hd : ‖p.1 - p.2‖ = 1
    · left
      exact hc p.1 h1 p.2 h2 hd
    · right; exact hd
  have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (ℂ → Fin k)) := isCompact_univ
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := hcomp.inter_iInter_nonempty t ht (fun u => by simpa using hfip u)
  refine ⟨c, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hc
  have h1 : c ∈ t (x, y) := hc (x, y)
  simp only [t, mem_union] at h1
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd hxy h1

/-- A weak measurable `k`-colouring produces an ordinary proper `k`-colouring of the plane. -/

name: properColoring_of_weak
proof:
by
  classical
  apply exists_properColoring_of_finset
  intro F
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := finite_config_proper (k := k) hc hw (fun x : F => (x : ℂ))
  exact ⟨fun x => c (q + x), fun x hx y hy hxy =>
    hq ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ (by simpa using hxy)⟩

name: triangular_wedge_bound
proof:
by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - x) - s * y := by linarith
  have hplus : 0 ≤ (1 - x) + s * y := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hs) hy0]
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hnonneg hplus
  have hxprod := mul_nonneg hx0 (show 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - x by linarith)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s * y), sq_nonneg y]

name: triangular_rectangle_cover
proof:
by
  by_cases hx : x ≤ 1 / 2
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ 1 - x
    · exact Or.inl (triangular_wedge_bound s x y hs hsq hx0 hx hy0 hxy)
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 / 2 - x) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ x
    · right; left
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 - x) y hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hy0 (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (x - 1 / 2) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith

/-- Every point in the plane is within squared distance `1/3` of the
unit triangular lattice. The proof gives one of three explicit nearby centers. -/

name: triangular_lattice_cover
proof:
by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3

name: cycle_standard_permutation
proof:
by
  have hl := hp.three_le_length
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) := by
    intro i j h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hp.getVert_injOn' (by change i.val≤p.length-1; omega)
      (by change j.val≤p.length-1; omega) h
  have hle : p.length≤5 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair (Fin.castLE hle)
    (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) (Fin.castLE_injective hle) hinj
  have hem (n : ℕ) (hn : n<p.length) : e ⟨n,lt_of_lt_of_le hn hle⟩=p.getVert n := he ⟨n,hn⟩
  have h0 : e 0=p.getVert 0 := hem 0 (by omega)
  have h1 : e 1=p.getVert 1 := hem 1 (by omega)
  have h2 : e 2=p.getVert 2 := hem 2 (by omega)
  have h01 : G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) := by rw [h0,h1]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  have h12 : G.Adj (e 1) (e 2) := by rw [h1,h2]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  refine ⟨e,?_⟩
  rcases (by omega : p.length=3 ∨ p.length=4 ∨ p.length=5) with hL|hL|hL
  · left
    refine ⟨h01,?_,h12⟩
    have h20 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 2) (by omega)
    have hlast : p.getVert 3=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
    rw [hlast,← h2,← h0] at h20
    exact h20.symm
  · right; left
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    refine ⟨h01,h12,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    · have h30 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 3) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 4=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h3,← h0] at h30
  · right; right
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    have h4 : e 4=p.getVert 4 := hem 4 (by omega)
    have h23 : G.Adj (e 2) (e 3) := by rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h34 : G.Adj (e 3) (e 4) := by rw [h3,h4]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h40 : G.Adj (e 4) (e 0) := by
      have h40 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 4) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 5=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h4,← h0] at h40
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h34
    · exact h40
end EuclideanFiveColor

    intro i j

    · have ho := (transitionEdge_closed c i j).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hij
      exact Filter.Eventually.mono ho fun _ hy h => False.elim (hy h)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,∀i j : Fin 5,
      TransitionEdge c i j y → TransitionEdge c i j x :=
    (Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => Filter.eventually_all.mpr (he i))
  filter_upwards [hall] with y hy

  exact not_not.mpr (hx'.anti (fun {i j} h => hy i j h))

    measurableSet_ball (ball_ne_top q (ε+dist q z)),volumeReal_ball q (by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := z)]),
    volumeReal_ball q (sub_nonneg.mpr hd)]
  ring

name: diskAverage_lipschitz
proof:
by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro q z
  change |diskAverage c ε i q-diskAverage c ε i z|≤(4/ε)*dist q z
  by_cases hd : dist q z≤ε
  · rw [diskAverage_area hc,diskAverage_area hc,← sub_div,abs_div,
      volumeReal_ball 0 hε.le,abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0<Real.pi*ε^2)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<Real.pi*ε^2)).mpr
    have hh := measure_inter_ball_difference {v | c v=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const) q z hd
    apply hh.trans_eq
    field_simp
  · have hb : |diskAverage c ε i q-diskAverage c ε i z|≤1 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q,diskAverage_nonneg c ε i z,
        diskAverage_le_one hc hε i q,diskAverage_le_one hc hε i z]
    apply hb.trans
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,le_div_iff₀ hε]
    linarith [not_le.mp hd]

name: colorFn_norm_le_one

name: diskAverage_product

name: disk_overlap_swap
proof:
by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := ⟨by
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using (ball_ne_top x r).lt_top⟩
  simp_rw [diskAverage_product hε]
  apply integral_integral_swap
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (((colorFn_measurable hc i).comp (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd.fst)).mul
      ((colorFn_measurable hc j).comp (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd.snd))).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    change ‖colorFn c i _*colorFn c j _‖≤1
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact (mul_le_mul (colorFn_norm_le_one i _) (colorFn_norm_le_one j _) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one).trans_eq (one_mul _)

name: root_overlap_bound
proof:
by
  let T := transitionSet c i j x R (h₂-h₁)
  have hT : MeasurableSet T := transitionSet_measurable c hc i j x R (h₂-h₁)
  have hTf : volume T≠⊤ := (transitionSet_finite c i j x R (h₂-h₁)).ne
  have hI : Integrable (fun q : ℂ => T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁)) volume := by
    exact ((integrable_indicator_iff hT).mpr (integrableOn_const (C := (1:ℝ)) hTf)).comp_add_right h₁
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := ⟨by
    simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using (ball_ne_top x r).lt_top⟩
  have hF : Integrable (fun q : ℂ => colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂))
      (volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (((colorFn_measurable hc i).comp (measurable_id.add_const h₁)).mul
      ((colorFn_measurable hc j).comp (measurable_id.add_const h₂))).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      change ‖colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂)‖≤1
      rw [norm_mul]
      simpa using mul_le_mul (colorFn_norm_le_one i (q+h₁)) (colorFn_norm_le_one j (q+h₂)) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
  have hle : (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h₁)*colorFn c j (q+h₂))≤
      ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁) := by
    apply integral_mono_ae hF hI.restrict
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with q hq
    by_cases h1 : c (q+h₁)=i
    · by_cases h2 : c (q+h₂)=j
      · have hmem : q+h₁∈T := by
          refine ⟨?_,Or.inl ⟨h1,?_⟩⟩
          · change dist (q+h₁) x<R
            have he : q+h₁-x=(q-x)+h₁ := by ring
            rw [dist_eq_norm,he]
            have hq' : ‖q-x‖<r := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hq
            exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
          · convert h2 using 1; congr 1; ring
        simp [colorFn,h1,h2,Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      · simp only [colorFn,ite_eq_left h1,ite_eq_right h2,mul_zero]; exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
    · simp only [colorFn,ite_eq_right h1,zero_mul]; exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
  apply hle.trans
  calc
    (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁)) ≤
      ∫ q, T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (q+h₁) :=
        integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self (Eventually.of_forall fun q => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _) hI
    _ = volume.real T := by
      rw [(measurePreserving_add_right volume h₁).integral_comp
        (MeasurableEquiv.addRight h₁).measurableEmbedding]
      rw [integral_indicator hT]
      simp

name: root_overlap_zero
proof:
by
  apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
    simp only [colorFn]
    split_ifs with hi hj hj <;> try norm_num
    exact False.elim (hne (hi.symm.trans hj))

name: missing_edge_uniform
proof:
by
  have hev : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ), transitionRatio c i j x R h<ENNReal.ofReal η :=
    ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hη))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hev
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun h hh => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : h=0
  · subst h
    have he : transitionSet c i j x R 0=∅ := by
      ext q
      simp only [transitionSet,mem_ofPred_eq,add_zero,mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false]
      rintro ⟨_,hh|hh⟩
      · exact hne (hh.1.symm.trans hh.2)
      · exact hne (hh.2.symm.trans hh.1)
    simp [he]
  · have hr : transitionRatio c i j x R h ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η :=
      le_of_lt (hd ⟨by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh,hz⟩)
    have hm := (ENNReal.div_le_iff (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz)).ne'
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hr
    have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top) hm
    simpa only [Measure.real,ENNReal.toReal_mul,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hη.le,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (norm_nonneg h)] using hreal

name: diskLaw_mem_ball
proof:
by

  exact ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball

name: disk_overlap_bound
proof:
by
  have := diskLaw_probability hε
  rw [disk_overlap_swap hc hε]
  have hab : ∀ᵐ h ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε), h.1∈Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε ∧ h.2∈Metric.ball (0:ℂ) ε := by
    apply (ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (measurableSet_ball.prod measurableSet_ball)).mpr
    filter_upwards [diskLaw_mem_ball hε] with h₁ hh₁
    filter_upwards [diskLaw_mem_ball hε] with h₂ hh₂
    exact ⟨hh₁,hh₂⟩
  have hh : ∀ᵐ h ∂(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε),
      (∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2))≤2*η*ε := by
    filter_upwards [hab] with h hh
    have ha : ‖h.1‖<ε := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh.1
    have hb : ‖h.2‖<ε := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh.2
    by_cases he : h.1=h.2
    · rw [he,root_overlap_zero i j hne]
      positivity
    · have hn : ‖h.2-h.1‖ < 2*ε := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
      apply (root_overlap_bound hc i j x r R h.1 h.2 (by linarith)).trans
      apply (hd _ (hn.trans_le hδ)).trans
      nlinarith
  have hn : 0≤ᵐ[(diskLaw ε).prod (diskLaw ε)]
      fun h => ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, colorFn c i (q+h.1)*colorFn c j (q+h.2) :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun h => integral_nonneg fun q => mul_nonneg (colorFn_nonneg c i _) (colorFn_nonneg c j _)
  simpa using integral_mono_of_nonneg hn (integrable_const (2*η*ε)) hh

name: missing_edge_overlap
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,ht⟩ := missing_edge_lim c i j hne he
  refine ⟨R,hR,fun r hr => ?_⟩
  apply tendsto_order.2
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε
    exact ha.trans_le (div_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun q => mul_nonneg (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q)
      (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q)) (le_of_lt hε))
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := missing_edge_uniform hne ht (show 0<b/4 by linarith)
    have hv : ∀ᶠ ε : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ε < min (R-r) (δ/2) :=
      (eventually_lt_nhds (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,hv] with ε hε hv
    have hh := disk_overlap_bound hc hne x r R (show 0<ε from hε) (show 0≤b/4 by linarith)
      (by have := (lt_min_iff.mp hv).1; linarith) (by have := (lt_min_iff.mp hv).2; linarith) hd
    apply (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (le_of_lt hε)).trans_lt
    have hz : ε≠0 := ne_of_gt hε
    field_simp
    linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
