name: merge
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z,hza,hzb⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp hab
  have hd : dist a.center b.center≤a.radius+b.radius :=
    (dist_triangle a.center z b.center).trans (add_le_add (by simpa [closedBall,dist_comm] using hza) hzb)
  let t : ℝ := b.radius/(a.radius+b.radius)
  have hrs : 0<a.radius+b.radius := add_pos ha.1 hb.1
  have ht0 : 0≤t := (div_pos hb.1 hrs).le
  have ht1 : t≤1 := (div_le_one hrs).mpr (by linarith [ha.1])
  let c := AffineMap.lineMap a.center b.center t
  have hca : dist a.center c≤b.radius := by
    rw [dist_left_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0]
    calc t*dist a.center b.center ≤ t*(a.radius+b.radius) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd ht0
         _ = b.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
  have hcb : dist b.center c≤a.radius := by
    rw [dist_right_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)]
    calc (1-t)*dist a.center b.center ≤ (1-t)*(a.radius+b.radius) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)
         _ = a.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp; ring
  let d : MarkedDisk := ⟨c,a.radius+b.radius+η,a.core || b.core⟩
  have hA : a.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q a.center≤a.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q a.center c) (by linarith)
  have hB : b.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q b.center≤b.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q b.center c) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨d,⟨by dsimp [d]; linarith,?_⟩,hA,hB,le_refl _,?_,rfl⟩
  · intro hc
    have hc' : a.core=true ∨ b.core=true := by cases hca : a.core <;> cases hcb : b.core <;> simp_all [d]
    rcases hc' with hh|hh
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxa⟩ := ha.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hA (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxa)⟩
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxb⟩ := hb.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hB (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxb)⟩
  · dsimp [noncoreCost,d]
    cases a.core <;> cases b.core <;> simp <;> linarith [ha.1,hb.1]
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: erased_pair_sum
proof:
by
  have h1 := Finset.sum_erase_add S f ha
  have h2 := Finset.sum_erase_add (S.erase a) f (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
  linarith

name: merge_sum_bound
proof:
by
  have hs := erased_pair_sum S ha hb hab f
  by_cases hmem : d∈(S.erase a).erase b
  · rw [Finset.insert_eq_of_mem hmem]
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert hmem]
    linarith

/-- Finite disk merging with separate total and non-core radius budgets. Strict
containment at merges, and the retained core witness, are both included. -/

name: separate
proof:
by
  suffices hh : ∀n : ℕ, ∀S : Finset MarkedDisk, S.card=n →
      (∀d∈S,d.Valid L) → ∀η : ℝ,0<η → ∃T : Finset MarkedDisk,
      (∀d∈T,d.Valid L) ∧ (T : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧
      (∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.radius)<(∑d∈S,d.radius)+η ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.noncoreCost)<(∑d∈S,d.noncoreCost)+η from hh _ S rfl hS η hη
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro S hn hS η hη
    by_cases hp : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
    · exact ⟨S,hS,hp,fun d hd => ⟨d,hd,Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩,
        lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη,lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη⟩
    · simp only [Set.Pairwise,Finset.mem_coe] at hp
      push Not at hp
      obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hab,hd⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨d,hdv,hda,hdb,hdr,hdc,hdcore⟩ := merge (hS a ha) (hS b hb) hd (half_pos hη)
      let R := (S.erase a).erase b
      let S' := insert d R
      have hR : ∀e∈R,e∈S := by intro e he; exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).2).2
      have hS' : ∀e∈S',e.Valid L := by
        intro e he
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp he with rfl|he
        · exact hdv
        · exact hS e (hR e he)
      have hcard : S'.card<n := by
        have hc₁ := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha
        have hc₂ := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
        have hc₃ := Finset.card_insert_le d R
        change R.card+1=(S.erase a).card at hc₂
        dsimp only [S']
        omega
      obtain ⟨T,hT,hdis,hcov,hr,hc⟩ := ih S'.card hcard S' rfl hS' (η/2) (half_pos hη)
      refine ⟨T,hT,hdis,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · intro e he
        have he' : ∃f∈S',e.ball⊆f.ball ∧ (e.core=true → f.core=true) := by
          by_cases hea : e=a
          · subst e
            refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hda (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
            intro ha
            rw [hdcore,ha]
            simp
          · by_cases heb : e=b
            · subst e
              refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hdb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
              intro hb
              rw [hdcore,hb]
              simp
            · exact ⟨e,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (by simp [R,he,hea,heb]),Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩
        obtain ⟨f,hf,hef,hcore⟩ := he'
        obtain ⟨g,hg,hfg,hcore'⟩ := hcov f hf
        exact ⟨g,hg,hef.trans hfg,fun hec => hcore' (hcore hec)⟩
      · have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab radius hdv.1.le hdr
        change (∑x∈S',x.radius)≤(∑x∈S,x.radius)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
      · have hdc0 : 0≤d.noncoreCost := by unfold noncoreCost; split_ifs <;> linarith [hdv.1]
        have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab noncoreCost hdc0 hdc
        change (∑x∈S',x.noncoreCost)≤(∑x∈S,x.noncoreCost)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
end MarkedDisk

name: cone_dist
proof:
by
  rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.property.2)]
  rw [←dist_eq_norm,z.property]
def diskCone (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) :
    C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r, Metric.closedBall c r) where
  toFun p := ⟨(1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c,by
    change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c≤r
    rw [cone_dist]
    nlinarith [p.1.property.1]⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const)).add continuous_const).subtype_mk _

name: diskCone_surjective
proof:
by
  intro q
  by_cases hq : q.val=c
  · obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=c)).mpr hr.le
    refine ⟨(1,⟨z,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [diskCone] using hq.symm
  · let d := dist q.val c
    have hd : 0<d := dist_pos.mpr hq
    have hdr : d≤r := q.property
    let t : unitInterval := ⟨1-d/r,⟨by rw [sub_nonneg,div_le_one hr]; exact hdr,
      by linarith [div_nonneg hd.le hr.le]⟩⟩
    have hz : (r/d) • (q.val-c)+c∈Metric.sphere c r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_pos hr hd).le]
      rw [←dist_eq_norm]
      change r/d*d=r
      field_simp
    refine ⟨(t,⟨(r/d) • (q.val-c)+c,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-(1-d/r)) • (((r/d) • (q.val-c)+c)-c)+c=q.val
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right,smul_smul]
    have he : (1-(1-d/r))*(r/d)=1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [he,one_smul,sub_add_cancel]

name: diskCone_fiber
proof:
by
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
  have hd := congrArg (fun x : Metric.closedBall c r => dist x.val c) he
  change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c=dist ((1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c) c at hd
  rw [cone_dist,cone_dist] at hd
  have ht : p.1=q.1 := Subtype.ext (by nlinarith)
  by_cases h1 : p.1=1
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h1,ht.symm.trans h1⟩
  · left
    apply Prod.ext ht
    have hneq : 1-p.1.val≠0 := by
      intro hh
      apply h1
      apply Subtype.ext
      change p.1.val=1
      linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c=(1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c at hv
    rw [←ht] at hv
    have hsub : p.2.val-c=q.2.val-c := (smul_right_injective ℂ hneq (add_right_cancel hv))
    exact sub_left_injective hsub

/-- A contraction genuinely extends arbitrary continuous sphere data across a disk. -/

name: contractible_disk_extension
proof:
by
  let : CompactSpace (Metric.sphere c r) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_sphere c r)
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Y
  let F : C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r,Y) := H.toContinuousMap.comp
    (ContinuousMap.prodMk ContinuousMap.fst (f.comp ContinuousMap.snd))
  have hf : Function.FactorsThrough F (diskCone c hr) := by
    intro p q he
    rcases diskCone_fiber c hr he with rfl|⟨hp,hq⟩
    · rfl
    · change H (p.1,f p.2)=H (q.1,f q.2)
      rw [hp,hq]
      exact (H.map_one_left (f p.2)).trans (H.map_one_left (f q.2)).symm
  have hquot := IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous (diskCone_surjective c hr) (diskCone c hr).continuous
  refine ⟨hquot.lift F hf,?_⟩
  intro z
  have he : diskCone c hr (0,z)=⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [diskCone]
  rw [←he]

  · by_cases hj : i=w

def graphLeafRetraction {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    C(GraphSpace G, GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v})) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphDrop v (graphLeafMove v w 1 p.val),
    graphDrop_mem v (graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf p.property (by norm_num))
      (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphDrop v |>.comp
    ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val))).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafInclusion {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) :
    C(GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v}), GraphSpace G) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphLift v p.val,graphLift_mem v p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLift v).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafHomotopy {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphSpace G)).Homotopy
      ((graphLeafInclusion G v).comp (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)) where
  toFun tp := ⟨graphLeafMove v w tp.1.val tp.2.val,
    graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf tp.2.property tp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; exact graphLeafMove_zero v w p.val
  map_one_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (graphLift_drop v _ (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)).symm

name: graphTree_contractible_aux
proof:
by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro V inst G hcard hG
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial V with hSS|hNT
    · let := hSS
      obtain ⟨a⟩ := hG.nonempty
      let : Nonempty (GraphSpace G) := ⟨⟨graphVertex a,graphVertex_mem G a⟩⟩
      let : Subsingleton (GraphSpace G) := ⟨fun p q => Subtype.ext (by
        have hp := p.property
        have hq := q.property
        simp only [graphRealization_singleton G a,mem_singleton_iff] at hp hq
        exact hp.trans hq.symm)⟩
      infer_instance
    · let := hNT
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hG.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial
      obtain ⟨w,hvw,hleaf⟩ := SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hv
      let W := {i : V // i≠v}
      let G' : SimpleGraph W := G.induce {i | i≠v}
      have hs : ({v}ᶜ : Set V)={i | i≠v} := by ext i; simp
      have hconn : G'.Connected := by
        have hh := hG.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hv
        rwa [hs] at hh
      have hac : G'.IsAcyclic := hG.isAcyclic.induce _
      have hlt : Fintype.card W<n := by
        rw [←hcard]
        apply Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (Subtype.val : W → V) Subtype.val_injective
        intro hh
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hh v
        exact i.property hi
      let : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G') := ih _ hlt W G' rfl ⟨hconn,hac⟩
      have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace G')).comp_left
        (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)).comp_right (graphLeafInclusion G v)
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
      apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
      refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphLeafHomotopy hvw hleaf⟩ ?_⟩
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha

/-- Genuine contraction of the geometric probability-simplex realization of a finite tree. -/

name: graphTree_contractible
proof:
graphTree_contractible_aux _ V G rfl hG
end EuclideanFiveColor

def diskHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,d.ball
def coreHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,⋃(_ : d.core=true),d.ball

/-- Finite closed pasting fills precisely the non-core holes, with actual continuous
tree extensions on their disks and no change outside the original open holes. -/

name: fill_noncore_disks
proof:
by
  let D : Finset MarkedDisk := S.filter fun d => d.core=false ∧ (d.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty
  have hD (d : D) : d.val∈S ∧ d.val.core=false ∧ (d.val.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mp d.property
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall d.val.center d.val.radius,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,
        (g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩).val=f z.val := by
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hf⟩ := hb d.val (hD d).1 (hD d).2.1 (hD d).2.2
    exact forest_disk_extension d.val.center (hr _ (hD d).1) (f.restrict _) hG (fun z => hf z.val z.property)
  choose g hg' using hex
  let X := Q \ coreHoles S
  let Z : Option D → Set X := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      have hdf : d.core=false := by
        cases he : d.core
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (z.property.2 (mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨d,hd,he,hzd⟩))
      let d' : D := ⟨d,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd,hdf,⟨z.val,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd,z.property.1⟩⟩⟩
      exact ⟨some d',Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let f₀ : C(Z none,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => ⟨f z.val.val,hg z.val.val z.val.property.1 z.property⟩,
      (f.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val)).subtype_mk _⟩
  let ψ (d : D) : C(Z (some d),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
      (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun i => match i with
    | none => f₀
    | some d => ψ d
  have hbd (d : D) (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      f₀ ⟨z,h0⟩=ψ d ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,(hD d).1,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius := by
      change dist z.val d.val.center=d.val.radius
      exact le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hg' d ⟨z.val,hs⟩).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis (hD d).1 (hD e).1
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  change (closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ z).val=f z.val
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩]
  rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: positive_log_difference_bound
proof:
by
  have hu' : 0 < u := hm.trans_le hu
  have hv' : 0 < v := hm.trans_le hv
  have haux : ∀ a b : ℝ, m ≤ a → m ≤ b → a-b ≤ C → Real.log a-Real.log b ≤ C/m := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    have ha' := hm.trans_le ha
    have hb' := hm.trans_le hb
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos ha' hb')
    rw [Real.log_div ha'.ne' hb'.ne'] at h
    have he : a/b-1=(a-b)/b := by field_simp
    rw [he] at h
    exact h.trans ((div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hab hb'.le).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hC hm hb))
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by have h := haux v u hv hu (by linarith [neg_le_abs (u-v)]); linarith,
    haux u v hu hv (le_trans (le_abs_self _) hd)⟩

name: controlled_interval_derivative
proof:
by
  have hdist : |t-(a+b)/2| ≤ (b-a)/2 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1,ht.2]
  have h := hlip.dist_le_mul t ((a+b)/2)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,Real.dist_eq] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist K.2
  have hn := neg_le_abs (f' t-f' ((a+b)/2))
  nlinarith

name: controlled_interval_expands
proof:
by
  apply (convex_Icc a b).mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv
    (fun x _ => (hd x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun x _ => (hd x).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) _ a ⟨le_rfl,hab⟩ b ⟨hab,le_rfl⟩ hab
  intro t ht
  rw [(hd t).deriv]
  exact controlled_interval_derivative hlip hab he hmid (interior_subset ht)

name: geometric_partial_sum
proof:
by
  have h : (q-1)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ l N-l 0 := by
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,mul_add]
      nlinarith [hstep n]
  linarith

def iterComposition (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0 => id
  | n+1 => fun x => f n (iterComposition f n x)
def iterDerivative (f D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0 => fun _ => 1
  | n+1 => fun x => D n (iterComposition f n x)*iterDerivative f D n x
variable {f D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}

name: iterComposition_hasDeriv
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hasDerivAt_id x
  | succ n ih => exact (hd n _).comp x ih

name: iterDerivative_pos
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [iterDerivative]
  | succ n ih => exact mul_pos (hD n _) ih

name: iterComposition_strictMono
proof:
by
  apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
  intro x
  rw [(iterComposition_hasDeriv hd n x).deriv]
  exact iterDerivative_pos hD n x

name: iterDerivative_log_oscillation
proof:
by
  rcases K with ⟨K,hKpos⟩
  change |Real.log (iterDerivative f D N x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D N y)| ≤
    2*K*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a))
  have hp : ∀ n t, 0 < D n t := fun n t => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hD n t)
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [iterDerivative]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hm := (iterComposition_strictMono hd hp n).monotone
    have hu := hm hx.1
    have hv := hm hx.2
    have hu' := hm hy.1
    have hv' := hm hy.2
    have hab : 0 ≤ iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a := by linarith
    have hdist : |iterComposition f n x-iterComposition f n y| ≤
        iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hkd := (hK n).dist_le_mul (iterComposition f n x) (iterComposition f n y)
    change |D n (iterComposition f n x)-D n (iterComposition f n y)| ≤
      K*|iterComposition f n x-iterComposition f n y| at hkd
    have hC := mul_nonneg hKpos hab
    have hh := positive_log_difference_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2)
      (hD n (iterComposition f n x)) (hD n (iterComposition f n y)) hC
      (hkd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist hKpos))
    simp only [iterDerivative,Real.log_mul (hp n _).ne' (iterDerivative_pos hp n _).ne',
      Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have ht := abs_add_le (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x))-Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)))
      (Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y))
    have he : Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x)) + Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x) -
      (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)) + Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y)) =
      (Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n x))-Real.log (D n (iterComposition f n y)))+
      (Real.log (iterDerivative f D n x)-Real.log (iterDerivative f D n y)) := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact ht.trans ((add_le_add hh ih).trans_eq (by ring))

name: iterDerivative_ratio_bound
proof:
by
  have hp : ∀ n t, 0 < D n t := fun n t => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hD n t)
  have h := (le_abs_self _).trans ((iterDerivative_log_oscillation hd hD hK hx hy N).trans hM)
  have hex := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h
  rw [Real.exp_sub,Real.exp_log (iterDerivative_pos hp N x),Real.exp_log (iterDerivative_pos hp N y)] at hex
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (iterDerivative_pos hp N y)).mp hex
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: eventually_reaches_threshold
proof:
by
  by_contra hex
  have hlt : ∀ n, l n < L := fun n => lt_of_not_ge (fun h => hex ⟨n,h⟩)
  have hp : ∀ n, 0 < l n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact h0
    | succ n ih => exact (mul_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq) ih).trans_le (hstep n (hlt n))
  have hm : Monotone l := monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => by nlinarith [hstep n (hlt n),hp n]
  have hg : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ)*((q-1)*l 0) ≤ l n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using h0.le
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      have hl := hm (Nat.zero_le n)
      have h := hstep n (hlt n)
      have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (sub_nonneg.mpr hq.le)
      nlinarith
  have hc : 0 < (q-1)*l 0 := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq) h0
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (L/((q-1)*l 0))
  have hn : L < (N : ℝ)*((q-1)*l 0) := (div_lt_iff₀ hc).mp hN
  exact (hlt N).not_ge (hn.le.trans (hg N))

name: first_expansion_threshold
proof:
by
  have hex := eventually_reaches_threshold hq h0 hstep
  let N := Nat.find hex
  have hN : L ≤ l N := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hbefore : ∀ n < N, l n < L := fun n hn => lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min hex hn)
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    by_contra h
    have hzero : N=0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
    rw [hzero] at hN
    exact hsmall.not_ge hN
  have hup : l N ≤ U*L := by
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hNpos)
    rw [hn]
    exact (hupper n).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbefore n (by omega)).le hU)
  have hsum : ∀ n ≤ N, (q-1)*(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, l i) ≤ l n-l 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      have hi := ih (by omega)
      have hs := hstep n (hbefore n (by omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ,mul_add]
      nlinarith
  exact ⟨N,hN,hup,hbefore,(hsum N le_rfl).trans (by linarith)⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

name: exists_expanding_word
proof:
by
  choose j hj using hlarge
  let A : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ := fun n => Nat.rec (a,b)
    (fun _ p => (F (j ((p.1+p.2)/2)) p.1,F (j ((p.1+p.2)/2)) p.2)) n
  let w : ℕ → ι := fun n => j (((A n).1+(A n).2)/2)
  let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n => F (w n)
  let d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n => D (w n)
  have hd' : ∀ n x, HasDerivAt (f n) (d n x) x := fun n x => hd (w n) x
  have hp' : ∀ n x, 0 < d n x := fun n x => (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2).trans_le (hp (w n) x)
  have hends : ∀ n, (A n).1=iterComposition f n a ∧ (A n).2=iterComposition f n b := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      change f n (A n).1=iterComposition f (n+1) a ∧ f n (A n).2=iterComposition f (n+1) b
      rw [ih.1,ih.2]
      exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  let l : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => iterComposition f n b-iterComposition f n a
  have hpos : ∀ n, 0 < l n := fun n => sub_pos.mpr (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab)
  have hstep : ∀ n, l n < L → (1+e/2)*l n ≤ l (n+1) := by
    intro n hln
    apply controlled_interval_expands (hd' n) (hK (w n))
      (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab).le
    · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hln.le K.2).trans hKL
    · simpa only [d,w,(hends n).1,(hends n).2] using hj (((A n).1+(A n).2)/2)
  have hupper : ∀ n, l (n+1) ≤ U*l n := by
    intro n
    exact image_sub_le_mul_sub_of_deriv_le (fun x => (hd' n x).differentiableAt)
      (fun x => by rw [(hd' n x).deriv]; exact hup (w n) x)
      (iterComposition_strictMono hd' hp' n hab).le
  obtain ⟨N,hN,hNu,_,hsum⟩ := first_expansion_threshold (by linarith : 1 < 1+e/2)
    (hpos 0) hsmall hU hstep hupper
  refine ⟨w,N,hN,hNu,fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
  apply iterDerivative_ratio_bound hd' (fun n x => hp (w n) x) (fun n => hK (w n)) hx hy N
  change 2*(K : ℝ)*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ 4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e
  apply (le_div_iff₀ he).mpr
  have hsum' : e/2*(∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, l n) ≤ U*L := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hsum.trans hNu
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum' (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)≤4*(K : ℝ))
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: interval_defect_image_bound
proof:
by
  let E : Set ℝ := {x ∈ Icc a b | ¬(x ∈ A ↔ f x ∈ A)}
  have hE : volume E=0 := measure_mono_null (fun _ h => h.2) (ae_iff.mp hA)
  have hEi : volume (f '' E)=0 := by
    have h := line_lipschitzOn_image_bound (hK.mono (show E ⊆ Icc a b from fun _ h => h.1))
    rw [hE,mul_zero] at h
    exact le_antisymm h bot_le
  have hsub : Icc (f a) (f b) \ A ⊆ f '' (Icc a b \ A) ∪ f '' E := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hxy⟩ := (hc.image_Icc_of_monotoneOn hab hm ▸ hy.1 : y ∈ f '' Icc a b)
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
    · right
      exact ⟨x,⟨hx,fun h => hy.2 (hxy ▸ h.mp hxA)⟩,hxy⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x,⟨hx,hxA⟩,hxy⟩
  calc
    volume (Icc (f a) (f b) \ A) ≤ volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A) ∪ f '' E) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A))+volume (f '' E) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = volume (f '' (Icc a b \ A)) := by rw [hEi,add_zero]
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞)*volume (Icc a b \ A) := line_lipschitzOn_image_bound (hK.mono sdiff_subset)

    (fun x _ => (hd x).differentiableAt)

  rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by rw [← he]; exact mul_nonneg hR (hp z).le),coe_nnnorm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hp x)]
  rw [← he]

name: integrable_comp_of_map_le

by
  have hh := (hf.smul_measure (by simp : (C : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)).mono_measure hmap
  exact (integrable_map_measure hh.aestronglyMeasurable hT.aemeasurable).mp hh

name: integral_norm_comp_le
proof:
by
  have hh := (hf.smul_measure (by simp : (C : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤)).mono_measure hmap
  rw [← integral_map hT.aemeasurable hh.norm.aestronglyMeasurable]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂((C : ENNReal) • ν) :=
      integral_mono_measure hmap (Eventually.of_forall fun y => norm_nonneg _) (hf.norm.smul_measure (by simp))
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_smul_measure]; simp
/-- L¹ continuity under measurable perturbations with a common bounded pushforward density. -/

name: tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub
proof:
by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  let δ := ε/(3*((C : ℝ)+1))
  have hδ : 0<δ := by dsimp [δ]; positivity
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hgi⟩ := hf.exists_boundedContinuous_integral_sub_le hδ
  have hgT (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => g (T n x)) μ :=
    integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) (hmT n) hgi
  have hgS : Integrable (fun x => g (S x)) μ := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hgi
  have hfT (n : ℕ) := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) (hmT n) hf
  have hfS := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hf
  have hmid : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hp := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ) (fun _ => 2*‖g‖)
      (fun n => ((hgT n).sub hgS).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) (integrable_const _)
      (fun n => Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
        rw [norm_norm]
        exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [g.norm_coe_le_norm (T n x),g.norm_coe_le_norm (S x)]))
      (ht.mono fun x hx => by
        have hh := (g.continuous.tendsto (S x)).comp hx
        simpa using (hh.sub tendsto_const_nhds).norm)
    simpa using hp
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hmid (ε/3) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 : (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖ ∂μ) ≤ (C : ℝ)*δ :=
    (integral_norm_comp_le (hT n) (hmT n) (hf.sub hgi)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg C.2)
  have h2 : (∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) ≤ (C : ℝ)*δ :=
    (integral_norm_comp_le hS hmS (hf.sub hgi)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg C.2)
  have htri : (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) ≤
      (∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖ ∂μ) + (∫ x, ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) +
      (∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) := by
    have ha : Integrable (fun x => ‖f (T n x)-g (T n x)‖) μ := ((hfT n).sub (hgT n)).norm
    have hb : Integrable (fun x => ‖g (T n x)-g (S x)‖) μ := ((hgT n).sub hgS).norm
    have hc : Integrable (fun x => ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖) μ := (hfS.sub hgS).norm
    have hi := integral_mono ((hfT n).sub hfS).norm ((ha.add hb).add hc) (fun x => by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.sub_apply,← dist_eq_norm,dist_comm (g (S x))] using
        dist_triangle4 (f (T n x)) (g (T n x)) (g (S x)) (f (S x)))
    apply hi.trans_eq
    exact (integral_add (ha.add hb) hc).trans (congrArg (fun t => t + ∫ x, ‖f (S x)-g (S x)‖ ∂μ) (integral_add ha hb))
  have hδv : (C : ℝ)*δ ≤ ε/3 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<3*((C : ℝ)+1))).mpr
    nlinarith [C.2]
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _)]
  have hm := hN n hn
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => norm_nonneg _)] at hm
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: deriv_lower_antilipschitz
proof:
by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro x y
  wlog hxy : x ≤ y generalizing x y
  · simpa only [dist_comm] using this y x (le_of_not_ge hxy)
  have hm := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
    (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; exact hp x) hxy
  have hmono : f x ≤ f y := le_of_sub_nonneg (by nlinarith)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,Real.dist_eq,abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hxy),
    abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hmono)]
  norm_num
  linarith

name: deriv_lower_qmp
proof:
by
  have hA := (deriv_lower_antilipschitz hd hp).comp
    ((isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : {x : ℝ // x ∈ (univ : Set ℝ)} → ℝ)).antilipschitzWith)
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using
    (line_antilipschitz_qmp (I := univ) (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hd x).continuousAt)).measurable hA)

name: iterComposition_invariant
proof:
by
  have hq' : ∀ n, Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (iterComposition f n) volume volume := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving.id _
    | succ n ih => exact (hq n).comp ih
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => Iff.rfl)
  | succ N ih =>
    filter_upwards [ih,(hq' N).ae (hA N)] with x hx hxx
    exact hx.trans hxx

name: expanding_interval_defect
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨w,N,hN,hNu,hr⟩ := exists_expanding_word hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hab hsmall
  let f := fun n => F (w n)
  let G := iterComposition f N
  have hd' := iterComposition_hasDeriv (fun n x => hd (w n) x) N
  have hp' := iterDerivative_pos (f := f) (fun n x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp (w n) x)) N
  have hm := iterComposition_strictMono (fun n x => hd (w n) x)
    (fun n x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp (w n) x)) N
  have hLip := derivative_ratio_lipschitzOn hab hd' hp' (Real.exp_pos _).le hr
  have hAi := iterComposition_invariant (fun n => deriv_lower_qmp (hd (w n)) (hp (w n)))
    (fun n => hinv (w n)) N
  refine ⟨G a,G b,hN,hNu,?_⟩
  apply (interval_defect_image_bound hab.le
    (fun x _ => (hd' x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (hm.monotone.monotoneOn _) hLip hAi).trans
  gcongr
  change ENNReal.ofReal _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal _
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNu (Real.exp_pos (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)).le
  calc
    Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*((G b-G a)/(b-a)) =
      (Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*(G b-G a))/(b-a) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L/(b-a) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sub_pos.mpr hab).le
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using this
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: periodic_interval_defect
proof:
by
  have he : Icc (a-(n : ℝ)*P) (b-(n : ℝ)*P) \ A =
      (fun x : ℝ => x+(n : ℝ)*P) ⁻¹' (Icc a b \ A) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage,Set.mem_sdiff,mem_Icc,hper]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨⟨h₁,h₂⟩,h₃⟩ <;> exact ⟨⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩,h₃⟩
  rw [he,measure_preimage_add_right]

name: periodic_interval_normalize
proof:
by
  let n : ℤ := ⌊a/P⌋
  refine ⟨a-(n : ℝ)*P,b-(n : ℝ)*P,?_,by ring,periodic_interval_defect hper n a b⟩
  have h := Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P a hP
  have he : Int.fract (a/P)*P=a-(n : ℝ)*P := by
    change (a/P-(⌊a/P⌋ : ℝ))*P=a-(⌊a/P⌋ : ℝ)*P
    field_simp
  rw [he] at h
  exact ⟨h.1,h.2.le⟩

name: compact_almost_conull_interval
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,φ,hφ,hzlim⟩ := isCompact_Icc.tendsto_subseq ha
  have he : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Icc (z+L/4) (z+3*L/4) ⊆ Icc (a (φ n)) (b (φ n)) := by
    have hdist := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hzlim) (L/4) (by positivity)
    filter_upwards [hdist] with n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt] at hn
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hn
    intro x hx
    have hh := hl (φ n)
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1,hx.2]
  have hle : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, volume (Icc (z+L/4) (z+3*L/4) \ A) ≤
      volume (Icc (a (φ n)) (b (φ n)) \ A) := he.mono (fun _ h => measure_mono (sdiff_subset_sdiff_left h))
  refine ⟨z+L/4,z+3*L/4,by ring,?_⟩
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto (hdef.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hle) bot_le
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: exists_density_interval
proof:
by
  have h := Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet (volume : Measure ℝ) hA.compl
  obtain ⟨x,hx,ht⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  have hx' : x ∉ Aᶜ := by simpa using hx
  simp only [indicator_of_notMem hx'] at ht
  have he : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hε
  have hev := ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds he)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, r < L/2 :=
    (eventually_lt_nhds (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)<L/2)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hev' : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      0 < r ∧ r < L/2 ∧ volume (Aᶜ ∩ Metric.closedBall x r)/volume (Metric.closedBall x r)<ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,hev,hsmall] with r hr hh hs
    exact ⟨hr,hs,hh⟩
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hs,hh⟩ := hev'.exists
  refine ⟨x-r,x+r,by linarith,by linarith,?_⟩
  rw [Real.closedBall_eq_Icc] at hh
  have heq : Aᶜ ∩ Icc (x-r) (x+r)=Icc (x-r) (x+r) \ A := by ext; simp [and_comm]
  rw [heq,Real.volume_Icc] at hh
  exact (ENNReal.div_le_iff (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith))) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp hh.le
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: expansion_almost_conull
proof:
by
  let C := Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L
  have hC : 0 < C := mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hU) hL
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,hsmall,hdef⟩ := exists_density_interval hA hpos hL (div_pos hε hC)
  obtain ⟨a',b',hl,_,hbound⟩ := expanding_interval_defect hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU.le hinv hab hsmall
  refine ⟨a',b',hl,hbound.trans ?_⟩
  change ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*(ENNReal.ofReal (ε/C)*ENNReal.ofReal (b-a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_right hdef _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((C/(b-a))*((ε/C)*(b-a))) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hε hC).le,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hC (sub_pos.mpr hab)).le]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ε := by congr 1; field_simp [hC.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hab).ne']

name: expansion_conull_interval
proof:
by
  have hex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℝ, a ∈ Icc 0 P ∧ L ≤ b-a ∧
      volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/((n : ℝ)+1)) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨a,b,hl,hdef⟩ := expansion_almost_conull hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hL hinv hA hpos
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)<1/((n : ℝ)+1))
    obtain ⟨a',b',ha',hlen,hdef'⟩ := periodic_interval_normalize hP hper a b
    exact ⟨a',b',ha',by rwa [hlen],hdef'.trans_le hdef⟩
  choose a b ha hl hdef using hex
  apply compact_almost_conull_interval hL ha hl
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)/((n : ℝ)+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
    (by simpa only [Function.comp_def,ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht)
    (fun _ => zero_le) hdef
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: conull_extend_intervals
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨b,by simp,hnull⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b',hb',hnull'⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hadvance b'
    have hb : b ≤ b' := le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) he.le)) hb'
    have hfa : F j a ≤ b' := (hdispl j a).trans (by linarith)
    have himage : volume (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A)=0 := by
      apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
      exact (interval_defect_image_bound (hab.trans hb) (hLip j).continuous.continuousOn
        ((hmono j).monotoneOn _) (hLip j).lipschitzOnWith (hinv j)).trans (by simp [hnull'])
    refine ⟨F j b',?_,?_⟩
    · push_cast
      nlinarith
    · apply measure_mono_null (t := (Icc a b' \ A) ∪ (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A))
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hxb : x ≤ b'
        · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hx.1.1,hxb⟩,hx.2⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨le_trans hfa (le_of_not_ge hxb),hx.1.2⟩,hx.2⟩
      · exact le_antisymm ((measure_union_le _ _).trans (by rw [hnull',himage,add_zero])) bot_le

name: conull_interval_alternation_false
proof:

  have hmem : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Icc a b → x ∈ A := by

  have hmem' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hmem

    have hxka : x+κ ∈ A := hx' ⟨by linarith [hxin.1],by linarith [hxin.2]⟩
    exact (ha.mp hxka) hxa

name: graphRealization_positive_three
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_,t,_,rfl⟩ := hp
  have hpos (v : V) (hv : 0<graphEdgePoint a b t v) : v=a ∨ v=b := by
    by_contra! hh
    simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hh.1,hh.2] at hv
  rcases hpos i hi with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hpos j hj with rfl|rfl <;>
    rcases hpos k hk with rfl|rfl <;> simp

/-- The actual positive-coordinate component cover contradicts the planar cover
obstruction whenever every connected positive region has diameter at most two. -/

name: graph_map_small_mesh_impossible
proof:
by
  let Q := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5
  have : LocallyPathConnectedSpace Q := (convex_closedBall (0:ℂ) (5:ℝ)).locallyPathConnectedSpace
  let U : Fin 5 → Set Q := fun i => {z | 0<(F z).val i}
  have hU (i : Fin 5) : IsOpen (U i) :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp F.continuous))
  let I := {p : Fin 5 × Set Q // ∃x : Q,p.2=connectedComponentIn (U p.1) x}
  let W : I → Set Q := fun p => p.val.2
  have hW (p : I) : IsOpen (W p) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change IsOpen p.val.2
    rw [hx]
    exact (hU _).connectedComponentIn
  have hpos {p : I} {z : Q} (hz : z∈W p) : 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    exact connectedComponentIn_subset (U p.val.1) x hz
  have heq {p q : I} {z : Q} (hpq : p.val.1=q.val.1) (hp : z∈W p) (hq : z∈W q) : p=q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext hpq
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := q.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hp
    change z∈q.val.2 at hq
    rw [hx,hpq] at hp
    rw [hy] at hq
    rw [hx,hy,hpq,connectedComponentIn_eq hp,connectedComponentIn_eq hq]
  apply PlanarCover.compact_open_cover_impossible Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) W hW ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    have he : ∃i,0<(F z).val i := by
      by_contra! hh
      have hsum := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5))) (fun i _ => hh i)
      rw [graphRealization_sum (F z).property] at hsum
      norm_num at hsum
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := he
    exact ⟨⟨(i,connectedComponentIn (U i) z),⟨z,rfl⟩⟩,mem_connectedComponentIn hi⟩
  · intro z p q r hp hq hr
    rcases graphRealization_positive_three (F z).property (hpos hp) (hpos hq) (hpos hr) with h|h|h
    · exact Or.inl (heq h hp hq)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (heq h hp hr))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (heq h hq hr))
  · intro p x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := p.property
    let K : Set ℂ := Subtype.val '' W p
    have hK : IsPreconnected K := by
      apply IsPreconnected.image _ _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      change IsPreconnected p.val.2
      rw [hz]
      exact isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
    have hsub : K⊆Q := by rintro a ⟨b,_,rfl⟩; exact b.property
    have hprob : ∀z : Q,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
      rintro z ⟨b,hb,he⟩
      have hh : b=z := Subtype.ext he
      subst b
      exact hpos hb
    have hh := hmesh p.val.1 K hK hsub hprob x.val ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ y.val ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor

/-- No Borel weak five-coloring exists. The global approximants here are
constructed from the actual coloring, its transition graph, and its common
interface limits, rather than supplied as an extra coloring hypothesis. -/

name: no_measurable_weak_five_coloring
proof:
by
  let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (1/16) (1/((n:ℝ)+1))
  have hpos (n : ℕ) : 0<t n := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hsmall (n : ℕ) : t n≤1/16 := min_le_left _ _
  have ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero (fun n => (hpos n).le)
    (fun n => min_le_right _ _) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let F : ∀n,FullApprox c (1/10) (t n) := fun n =>
    Classical.choice (fullApprox_exists hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (hpos n))
  have hbad : ∃ᶠn in atTop,∃i : Fin 5,∃K : Set ℂ,IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y :=
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => graph_map_large_positive (F n).map)).frequently
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Filter.frequently_exists.mp hbad
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hφbad⟩ := extraction_of_frequently_atTop hi
  exact FullApprox.no_large_positive_sequence hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (fun n => F (φ n)) (ht.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hsmall (φ n)) i hφbad

proper five-labelling of the countable unit-distance graph on `E`. -/

name: no_proper_five_coloring_algebraic

by
  rintro ⟨c,hc⟩
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hw⟩ := proper_to_borel_weak_algebraic hc
  exact no_measurable_weak_five_coloring hd hw

/-- No unrestricted five-coloring separates all unit-distance pairs in the Euclidean plane. -/

name: no_proper_five_coloring

name: palette_neighbor_real
proof:
by
  let U : Set ℝ := {t | Real.sin (a-t)≠0}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun (Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)) continuous_const
  have hu : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈U := by

    change Real.sin (a-t)≠0

    (ds := fun _ => 1) (dt := fun _ => 0) (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_id t)
    (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_const t a) (fun _ _ => one_ne_zero) (fun _ ht => ht) (fun t _ => ?_) i
  · exact (ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet).mp hh |>.mp (hu.mono fun t ht hi => hi ht)
  · simp only [circleTarget,samplingParameter,add_sub_cancel_left,direction_realPlane,circleSum,one_smul,one_mul,id_eq]

    apply ae_angular_of_ae_line

        (paletteSet_measurable c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) i).compl.union (paletteSet_measurable c hc x i).compl
    · exact palette_neighbor_real c hc hw x a i
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hp] with t ht

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
def stateSupport (f : ℝ → ι) (i : ι) : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict {t | f t=i}).support

name: ae_mem_stateSupport
proof:
(ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hf measurable_const)).mp
    (volume.restrict {t | f t=i}).support_mem_ae

name: ae_state_support
proof:
by
  have h : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,∀i : ι,f t=i → t∈stateSupport f i :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_mem_stateSupport hf i)
  exact h.mono fun t ht => ht (f t) rfl

name: stateSupport_cover
proof:
by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃i,stateSupport f i)  := isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun _ => Measure.isClosed_support
  have hae : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈⋃i,stateSupport f i :=
    (ae_state_support hf).mono fun t ht => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨f t,ht⟩
  have hd := Measure.dense_of_ae hae
  exact mem_iUnion.mp ((hclosed.closure_eq ▸ hd a) : a∈⋃i,stateSupport f i)

name: stateSupport_shift_relation
proof:
by
  classical
  let K : Set ℝ := ⋃j∈({j | R i j} : Set ι),(fun t => t+d)⁻¹'stateSupport f j
  have hK : IsClosed K := (Set.toFinite _).isClosed_biUnion (fun j _ =>
    Measure.isClosed_support.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  have hm : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,f t=i → t∈K := by
    filter_upwards [hR,(measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) d).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_state_support hf)] with t hR ht hti
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨f (t+d),mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hti ▸ hR,ht⟩⟩
  have hk : a∈K := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hK
    ((ae_restrict_iff' (hf (measurableSet_singleton i))).mpr hm) ha

      apply (mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hl
      rcases hl with rfl|rfl <;> tauto
    exact five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hiK (by convert hjK using 1; rw [hab]; ring)
  have hji := FiveComb.opposite_contacts i j hdis
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_hst,hban⟩ := FiveComb.two_bans i j hji
  have hss : a∈fiveSupport c hc x s := by rcases hs with rfl|rfl <;> assumption
  have hbanI := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hi hi' (Or.inl rfl)
  have hbanJ := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hj hj' (Or.inl rfl)

    filter_upwards [hbanI,hbanJ,fiveState_adj c hc hw hx] with t hbI hbJ ha he

      · exact hbI.2 ⟨he,ht⟩

  have hz : volume (fiveRealState c hc x s)=0 := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot)
  exact (stateSupport_nonempty_measure hss).ne' hz

name: palette_open_exclusion
proof:
by
  let e := circleInverseHomeo hab
  let W : Set RealPlane := e.source ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' V
  have hW : IsOpen W := e.open_source.inter (hV.preimage continuous_fst)
  have haW : (a,b)∈W := by
    refine ⟨?_,ha⟩
    exact (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa using hab) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (a,b) from circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hO : IsOpen (circleSum 1 '' W) := e.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hW inter_subset_left
  let g : RealPlane → ℂ := fun q => x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm q
  have hgs (q : RealPlane) : g (circleSum 1 q)=angularSum x 1 (angleChart q) := by
    rw [angularSum_chart]
    simp only [g,map_add,ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hgc : IsOpenMap g := (Homeomorph.addLeft x).isOpenMap.comp Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap
  have hex := anglePair_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i)
  have hp : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.1∈V → (q.1 : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x i :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hpal
  have hnull : volume (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})=0 := by
    apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
    filter_upwards [hex,hp] with q hq hp hmem
    apply hq (hp hmem.1.2)
    change c (angularSum x 1 (angleChart q))=i
    rw [← hgs]
    exact hmem.2
  have himage := plane_lipschitz_image_null circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport hnull
  have hnullg : volume (g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})))=0 := by
    rw [show g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i}))=
      (fun z => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x)) ⁻¹' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})) by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
          simpa only [Set.mem_preimage,g,add_sub_cancel_left,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hp
        · intro hz
          refine ⟨Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x),hz,?_⟩
          change x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x))=z
          rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
          abel]
    exact ((Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.comp (measurePreserving_sub_right volume x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null himage)
  refine ⟨g '' (circleSum 1 '' W),hgc _ hO,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨circleSum 1 (a,b),⟨(a,b),haW,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simpa only [angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,angleChart] using hgs (a,b)
  · exact measure_mono_null (by rintro z ⟨⟨q,⟨p,hp,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,hz⟩; exact ⟨_,⟨p,⟨hp,hz⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩) hnullg

name: transitionEdge_no_open_exclusion
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
  have hae : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈U → c z≠i := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with z hz hu he
    exact hz ⟨hu,he⟩
  have hratio : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, transitionRatio c i j x (r/2) h=0 := by
    have hh : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,‖h‖<r/2 := by
      have hb : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,h∈Metric.ball 0 (r/2) :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (show 0<r/2 by linarith))
      filter_upwards [hb] with h hh
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh
    filter_upwards [hh] with h hh
    have hap := (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hae
    have hzT : volume (transitionSet c i j x (r/2) h)=0 := by
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards [hae,hap] with q hq hqh ht
      have hqU : q∈U := hB (Metric.ball_subset_ball (show r/2≤r by linarith) ht.1)
      have hqhU : q+h∈U := by
        apply hB
        have hd := dist_triangle (q+h) q x
        have hdist : dist (q+h) q=‖h‖ := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
        rw [hdist] at hd
        exact hd.trans_lt (by have hqx : dist q x<r/2 := ht.1; linarith)
      rcases ht.2 with ht|ht
      · exact hq hqU ht.1
      · exact hqh hqhU ht.2
    simp only [transitionRatio,hzT,ENNReal.zero_div]
  have hh : limsup (transitionRatio c i j x (r/2)) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))=0 := by
    rw [limsup_congr hratio]
    exact limsup_const 0
  have hp := he.2 (r/2) (by linarith)
  rw [hh] at hp
  exact lt_irrefl _ hp
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: four_avoiding_traces
proof:
by
  have hh (i j : Fin 5) (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) :
      ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀a∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)),traceValue b a=0 := by

  have he (e : Fin 4) : ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue b i=0 := by
    fin_cases e
    · exact hh 0 1 hx.1
    · exact hh 1 2 hx.2.1
    · exact hh 2 3 hx.2.2.1
    · exact hh 3 0 hx.2.2.2

name: four_state_trace_domination
proof:
by
  have hs (e : Fin 4) : (fun t => ∑a,traceValue (b e) a t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue (b e))
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hzero (e : Fin 4) (a : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,a∈fourEdge e → traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
    by_cases ha : a∈fourEdge e
    · rw [hz e a ha]
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure] with t ht
      exact fun _ => ht
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => fun h => (ha h).elim
  filter_upwards [four_palette_admissible c hc hw hx,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => (trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).1 a),
    ae_all_iff.mpr hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr (hzero e)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x a ⟨b e,hb e⟩)]
    with t hadm hnon hsum hzero hpal
  by_cases hts : fourState c hc x t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    obtain ⟨e,_,hep⟩ := four_trace_edge (palette c hc x t) hadm i (by simpa only [← hts, fourState] using hi)
    have hj (a : Fin 5) (ha : a≠i) : traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
      by_cases he : a∈fourEdge e
      · exact hzero e a he
      · apply le_antisymm _ (hnon e a)
        by_contra! hpos
        have hp := (mem_palette c hc x t a).mpr (hpal e a hpos)
        exact he (hep (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hp,by simpa using ha⟩))
    have heq : traceValue (b e) i t=1 := by
      rw [← hsum e,Finset.sum_eq_single i _ (by simp)]
      intro a _ hai
      exact hj a hai
    rw [← heq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnon j i) (Finset.mem_univ e)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hnon e i)

name: indL2_ae
proof: μ) A hA =ᵐ[μ] A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := indicatorConstLp_coeFn

name: indL2_nonneg

μ) A hA := by

μ) A hA‖≤1 := by
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂μ,‖indL2 (μ := μ) A hA t‖≤1 := by
    filter_upwards [indL2_nonneg (μ := μ) A hA,indL2_le_one (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht hu
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ht]

μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)=oneL2 μ := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i => indL2 (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => indL2_ae (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),oneL2_ae μ] with t ht ha hu
  rw [ht,hu]

  simp

proof:
by
  have hh : 0≤ᵐ[μ] b-a := weak_limit_nonneg μ (f := fun n => g n-f n)
    (fun v => by simpa only [inner_sub_left] using (hg v).sub (hf v)) (fun n => by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (g n) (f n),hle n] with t ht hh
      simpa only [ht,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using hh)
  filter_upwards [hh,Lp.coeFn_sub b a] with t ht he
  simpa only [he,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using ht

proof:
by
  have hone (w : RealL2 μ) : ⟪w,oneL2 μ⟫=∫t,w t ∂μ := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    simpa only [oneL2,setIntegral_univ] using
      L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one MeasurableSet.univ (measure_ne_top μ univ) w
  have hBB : ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,indL2 B hB⟫=⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫ := by
    rw [hone,L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht
    rw [ht]
    by_cases hb : t∈B <;> simp [hb]
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∫t,‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-B.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂μ) =
      ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
      2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2 (μ := μ) B hB⟫ := by
    rw [hone,hone,L2.inner_def,← integral_const_mul,← integral_add,
      ← integral_sub]
    · apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht hu
      rw [ht,hu]
      by_cases ha : t∈A n <;> by_cases hb : t∈B <;> norm_num [ha,hb]
    · exact ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)).add ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num))
    · exact (L2.integrable_inner _ _).const_mul 2
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
  simp_rw [he]
  have ht := ((hw (oneL2 μ)).add_const ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫).sub
    ((hw (indL2 (μ := μ) B hB)).const_mul 2)
  rw [hBB,show ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB, oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
    2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫=0 by ring] at ht
  exact ht

name: four_weak_limit_identify
proof:
by
  have hat (e : Fin 4) : IsTrace c hc y (a e) := trace_limit c hc (fun n => hb n e) hxt (ht e)
  have hdom (s : Fin 3) (i : Fin 5) (hi : i∈fourGroup s) :
      f s≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (∑e,traceValue (a e) i : RealL2 angularMeasure) := by
    apply weak_limit_le (hf s) (f := fun n => fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s)
      (g := fun n => ∑e,traceValue (b n e) i)
      (fun v => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    · simpa only [sum_inner] using tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ
        (fun e _ => traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp (ht e) i v)
    · filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc (x n) t=s}
        (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)) measurable_const),
        Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (b n e) i),
        four_state_trace_domination c hc hw (hx n) (b n) (hb n) (hz n) s hi] with t h₁ h₂ h₃
      simpa only [fourStateL2,h₁,h₂] using h₃
  have hnon (s : Fin 3) : 0≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] f s :=
    weak_limit_nonneg angularMeasure (hf s) (fun n => indL2_nonneg _ _)
  have hsumf : ∑s,f s=oneL2 angularMeasure :=
    weak_limit_sum angularMeasure hf (fun n => indL2_sum (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)))
  have hsupport (s : Fin 3) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,0<f s t → fourGroup s⊆palette c hc y t := by
    have hdom' (i : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,i∈fourGroup s → f s t≤∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_cases hi : i∈fourGroup s
      · filter_upwards [hdom s i hi,Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (a e) i)] with t ht he
        exact fun _ => by simpa only [he] using ht
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => (hi h).elim
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hdom',
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc y i ⟨a e,hat e⟩)] with t hdom hpal hp i hi
    have hsum : 0<∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := hp.trans_le (hdom i hi)
    have hex : ∃e,0<traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_contra! hh
      exact hsum.not_ge (Finset.sum_nonpos fun e _ => hh e)
    obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := hex
    exact (mem_palette c hc y t i).mpr (hpal e i he)
  intro s
  apply Lp.ext
  have hsumae : (fun t => ∑s,f s t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ f
    rw [hsumf] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hnon,ae_all_iff.mpr hsupport,hsumae,
    four_palette_admissible c hc hw hy,
    indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s}
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)] with t hn hp hsum hadm hi
  change f s t=indL2 (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s} _ t
  rw [hi]
  have hz (v : Fin 3) (hv : v≠fourState c hc y t) : f v t=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (hn v)
    by_contra! hh
    have he := (four_admissible_character (palette c hc y t) hadm v).mp (hp v hh)
    exact hv he.symm
  by_cases he : fourState c hc y t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    rw [← hsum,Finset.sum_eq_single s _ (by simp)]
    intro v _ hvs
    exact hz v (by simpa only [he] using hvs)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    exact hz s (Ne.symm he)
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: four_state_subseq_continuity
proof:

    (fun _ _ => indL2_norm _ _)
  choose b hb hz using fun n => four_avoiding_traces c hc hw (hx (φ n))

    (fun n => mem_univ (b n))
  have hid := four_weak_limit_identify c hc hw (fun n => hx (φ (ψ n))) hy
    (hxt.comp (hφ.tendsto_atTop.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop))
    (fun s v => (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => b (ψ n)) a
    (fun n => hb (ψ n)) (fun n => hz (ψ n))
    (fun e => (continuous_apply e).tendsto a |>.comp ha)
  refine ⟨φ∘ψ,hφ.comp hψ,?_⟩
  intro s
  apply indL2_weak_L1 (fun n => measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x (φ (ψ n)))) measurable_const)
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)
  intro v
  have hh := (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  rw [hid s] at hh

  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,ht⟩ := four_state_subseq_continuity c hc hw (fun n => hx (m n)) hy (hxt.comp hmt)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (ht s) ε hε
  exact (hm (φ N)).2.not_gt (hN N le_rfl)

name: angleMk_compact_bound
proof:
by

    (fun _ => isOpen_Ioo) (fun a _ => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩)
  let C : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi),by positivity⟩
  refine ⟨C,Measure.le_iff.mpr (fun A hA => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA,
    Measure.restrict_apply (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA),Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  have hsub : ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩E ⊆
      ⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨a,ha,h₁,h₂⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hF ht.2)
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a,ha,ht.1,h₁,by linarith⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ volume (⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑a∈F,volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le F _
    _ = ∑_a∈F,(volume : Measure Angles) A := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      exact (AddCircle.add_projection_respects_measure (2*Real.pi) (a-Real.pi) hA).symm
    _ = (C:ENNReal)*angularMeasure A := by
      rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle]

      change (F.card:ENNReal)*(ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi)*angularMeasure A)=_
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [show (C:ENNReal)=ENNReal.ofReal ((F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)) from ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal.symm]
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0≤(F.card:ℝ)),ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]

proof:
by

  obtain ⟨v,hv,hs⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpB (ae_restrict_of_ae (volume.restrict (B n)).support_mem_ae)

  choose v hv hd using fun n => (volume.restrict (B n)).isClosed_support.exists_infDist_eq_dist (hne n) b

name: strict_state_uniform_on_compact
proof:
by

  have hex (N : ℕ) : ∃ n≥N, ∃ b∈C, ∃ d∈C,
      b∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧ d∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧
      |‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖-1|<1/(N+1) := by
    have hh := hbad (1/((N:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)
    simpa only [and_assoc] using (frequently_atTop.mp hh) N
  choose f hf b hb d hd hbs hds hsmall using hex
  have hft : Tendsto f atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono hf tendsto_id
  obtain ⟨q,_hq,φ,hφ,hqt⟩ := (hC.prod hC).isSeqCompact
    (fun n => show (b n,d n)∈C×ˢC from ⟨hb n,hd n⟩)
  have hqb : Tendsto (b∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hqd : Tendsto (d∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hdir : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => direction (v : Angles)) :=
    direction_continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi))
  have he : ‖direction (q.1 : Angles)-direction (q.2 : Angles)‖=1 := by
    have hn : Tendsto (fun N => |‖direction (b N : Angles)-direction (d N : Angles)‖-1|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun N => (hsmall N).le)
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hl := (((hdir.tendsto q.1).comp hqb).sub ((hdir.tendsto q.2).comp hqd)).norm.sub_const 1 |>.abs
    have he := tendsto_nhds_unique hl (hn.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp he)
  apply strict_state_sequence_false hc hw (fun n => x (f (φ n))) J K X hlabels
    (fun n => A (f (φ n))) (fun n => B (f (φ n))) D hD hp
    (fun n => hA (f (φ n))) (fun n => hB (f (φ n)))
    (b∘φ) (d∘φ) q.1 q.2 hqb hqd (fun n => hbs (φ n)) (fun n => hds (φ n)) he
  intro E hE
  exact (hL1 E hE).comp (hft.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)

name: circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport
proof:
by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro p q
  have hh (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) :
      dist (g p.1+g p.2) (g q.1+g q.2)≤2*max (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2) := by
    have h1 := hg.dist_le_mul p.1 q.1
    have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul p.2 q.2
    norm_num only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] at h1 h2
    have h3 := dist_add_add_le (g p.1) (g p.2) (g q.1) (g q.2)
    have h4 := le_max_left (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    have h5 := le_max_right (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    linarith
  simpa only [circleSum,one_mul,Prod.dist_eq,NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    max_le (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_cos) (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_sin)

def sumTransport {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) (q : RealPlane) :=
  circleInverse h (circleSum 1 q-H)

name: sumTransport_measurable
proof: (circleInverse_measurable h).comp ((circleSum_continuous 1).sub continuous_const).measurable

name: sumTransport_neighborhood
proof:
by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_fst
  have hbtarget : circleSum 1 (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
    (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  have ht : ∀ᶠ z : RealPlane×RealPlane in 𝓝 (0,(a,b)),
      circleSum 1 z.2-z.1∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧
      Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).1)≠0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)
        (𝓝 (0,(a,b))) (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by simpa only [sub_zero] using hc.tendsto (0,(a,b))
    have htt : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b)),q∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
      (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hbtarget
    exact hlim.eventually (htt.and (circleInverse_regular h))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,W,hW,hPW⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp ht
  obtain ⟨P₀,hP₀,hPsub,hPmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨W₀,hW₀,hWsub,hWmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
  obtain ⟨V₀,hV₀,hv₀,L,hL⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let V := W₀∩V₀∩{q : RealPlane | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0}
  have hV : IsOpen V := (hWsub.inter hV₀).inter ((Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)).isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_ne)
  refine ⟨P₀,V,hPsub,hPmem,hV,⟨⟨hWmem,hv₀⟩,h⟩,L*2,?_⟩
  intro H hH
  have htarget (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) := hPW (a := (H,q)) ⟨hP₀ hH,hW₀ hq.1.1⟩
  have heq (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) : circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)=circleSum 1 q-H :=
    circleInverse_right h (htarget q hq).1
  refine ⟨?_,?_,fun _ hq => hq.2,fun q hq => (htarget q hq).2,heq⟩
  · intro q hq
    change ContinuousAt (fun z : RealPlane => circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z-H)) q
    exact (circleInverse_continuousAt h (htarget q hq).1).comp (x := q)
      (((circleSum_continuous 1).sub (continuous_const (y := H))).continuousAt)
  · apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro q r
    have hh := hL.le_mul_dist ⟨q,q.2.1.2⟩ ⟨r,r.2.1.2⟩
    have hd : dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r)=dist (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)) (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H r)) := by
      rw [heq q q.2,heq r r.2,dist_sub_right]
    change dist (q : RealPlane) (r : RealPlane) ≤ L*dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r) at hh
    rw [hd] at hh
    have hl := circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport.dist_le_mul (sumTransport h H q) (sumTransport h H r)
    apply hh.trans
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl L.2
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat,Set.domRestrict_apply] at *
    nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

proof:

    (by rw [hcov]) (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hb)

name: closed_gap
proof:
by
  have hLC : IsCompact (N∩Icc l z) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  have hRC : IsCompact (N∩Icc z r) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ham⟩ := hLC.exists_isMaxOn (f := id) ⟨l,hl,le_rfl,hlz.le⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbm⟩ := hRC.exists_isMinOn (f := id) ⟨r,hr,hzr.le,le_rfl⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  have haz : a<z := lt_of_le_of_ne ha.2.2 (fun he => hz (he ▸ ha.1))
  have hzb : z<b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.1 (fun he => hz (he.symm ▸ hb.1))
  refine ⟨a,b,ha.1,hb.1,haz,hzb,?_⟩
  intro t ht hn
  by_cases htz : t≤z
  · have hta : t≤a := ham ⟨hn,ha.2.1.trans ht.1.le,htz⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hta) ht.1
  · have hbt : b≤t := hbm ⟨hn,(not_le.mp htz).le,ht.2.le.trans hb.2.2⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbt) ht.2

name: positive_normalized_increment_enters_gap

    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 1)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 1)).support_mem_ae
  have h2 : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fourRealState c hc x 2 → t∈fourSupport c hc x 2 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 2)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 2)).support_mem_ae
  filter_upwards [h1,h2] with t ht1 ht2 hn
  have hn1 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠1 := fun he => hn (Or.inl (ht1 he))
  have hn2 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠2 := fun he => hn (Or.inr (ht2 he))
  exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠1 → s≠2 → s=0 from by decide) _ hn1 hn2

name: four_gap_length
proof:
by
  by_contra! hab
  have hp : 0<volume (Ioo a (b-sixty)) := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have h0 := four_outside_support_state c hc x
  have hshift := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) sixty).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h0
  have hneq := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_changes c hc hw hx)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,ht0,hts,htn⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hp.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (h0.and (hshift.and hneq)))
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have he0 := ht0 (hgap ⟨ht.1,by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  have he1 := hts (hgap ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  apply htn
  simpa only [sixty,AddCircle.coe_add,he0] using he1.symm

name: four_gap_exists
proof:
by
  let N := fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2
  have hN : IsClosed N := Measure.isClosed_support.union Measure.isClosed_support
  have hex : ∃z : ℝ,z∉N := by
    by_contra! h
    exact four_support_union_proper c hc hw hx (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hex
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have hn (a b : ℝ) (hab : sixty<b-a) : ∃t∈Ioo a b,t∈N := by
    by_contra! hbad
    have hle := four_gap_length c hc hw hx hbad
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hab
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hlN⟩ := hn (z-sixty-1) z (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrN⟩ := hn z (z+sixty+1) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz,hzb,hgap⟩ := closed_gap hN hz hlN hrN hl.2 hr.1
  exact ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz.trans hzb,four_gap_length c hc hw hx hgap,hgap⟩

name: strict_increment_limit
proof:
by
  have hb : (fun n => u n-v n) =O[atTop] δ := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound (‖w‖+1)
    filter_upwards [hw.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (lt_add_one ‖w‖))] with n hn

    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hδ n)]
    exact ((inv_mul_lt_iff₀ (hδ n)).mp hn).le.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

    (hf.isLittleO.comp_tendsto (hu.prodMk_nhds hv)).trans_isBigO hb

def transportVelocity (H : RealPlane) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)

name: circleInverseDeriv_fst
proof:
1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm (-H)).1=
      transportVelocity H a b := by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-H)
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (a,b) q = -H := L.apply_symm_apply (-H)
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change 1*(-Real.sin a*q.1)+(-Real.sin b)*q.2= -H.1 at h1
  change 1*(Real.cos a*q.1)+Real.cos b*q.2= -H.2 at h2
  change q.1= -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)
  apply (eq_div_iff h).mpr
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination Real.cos b*h1+Real.sin b*h2

name: sumTransport_increment_limit
proof:
by
  have hv : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq
  have hu : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hv.sub hH
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•((circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n)-circleSum 1 (q n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel_left,smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hh := strict_increment_limit (circleInverse_strict h) hu hv hδ hdiff
  have hid : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (q n))=q n := by
    have hb : (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).source :=
      (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    filter_upwards [hq.eventually ((circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.mem_nhds hb)] with n hn
    have ht : circleSum 1 (q n)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hn
    rw [circleInverse_eq h ht]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hn
  have hf := hh.fst_nhds
  simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hf
  rw [circleInverseDeriv_fst h H] at hf
  apply hf.congr'
  filter_upwards [hid] with n hn
  simp only [hn,div_eq_inv_mul,sumTransport]
  rfl

name: sumTransport_tendsto
proof:
by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero,Function.comp_def] using (((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq).sub hH
  have hi := (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  simpa only [sub_zero,circleInverse_at,sumTransport,Function.comp_def] using hi

name: transportVelocity_neg
proof:
by
  simp only [transportVelocity,Prod.fst_neg,Prod.snd_neg]
  ring

name: sumTransport_double_increment
proof:
by
  have hct := sumTransport_tendsto h hH tendsto_const_nhds
  have hf := sumTransport_increment_limit h hH tendsto_const_nhds hδ hdir
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  have hnd : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•(-Hn n)) atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hr := sumTransport_increment_limit h' hn (hct.fst_nhds.prodMk_nhds hb) hδ hnd
  have hh := hr.add hf
  rw [transportVelocity_neg] at hh
  convert hh using 1
  · funext n
    dsimp
    ring
  · ring_nf
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: ae_angular_nonparallel
proof:
by
  have hs : {b : ℝ | Real.sin (b-a)=0}⊆Set.range (fun n : ℤ => a+n*Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hb

name: transportVelocity_ne

  have hz : (H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a)*Real.sin (b'-b)=0 := by

name: exists_transportVelocity_lt
proof:
by

proof:

name: finite_disk_paste
proof:
by
  let Z : Option S → Set Q := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      exact ⟨some ⟨d,hd⟩,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let φ₀ : C(Z none,Y) := ⟨fun z => f ⟨z.val.val,z.val.property,z.property⟩,
    f.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ₁ (d : S) : C(Z (some d),Y) := ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
    (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,Y) := fun i => match i with | none => φ₀ | some d => φ₁ d
  have hbd (d : S) (z : Q) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      φ none ⟨z,h0⟩=φ (some d) ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,d.property,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius :=
      le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    exact (hb d ⟨z.val,hs⟩ z.property h0).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis d.property e.property
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  exact closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

def annulusMap {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) {x : ℂ} (hx : x∈activeCenters L) :
    C(planeAnnulus x (2*t) R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
  ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.annulus_in_domain hR htR hsep hx z.property⟩,
    a.map.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)⟩
/-- Fill all the actual core holes simultaneously when their surrounding crossing
graphs are forests, retaining the threshold map outside the original and outer disks. -/

name: fill_cores
proof:
by
  let D := centerDisks (activeCenters L) R
  have hdis : (D : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) :=
    centerDisks_disjoint fun x hx y hy hxy => hsep x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1 y (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1 hxy
  let f : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 \ diskHoles D),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
    ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.outside_centers_in_domain htR (htR.trans hR) z.property⟩,
      a.map.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)⟩
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(d.val.closedBall,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,∀hzQ : z.val∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,
        ∀hzD : z.val∉diskHoles D,
        g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f ⟨z.val,hzQ,hzD⟩ := by
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := d
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := annulus_forest_extension htR (a.annulusMap hR htR hsep hx) (hforest x hx)
    exact ⟨g,fun z _ _ => hg z⟩
  choose g hg using hex
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := finite_disk_paste (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) D hdis f g hg
  refine ⟨F,fun z hzS hzD => ?_⟩
  rw [hF z hzD]
  exact a.agrees _ hzS
/-- The common-exclusion limit contradiction applies to the constructed maps, so
all these actual core fillings exist eventually at any fixed separated outer scale. -/

name: eventually_fill_cores
proof:
by
  have hrad : Tendsto (fun n => 2*t n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using ht.const_mul 2
  have h (x : activeCenters L) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (crossingGraph (fun z => ((a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property z).val)
        (annulusInner x.val (2*t n) R) (annulusOuter x.val (2*t n) R)).IsAcyclic := by
    apply annulus_maps_eventually_forest hc hw hR0 hrad (ε_tendsto a ht)
      (fun n => (a n).ε_pos) (annuli_tendsto a ht)
      (fun _ _ _ => unit_from_hole_mem_annuli) hα hα'
      (fun n => (a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property)
    intro n z hz
    exact (a n).agrees _ hz
  have hall := eventually_all.mpr h
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  exact (a n).fill_cores hR (htR n) hsep (fun x hx => hn ⟨x,hx⟩)
end HoleApprox
