/-- A global graph approximation, with actual small exceptional disks.
All fields will be constructed, not postulated as coloring hypotheses. -/
structure FullApprox (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (α t : ℝ) where
  ε : ℝ
  ε_pos : 0<ε
  ε_lt : ε<t
  disks : Finset MarkedDisk
  positive : ∀d∈disks,0<d.radius
  disjoint : (disks : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
  sum_lt : (∑d∈disks,d.radius)<t
  map : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))
  agrees : ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles disks →
    (map z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val
/-- The whole producer, using actual annular crossing fibers and all angular
contradictions: global graph approximants exist at arbitrarily small exception scales. -/

name: fullApprox_exists_of_finite_core
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsep⟩ := finite_centers_separation L
  let A := activeCenters L
  let R := min (s/4) (min (1/2) (t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))))
  have hR0 : 0<R := lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos ht (by positivity)))
  have hRs : R ≤ s/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hRhalf : R≤1/2 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hRt : R≤t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1)) := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hR1 : R<1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hRhalf (by norm_num)
  have hRsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hh := hsep x hx y hy hxy
    linarith
  have hRbudget : (A.card:ℝ)*R<t/4 := by
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))).mp hRt
    nlinarith
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (R/4) (min (t/4) (1/((n:ℝ)+1)))
  have hu : ∀n,0<u n := fun n => lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have huR : ∀n,2*u n<R := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤R/4 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have hut : ∀n,u n<t := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have hult : ∀n,u n<1/2 := by
    intro n
    have hh := huR n
    linarith
  have hulim : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => (hu n).le) (fun n => (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (u n) := fun n => Classical.choice (holeApprox_exists hc hα hα' L hL (hu n) (hult n))
  obtain ⟨n,F,hF⟩ := ((HoleApprox.eventually_fill_cores hc hw hα hα' a hulim hR0 hR1 huR hRsep).exists)
  let D := centerDisks A R
  have hD : ∀d∈D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    exact ⟨hR0,by simp⟩
  have hU : ∀d∈(a n).disks∪D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hd with hh|hh
    · exact (a n).valid d hh
    · exact hD d hh
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,_⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate ((a n).disks∪D) hU (show 0<t/4 by positivity)
  have htS : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    have hh := disk_radius_sum_union_le (a n).disks D (fun d hd => (hU d hd).1.le)
    have hDbudget : (∑d∈D,d.radius)<t/4 := by rw [centerDisks_sum]; exact hRbudget
    have hun : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith [(a n).sum_lt]
  refine ⟨⟨(a n).ε,(a n).ε_pos,(a n).ε_lt.trans (hut n),S,
    fun d hd => (hS d hd).1,hdis,htS,F,?_⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  have hn : z.val∉diskHoles ((a n).disks∪D) := fun hh => hz ((MarkedDisk.holes_subset_of_cover hcov).1 hh)
  rw [diskHoles_union] at hn
  exact hF z (fun hh => hn (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hn (Or.inr hh))
/-- The finite core used above is obtained from the proved actual transition core
local-finiteness theorem; no regularity of the original coloring is added. -/

    cases a with
    | none => exact (graphRealization_closed T).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some a => exact graphCutStub_closed a.1 a.2
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | none => exact continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutRetract_tree p hp)
    | some a => exact continuous_const.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutStub_retract hp)

name: graphMidpoint_coord_le
proof:
by
  simp only [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> first | contradiction | norm_num

name: graph_dominant_mem_cut
proof:
by
  refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
  intro j k hjk _ he
  have hh := graphMidpoint_coord_le hjk i
  rw [←he] at hh
  linarith

name: graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex
proof:
by
  ext k
  simp only [graphEdgePoint,Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: graphCut_lerp_mem
proof:
by
  rcases graphCut_cover p with hp|⟨i,j,hp⟩
  · rw [graphCutRetract_tree p hp,←add_smul]
    simp
  · have hr := graphCutStub_retract hp
    obtain ⟨hne,hadj,t,ht,he⟩ := hp
    have htm : t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (by
      intro h; exact p.property.2 i j hne hadj (he.symm.trans (by rw [h])))
    rw [hr,←he,graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex]
    have hu0 : 0≤(1-s)*t := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2]) ht.1
    have hu1 : (1-s)*t≤t := mul_le_of_le_one_left ht.1 (by linarith [hs.1])
    have hu : (1-s)*t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu1 htm
    apply graph_dominant_mem_cut (graphEdgePoint_mem (Or.inr (show (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).Adj i j from hne)) ⟨hu0,by linarith⟩) (i := i)
    simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]
    linarith

def graphCutRetraction {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    C(GraphCutSpace T,GraphSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphCutRetract T p,graphCutRetract_mem T p⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphCutRetract T).subtype_mk _
def graphCutInclusion {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : C(GraphSpace T,GraphCutSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨p.val,graphRealization_subset_cut T p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
def graphCutHomotopy {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphCutSpace T)).Homotopy
      ((graphCutInclusion T).comp (graphCutRetraction T)) where
  toFun sp := ⟨(1-sp.1.val) • sp.2.val+sp.1.val • graphCutRetract T sp.2,
    graphCut_lerp_mem T sp.2 sp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).add
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
      ((continuous_graphCutRetract T).comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
  map_one_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp [graphCutInclusion,graphCutRetraction]
/-- Removing the non-tree edge midpoints leaves a contractible graph (tree with half-open stubs). -/

name: graphCut_contractible
proof:
by
  let := graphTree_contractible hT
  have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace T)).comp_left
    (graphCutRetraction T)).comp_right (graphCutInclusion T)
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
  refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphCutHomotopy T⟩ ?_⟩
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha
end EuclideanFiveColor

/-- A compact connected fiber joins both designated boundary sets. -/
def FiberCrosses {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → Y) (A B : Set X) (b : Y) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K⊆f ⁻¹' {b} ∧
    (K∩A).Nonempty ∧ (K∩B).Nonempty

name: fiberCrosses_symm
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hA,hB⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hB,hA⟩

name: compact_fiber_partition
proof:
by
  let F : Set X := f ⁻¹' {b}
  have hF : IsClosed F := isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous
  let : CompactSpace F := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hF.isCompact
  let I : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' A
  let O : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' B
  have hI : IsCompact I := (hA.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hO : IsCompact O := (hB.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hno : ∀x∈I,Disjoint (connectedComponent x) O := by
    intro x hx
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro y hy hOy
    apply hn
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' connectedComponent x,
      isClosed_connectedComponent.isCompact.image continuous_subtype_val,
      isConnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rintro z ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩; exact w.property
    · exact ⟨x.val,⟨⟨x,mem_connectedComponent,rfl⟩,hx⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨y.val,⟨⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hOy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨Z₀,Z₁,hZ₀,hZ₁,hd,hcov,hIZ,hOZ⟩ := compact_component_partition hI hO hno
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' Z₀,Subtype.val '' Z₁,hZ₀.image continuous_subtype_val,
    hZ₁.image continuous_subtype_val,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro x ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ ⟨z,hz,he⟩
    have hh : z=y := Subtype.ext he
    subst z
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hy hz
  · rw [←image_union,hcov]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,_,rfl⟩; exact y.property
    · intro hx; exact ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,mem_univ _,rfl⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hx (hOZ hz)
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd (hIZ hz) hx

/-- All finitely many non-crossing bad fibers can simultaneously be separated,
 with the prescribed inner/outer closed sets on opposite sides. -/

name: finite_fiber_separation
proof:
by
  choose K₀ K₁ hK using (fun b : S => compact_fiber_partition f hA hB b.val (hn b.val b.property))
  let Z₀ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₀ b
  let Z₁ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₁ b
  have hz₀ : IsCompact Z₀ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).1
  have hz₁ : IsCompact Z₁ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).2.1
  have hsub₀ (b : S) : K₀ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_left
  have hsub₁ (b : S) : K₁ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_right
  have h01 : Disjoint Z₀ Z₁ := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    have he : b=c := Subtype.ext ((hsub₀ b hb).symm.trans (hsub₁ c hc))
    subst c
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.1 hb hc
  have h0B : Disjoint Z₀ B := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hB
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.1 hb hB
  have h1A : Disjoint Z₁ A := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hA
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.2 hb hA
  refine ⟨A∪Z₀,B∪Z₁,hA.isCompact.union hz₀,hB.isCompact.union hz₁,?_,subset_union_left,subset_union_left,?_⟩
  · exact disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd,h1A.symm⟩,
      disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨h0B,h01⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    let b : S := ⟨f x,hx⟩
    have hh : x∈K₀ b∪K₁ b := by rw [(hK b).2.2.2.1]; rfl
    rcases hh with hh|hh
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: contractible_patch
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨t,htB,htA,ht⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed hB hA hd.symm
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic D
  let S : Fin 3 → Set X := ![{x | t x≤1/3},{x | 1/3≤t x ∧ t x≤2/3},{x | 2/3≤t x}]
  have hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous).inter
        (isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const)
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous
  have hc : ⋃i,S i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro x
    by_cases h0 : t x≤1/3
    · exact ⟨0,h0⟩
    by_cases h1 : t x≤2/3
    · exact ⟨1,⟨(not_le.mp h0).le,h1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨2,(not_le.mp h1).le⟩
  have hgood (x : S 1) : f x.val∈D := by
    apply hg
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=1 := htA hx
      have hh : t x.val≤2/3 := x.property.2
      linarith
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=0 := htB hx
      have hh : 1/3≤t x.val := x.property.1
      linarith
  have hτmem (x : S 1) : 3*t x.val-1∈unitInterval := by
    constructor
    · linarith [x.property.1]
    · linarith [x.property.2]
  let τ : C(S 1,unitInterval) := ⟨fun x => ⟨3*t x.val-1,hτmem x⟩,
    ((continuous_const.mul (t.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)).sub continuous_const).subtype_mk hτmem⟩
  let φ₁ : C(S 1,Y) := ⟨fun x => (H (τ x,⟨f x.val,hgood x⟩)).val,
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (H.continuous.comp (τ.continuous.prodMk
      ((f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk hgood)))⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(S i,Y) := fun i => Fin.cases (f.restrict (S 0))
    (fun j => Fin.cases φ₁ (fun j => ContinuousMap.const (S j.succ.succ) a.val) j) i
  have h01 (x : X) (h0 : x∈S 0) (h1 : x∈S 1) : φ 0 ⟨x,h0⟩=φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩ := by
    have he : t x=1/3 := le_antisymm h0 h1.1
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=0 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=0; rw [he]; norm_num
    change f x=(H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_zero_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩) |>.symm
  have h12 (x : X) (h1 : x∈S 1) (h2 : x∈S 2) : φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩=φ 2 ⟨x,h2⟩ := by
    have he : t x=2/3 := le_antisymm h1.2 h2
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=1 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=1; rw [he]; norm_num
    change (H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val=a.val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_one_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)
  have hφ : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j),φ i ⟨x,hi⟩=φ j ⟨x,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j x hi hj
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact h01 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hi; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hj; linarith
    · exact (h01 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
    · exact h12 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hj; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hi; linarith
    · exact (h12 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨a,closedCoverMap S hS hc φ hφ,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx2 : x∈S 2 := by change 2/3≤t x; rw [htA hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx2⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx0 : x∈S 0 := by change t x≤1/3; rw [htB hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx0⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mp hc x
    rw [closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hi⟩]
    fin_cases i
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (H (τ ⟨x,hi⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,hi⟩⟩)).property
    · exact Or.inr a.property
end EuclideanFiveColor

open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u v
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Edges whose midpoint fibers contain a compact continuum joining the two boundaries. -/
def crossingGraph {X : Type u} {V : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → V → ℝ) (A B : Set X) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj i j := i≠j ∧ FiberCrosses f A B (graphEdgePoint i j (1/2))
  symm := ⟨by
    intro i j h
    refine ⟨h.1.symm,?_⟩
    have he : graphEdgePoint j i (1/2)=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := by
      convert graphEdgePoint_swap j i (1/2) using 1; norm_num
    rw [he]; exact h.2⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro i h; exact h.1 rfl⟩
/-- If the crossing edges form a forest, the boundary map can be patched to a constant
 on the inner closed set, unchanged on the outer closed set. This replaces the graph-word
 and winding detour for the existential interface-cycle producer. -/

name: graph_forest_patch
proof:
by
  let G := crossingGraph (fun x => (f x).val) A B
  obtain ⟨T,hGT,_,hT⟩ := SimpleGraph.connected_top.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic
    (show G≤⊤ from le_top) hforest
  let f₀ : C(X,V → ℝ) := ⟨fun x => (f x).val,continuous_subtype_val.comp f.continuous⟩
  let S : Finset (V → ℝ) := ((Finset.univ : Finset (V×V)).filter
    (fun a => a.1≠a.2 ∧ ¬T.Adj a.1 a.2)).image (fun a => graphEdgePoint a.1 a.2 (1/2))
  have hn : ∀b∈S,¬FiberCrosses f₀ A B b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,hij,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hij
    intro hh
    exact hij.2 (hGT ⟨hij.1,hh⟩)
  obtain ⟨C₀,C₁,hC₀,hC₁,hCd,hAC,hBC,hSC⟩ := finite_fiber_separation f₀ hA hB hd S hn
  let : ContractibleSpace (GraphCutSpace T) := graphCut_contractible hT
  have hg : ∀x,x∉C₀ → x∉C₁ → f₀ x∈graphCutRealization T := by
    intro x hx₀ hx₁
    refine ⟨(f x).property,?_⟩
    intro i j hij hTij he
    have hm : f₀ x∈S := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i,j),by simp [hij,hTij],he.symm⟩
    rcases hSC hm with hh|hh
    · exact hx₀ hh
    · exact hx₁ hh
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB,hgR⟩ := contractible_patch (graphCutRealization T) f₀ hC₀.isClosed hC₁.isClosed hCd hg
  have hgr (x : X) : g x∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) := by
    rcases hgR x with hh|hh
    · rw [hh]; exact (f x).property
    · exact hh.1
  let g' : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := ⟨fun x => ⟨g x,hgr x⟩,g.continuous.subtype_mk hgr⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a.val,a.property.1⟩,g',?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgA (hAC hx)
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgB (hBC hx)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def planeAnnulus (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall x R \ Metric.ball x r

/-- A forest crossing graph yields an actual extension of the outer boundary over
its disk. This uses compact fiber separation and tree contraction, not graph words. -/

name: annulus_forest_extension
proof:
by
  let : CompactSpace (planeAnnulus x r R) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (planeAnnulus_compact x r R)
  have hA : IsClosed (annulusInner x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hB : IsClosed (annulusOuter x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hd : Disjoint (annulusInner x r R) (annulusOuter x r R) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hz'
    exact hrR.ne (hz.symm.trans hz')
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB⟩ := graph_forest_patch f hA hB hd hforest
  let X := Metric.closedBall x R
  let Z : Bool → Set X := fun b => if b then {z | r≤dist z.val x} else {z | dist z.val x≤r}
  have hZ : ∀b,IsClosed (Z b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact isClosed_le (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const)
  have hcov : ⋃b,Z b=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    rcases le_total (dist z.val x) r with hh|hh
    · exact ⟨false,hh⟩
    · exact ⟨true,hh⟩
  let g₁ : C(Z true,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g ⟨z.val.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.val.property,z.property⟩⟩,
      g.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀b,C(Z b,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun b => Bool.casesOn b (ContinuousMap.const _ a) g₁
  have heq (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z false) (h1 : z∈Z true) : φ false ⟨z,h0⟩=φ true ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    exact (hgA (show (⟨z.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.property,h1⟩⟩ : planeAnnulus x r R)∈annulusInner x r R from
      le_antisymm h0 h1)).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i <;> cases j
    · rfl
    · exact heq z hi hj
    · exact (heq z hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z => ?_⟩
  have hz : (⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ : X)∈Z true := by
    change r≤dist z.val x
    rw [show dist z.val x=R from z.property]
    exact hrR.le
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=true) ⟨⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩,hz⟩]
  exact hgB z.property
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: finite_centers_separation

  have hrle (n) : r n≤ρ := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<(n:ℝ)+1)).mpr (by
    have hn : 0≤(n:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n

      (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=ρ)).mul (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜:=ℝ))

    have hI := hK.intermediate_value (f:=fun z : ℂ => dist z x) hx hy (continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn
    apply hI

  choose q hqK hqr using hq
  let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (q n-x)/(r n : ℂ)

    dsimp [w]
    rw [norm_div,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),←dist_eq_norm,hqr]
    exact div_self (ne_of_gt (hr n))

    simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using hwn n
  obtain ⟨v,hv,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) 1).tendsto_subseq hwm

    dsimp [w]
    have hn : (r (φ n) : ℂ)≠0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hr _))

/-- Standard affine vertices. These are the manuscript's probability-simplex coordinates. -/
def graphVertex {V : Type u} (i : V) : V → ℝ := fun j => if j=i then 1 else 0
/-- Affine parameterization of an edge, including its two vertices. -/
def graphEdgePoint {V : Type u} (i j : V) (t : ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  (1-t) • graphVertex i + t • graphVertex j
/-- The geometric realization of a simple graph in its probability simplex.
The equal-endpoint option includes isolated vertices. -/
def graphRealization {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Set (V → ℝ) :=
  {p | ∃ i j, (i=j ∨ G.Adj i j) ∧ ∃ t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, p=graphEdgePoint i j t}

    obtain ⟨y,hy,hyd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    have hh := congrArg MarkedDisk.core (hxd.trans hyd.symm)
    exact Bool.noConfusion hh
  have hi (r : ℝ) (b : Bool) : Function.Injective (fun x : ℂ => (⟨x,r,b⟩ : MarkedDisk)) := by
    intro x y h; exact congrArg MarkedDisk.center h
  simp only [initialDisks,Finset.sum_union hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h),
      Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h)]
  simp [noncoreCost]

name: initial_core_cover
proof:
by
  exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),rfl,hz⟩

by
  exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,u,false⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),hz⟩

name: holes_subset_of_cover
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,_⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hde hzd⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hzd⟩ := mem_coreHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,hc⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hc hcd,hde hzd⟩

open scoped Classical

open MarkedDisk
/-- Actual small-hole maps on a fixed disk, with arbitrarily small total radii.
The core witnesses lie in the finite actual cyclic core; all other holes have been
filled by genuine tree extensions. -/

name: small_hole_map
proof:
by
  let δ : ℝ := t/(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))
  have hδ : 0<δ := div_pos ht (by positivity)
  have hδeq : δ*(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))=t := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  have hδbudget : (L.card:ℝ)*δ<t/4 := by nlinarith
  let M := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 \ ⋃x∈L,Metric.ball x δ
  have hM : IsCompact M := (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 8).diff
    (isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have hf : ∀x∈M,(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx.2 (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hL x hx.1 hn,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩⟩)
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hcharts⟩ := compact_forest_charts hc hα hα' M hM hf
  let κ := min (t/4) (l/6)
  have hκ : 0<κ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hκt : κ≤t/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hκl : κ≤l/6 := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨e,he,hC⟩ := hcharts κ hκ
  refine ⟨e,he,fun ε hε hεe => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hCr,hCv⟩ := hC ε hε hεe
  let u := α*ε/4
  have hu : 0<u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,hcost⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate
    (initialDisks L C δ u) (initialDisks_valid L C hδ hu) hκ
  have htot : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).1] at hsum
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hnrad : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → 2*d.radius<l := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).2] at hcost
    intro d hd hdf
    have hd' := noncore_radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd hdf
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hcover := holes_subset_of_cover hcov
  have hMof (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8) (hzS : z∉diskHoles S) : z∈M := by
    refine ⟨hz,?_⟩
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxL,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hzS (hcover.1 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,
      mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hxL,rfl⟩),hzx⟩))
  have hmarked (z : ℂ) (hz : z∉diskHoles S) : z∉⋃x∈C,Metric.ball x u := by
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxC,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hz (hcover.1 (initial_marked_cover L C δ u hxC hzx))
  let f : C(ℂ,Fin 5 → ℝ) := ⟨thresholdMap c ε α,continuous_thresholdMap hc hε hα'⟩
  have hg : ∀z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7,z∉diskHoles S →
      f z∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) := by
    intro z hz hzS
    have hzM := hMof z (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num) hz) hzS
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv z hzM
    exact graphRealization_mono le_top (hq z (Metric.mem_ball_self hl) (hmarked z hzS))
  have hb : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → (d.closedBall∩Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7).Nonempty →
      ∃G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5),G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius,
        f z∈graphRealization G := by
    intro d hd hdf hmeet
    have hr := (hS d hd).1
    have hsph (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 := by
      have hzr := sphere_norm_bound hmeet hz
      have hd' := radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd
      change dist z 0≤8
      linarith
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=d.center)).mpr hr.le
    have haM := hMof a (hsph a ha) (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd ha)
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv a haM
    refine ⟨G,hG,fun z hz => hq z ?_ (hmarked z (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd hz))⟩
    have hza : dist z a≤2*d.radius := calc
      dist z a≤dist z d.center+dist d.center a := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = 2*d.radius := by
        have hz' : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
        have ha' : dist d.center a=d.radius := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_comm] using ha
        rw [hz',ha']; ring
    exact hza.trans_lt (hnrad d hd hdf)
  obtain ⟨g,hg'⟩ := fill_noncore_disks (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7) S
    (fun d hd => (hS d hd).1) hdis f hg hb
  exact ⟨S,hS,hdis,htot,g,hg'⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

/-- Exception annuli for exact unit distances from the small closed disks. -/
def diskAnnulus (d : MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) \ Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)
def holeAnnuli (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,diskAnnulus d

name: diskAnnulus_measurable
proof: Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet.diff Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet

name: unit_from_disk_mem_annulus
proof:
by
  have hq' : dist q d.center≤d.radius := hq
  constructor
  · change dist z d.center≤1+d.radius
    exact (dist_triangle z q d.center).trans (by linarith)
  · change ¬ dist z d.center<1-d.radius
    have hh := dist_triangle z d.center q
    rw [dist_comm d.center q,hzq] at hh
    linarith

name: volume_diskAnnulus
proof:
by
  have hsub : Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)⊆Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))
  have hvol (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) : ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (r^2*Real.pi) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg r),ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr]
    congr 1
    rw [←NNReal.coe_real_pi,ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  rw [diskAnnulus,measure_sdiff hsub Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet (by finiteness),
    Complex.volume_closedBall,Complex.volume_ball,hvol _ (by linarith),hvol _ (by linarith),
    ←ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by positivity : 0≤(1-d.radius)^2*Real.pi)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: volume_holeAnnuli_le
proof:
by
  calc
    volume (holeAnnuli S)≤∑d∈S,volume (diskAnnulus d) := measure_biUnion_finset_le S _
    _ = ∑d∈S,ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact volume_diskAnnulus (hS d hd).1 (hS d hd).2
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑d∈S,4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun d hd => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hS d hd).1)]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S,d.radius)) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: unit_from_hole_mem_annuli
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hqd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hq
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨d,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hd,unit_from_disk_mem_annulus (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hqd) hzq⟩⟩

name: holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero
proof:
by
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(∑d∈S n,d.radius)≤1 :=
    hlim.eventually (eventually_le_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,volume (holeAnnuli (S n))≤ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius)) := by
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with n hn
    apply volume_holeAnnuli_le
    exact fun d hd => ⟨hS n d hd,(MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum (hS n) hd).trans hn⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hlim.const_mul (4*Real.pi))
  apply ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mpr
  intro a ha
  filter_upwards [hbound,ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mp ht a ha] with n hn hn'
  exact hn.trans hn'
end EuclideanFiveColor

    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [a.sum_lt]) (hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd))⟩⟩

name: four_interface_compatible
proof:
by
  classical
  let E (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 4) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex := finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K fourEdge hH
  have hJ (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
      ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E s b,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈interfaceFourAllowed s b := by
    filter_upwards [hex] with z hz hzE
    simp only [interfaceFourAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (hzE i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩))
  have hout (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_outer_restriction c hc (E s true) hK (hJ s true)
  have hin (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_inner_restriction c hc (E s false) hK (hJ s false)

    palette_cardinality c hc hw x,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))]
    with t ho hi hp hcard hn
  refine ⟨hp,hcard.2,ho (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_,hi (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact of_decide_eq_true (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  · intro i hi
    have hn' : ¬0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ := of_decide_eq_false (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn') (hn i)

proof:
by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fourState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg] with t ht hts

  exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp (ht (by simpa only [hts] using hi))

    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd he

name: four_state_diagonal_positive_of_group
proof:
by
  by_contra! hn
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠s :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 ∧ r≠s ∧ ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=r := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠0 ∧ (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠s ∧
      ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=(if s=1 then 2 else 1) from by decide) s hs
  let f : Angles → Bool := fun t => if fourState c hc x t=0 then false else true
  have hf : Measurable f := Measurable.ite
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hrep (v : Bool) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | f (t : Angles)=v} (if v then fourGroup r else fourGroup 0) := by
    refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg,angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot]
      with t ht htn htv
    change f (t : Angles)=v at htv
    apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp
    apply ht
    cases v
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by simpa [f] using htv
      simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using hi
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=r := hr.2.2 _ (by simpa [f] using htv) htn
      simpa only [hz,ite_true] using hi
  have hcard : (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup r)).card≤2 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1))).card≤2 from by decide) s hs
  apply two_state_impossible hc hw x (fourGroup 0) (fourGroup r) hcard f hf (hrep false) (hrep true)
  filter_upwards [hnot,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot,
      four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg] with t ht hu hne
  exact three_exclude_flip _ _ s hs ht hu hne

by
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht hn
  have ho : 4∉palette c hc x t := by
    intro ho
    exact hn (by simp only [fourState,fourCanonical,ho,ite_true])

/-- Every point of an angular essential support has a real essential-support lift.
The compact fundamental domain is used only to establish the support inclusion. -/

name: angle_support_lift
proof:
by
  let B : Set ℝ := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A
  let S : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict B).support∩Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)
  let F : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' S
  have hm : Continuous ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) := AddCircle.continuous_mk' _
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_Icc.inter_left Measure.isClosed_support
  have hF : IsClosed F := (hS.image hm).isClosed
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂((volume : Measure Angles).restrict A),t∈F := by
    rw [← (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).map_eq,
      Measure.restrict_map hm.measurable hA]
    apply (ae_map_iff hm.measurable.aemeasurable hF.measurableSet).mpr
    have hs : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈(volume.restrict B).support := by
      apply ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self B)
      exact Measure.support_mem_ae
    have hi : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi) :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc)
    filter_upwards [hs,hi] with b hb hib

name: four_interface_word_data
proof:
by
  have hg := four_state_group_of_admissible hc (four_interface_admissible hc hcompat)
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hmargin⟩ := interfaceStateSupport_margin hc hw hg
  let Q (t : Angles) : Prop := (∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) ∧
    (fourState c hc x t≠0 → fourState c hc x t=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)) ∧
    fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) ∧
    ∀s : Fin 3,fourState c hc x t=s → t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s
  have hQ : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,Q t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i)),
      four_interface_state_rule hc hcompat,four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg,
      interfaceStateSupport_ae hc x] with t hn hr hs hF
    exact ⟨hn,fun h => (hr h).2,hs,hF⟩
  let G : Set Angles := {t | ∀j : Fin 6,Q (t+sixAngle j)}
  have hGae : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈G := ae_all_iff.mpr fun j =>
    (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixAngle j)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hQ
  have hGshift : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G := by
    intro t ht j
    have he : t+(sixty : Angles)+sixAngle j=t+sixAngle (j+1) := by
      rw [sixAngle_step]
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact ht (j+1)
  refine ⟨G,Measure.dense_of_ae hGae,hGshift,fun t ht j => (ht j).1,fun t ht j => (ht j).2.1,?_,ε,hε,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro j
      simpa only [fourInterfaceWord,sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using (ht j).2.2.1
    · intro j hj hj3
      dsimp only [fourInterfaceWord]
      rw [(ht (j+3)).2.1 hj3,(ht j).2.1 hj]
      exact four_diagonal_orbit_half (ht j).1
  · intro t ht u hu htu j hj
    have hm := hmargin (fourInterfaceWord hc x t j) hj (t+sixAngle j)
      ((ht j).2.2.2 _ rfl) (u+sixAngle j) (by simpa only [dist_add_right] using htu)
    constructor
    · intro he
      apply hm.1
      have hh := (hu (j+1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using hh
    · intro he
      apply hm.2
      have hh := (hu (j-1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_prev,add_sub_assoc] using hh

proof:

  have hpar (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) := four_word_parity (w t) (hw t ht) (hnomix t ht)
  let p : Angles → Fin 2 := fun t => if ht : t∈G then (hpar t ht).choose else 0
  have hp (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) : ∀j,w t j=0 → j.val%2=(p t).val := by
    simpa only [p,dite_eq_left ht] using (hpar t ht).choose_spec
  have hclose (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) (u : Angles) (hu : u∈G) (htu : dist t u<ε) : p t=p u := by
    by_contra hne
    have hcases : (p t=0 ∧ p u=1) ∨ (p t=1 ∧ p u=0) :=
      (show ∀a b : Fin 2,a≠b → (a=0 ∧ b=1) ∨ (a=1 ∧ b=0) from by decide) _ _ hne
    rcases hcases with ⟨hpt,hpu⟩|⟨hpt,hpu⟩
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw t ht) (hw u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_zero] using hp t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_one] using hp u hu)
        (hcross t ht u hu htu) (hn t ht) (hn u hu) (hd t ht) (hd u hu)
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw u hu) (hw t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_zero] using hp u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_one] using hp t ht)
        (hcross u hu t ht (by simpa only [dist_comm] using htu))
        (hn u hu) (hn t ht) (hd u hu) (hd t ht)
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hG.nonempty
  have hconst : ∀u∈G,p u=p t := by
    apply dense_isolated_value_constant hG p hε ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩

  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := four_word_has_outsider (w (t+(sixty : Angles))) (hw _ (hshiftG t ht))
  have hh := four_word_shift_parity (w t) (p t) (hp t ht) j

  have hh' := hp _ (hshiftG t ht) j hj
  rw [hconst _ (hshiftG t ht)] at hh'
  have he : (p t).val=(p t+1).val := hh'.symm.trans hh
  exact (show ∀a : Fin 2,a.val≠(a+1).val from by decide) (p t) he

sets of macroscopic diameter at every shrinking scale. This is the manuscript
mesh argument, with connectedness replacing the stronger path assumption. -/

name: no_large_positive_sequence
proof:
by
  choose K hK hsub hprob x hx y hy hxy using hbad
  have hxy' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (x n) (y n) := by linarith [htsmall n,hxy n]
  have hyx' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (y n) (x n) := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hxy' n
  choose a haK haH hax using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hx n) (hy n) (hxy' n)
  choose b hbK hbH hby using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hy n) (hx n) (hyx' n)
  have hab (n : ℕ) : 3/2≤dist (a n) (b n) := by
    have h1 := dist_triangle (x n) (a n) (y n)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (a n) (b n) (y n)
    rw [dist_comm (b n) (y n)] at h2
    linarith [hxy n,hax n,hby n,htsmall n]
  obtain ⟨p,hp,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5).prod
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5)).tendsto_subseq (x := fun n => (a n,b n)) (fun n => ⟨hsub n (haK n),hsub n (hbK n)⟩)
  have halim : Tendsto (fun n => a (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hblim : Tendsto (fun n => b (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hpdist : 3/2≤dist p.1 p.2 := ge_of_tendsto (halim.dist hblim) (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hab (φ n)))
  have hεlim := (ε_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hE := (annuli_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hasup : p.1∈spatialSupport c i := support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit hc hεlim halim i
    (fun n => hα.trans (positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨a (φ n),hsub _ (haK _)⟩
      (haH _) (hprob _ _ (haK _))))
  have hexc : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Metric.ball p.1 (1/8)) := by
    apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hεlim (fun n => (F (φ n)).ε_pos) hE hα Metric.isOpen_ball i
    intro z hz
    have hane : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (a (φ n)) p.1<1/8 :=
      halim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    have hbne : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (b (φ n)) p.2<1/8 :=
      hblim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    filter_upwards [hane,hbne] with n han hbn hzE
    have hza : dist z (a (φ n))<1 := by
      have hh := dist_triangle z p.1 (a (φ n))
      rw [dist_comm p.1 (a (φ n))] at hh
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    have hzb : 1<dist z (b (φ n)) := by
      have h1 := dist_triangle p.1 z p.2
      have h2 := dist_triangle z (b (φ n)) p.2
      rw [dist_comm p.1 z] at h1
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hK (φ n))
      ⟨a (φ n),haK _,b (φ n),hbK _,hza,hzb⟩
    have hqH : q∉diskHoles (F (φ n)).disks := fun hh => hzE (unit_from_hole_mem_annuli hh hunit)
    have hqprob := positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨q,hsub _ hq⟩ hqH (hprob _ _ hq)
    have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
    have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (F (φ n)).ε_pos hu i
    change diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i z≤1-α
    change α<diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i q at hqprob
    linarith
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hexc hasup (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))

name: polynomial_region_angles
proof:
by
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  let p : ℝ := z.arg
  let d : ℝ := Real.arccos (r/2)
  have hr2 : r^2=z.re^2+z.im^2 := by
    change ‖z‖^2=_
    rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hr0 : 0<r := by
    have hn : 0≤r := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith [hz.1]
  have hrlt : r<2 := by nlinarith [hz.2.1]
  have hdcos : Real.cos d=r/2 := Real.cos_arccos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hd0 : 0<d := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hdlt : d<Real.pi/2 := Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (by positivity)
  have hdsin : 0<Real.sin d := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hd0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hdsq : Real.sin d^2=1-r^2/4 := by
    have hh := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq d
    rw [hdcos] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hdp : Real.sin (3*d)=Real.sin d*(r^2-1) := by
    rw [sin_three_using_cos,hdcos]; ring
  have hpysin : r*Real.sin p=z.im := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  have hpxcos : r*Real.cos p=z.re := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have hpy : r^3*Real.sin (3*p)=z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_three_mul]
    calc _ = 3*r^2*(r*Real.sin p)-4*(r*Real.sin p)^3 := by ring
         _ = _ := by rw [hr2,hpysin]; ring
  have hP : z.im^2*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2)^2=r^6*Real.sin (3*p)^2 := by
    calc _ = (z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2))^2 := by ring
         _ = (r^3*Real.sin (3*p))^2 := by rw [hpy]
         _ = _ := by ring
  have hP' : (z.re^2+z.im^2)^3*(1-(z.re^2+z.im^2)/4)*(z.re^2+z.im^2-1)^2=
      r^6*Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    rw [←hr2,hdp]
    rw [show 1-r^2/4=Real.sin d^2 from hdsq.symm]
    ring
  have hlt : Real.sin (3*p)^2<Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    have hh := hz.2.2
    rw [hP,hP'] at hh
    exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos hr0 6)).mp hh
  refine ⟨p-d,p+d,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.add_re,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        sub_zero,zero_mul,add_zero]
      rw [Real.cos_sub,Real.cos_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
    · simp only [Complex.add_im,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        mul_one,add_zero,zero_add]
      rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
  · rw [show p+d-(p-d)=2*d by ring,Real.sin_two_mul,hdcos]
    exact ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  · rw [mul_sub,mul_add,sin_sub_add_product]
    linarith

name: not_proper_five_coloring_compl_null
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hsingle : ∀ x : ℂ, volume ((fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have heq : (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z = (fun w : ℂ => w + x) ⁻¹' Z := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; simpa using hz
      · intro h; exact ⟨w + x, h, by ring⟩
    rw [heq, measure_preimage_add_right]
    exact hZ
  have hfin : ∀ F : Finset ℂ, ∃ d : ℂ → Fin 5,
      ∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, ‖x - y‖ = 1 → d x ≠ d y := by
    intro F
    have hbad : volume (⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) = 0 := by
      induction F using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        rw [Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert]
        exact measure_union_null (hsingle a) ih
    have hne : (⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z) ≠ Set.univ := by
      intro hall
      have hzero : volume (Set.univ : Set ℂ) = 0 := by rw [← hall]; exact hbad
      have hpos : 0 < volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := Metric.measure_ball_pos volume 0 zero_lt_one
      have hle : volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) ≤ volume (Set.univ : Set ℂ) :=
        measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
      rw [hzero] at hle
      exact hpos.ne' (le_antisymm hle (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, v ∉ ⋃ x ∈ (F : Set ℂ), (fun z : ℂ => z - x) '' Z := by
      by_contra h
      exact hne (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun v => by by_contra hv; exact h ⟨v, hv⟩)
    refine ⟨fun x => c (x + v), ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxZ : x + v ∉ Z := by
      intro hmem
      exact hv (Set.mem_biUnion hx ⟨x + v, hmem, by ring⟩)
    have hyZ : y + v ∉ Z := by
      intro hmem
      exact hv (Set.mem_biUnion hy ⟨y + v, hmem, by ring⟩)
    exact hc (x + v) hxZ (y + v) hyZ (by simpa only [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hxy)
  exact no_proper_five_coloring (exists_properColoring_of_finset hfin)

end EuclideanFiveColor

name: weak_strong_disjoint
proof:
by
  have hgi : Integrable g (μ.prod ν) := Integrable.of_bound hg.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hgb p).1]; exact (hgb p).2)
  have hFi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => F n p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (((hF n).comp measurable_fst).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      change ‖F n p.1*g p‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hFb n p.1).1 (hgb p).1)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 (hFb n p.1).2).trans (hgb p).2
  have hbi : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => b p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hb.comp measurable_fst).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hbb] with p hp
    change ‖b p.1*g p‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 hp.2).trans (hgb p).2
  have herr (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p => ‖G n p-g p‖) (μ.prod ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hG n).sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ G n p-g p ∧ G n p-g p ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hGb n p).1,(hGb n p).2,(hgb p).1,(hgb p).2]
  have hi0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg fun p => mul_nonneg (hFb n p.1).1 (hgb p).1) _ hs
    intro n
    apply integral_mono_ae (hFi n) (herr n)
    filter_upwards [hz n] with p hp
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      F n p.1*g p = F n p.1*(g p-G n p) := by rw [mul_sub,hp,sub_zero]
      _ ≤ |g p-G n p| := by
        calc
          _ ≤ F n p.1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (hFb n p.1).1
          _ ≤ 1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFb n p.1).2 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := one_mul _
      _ = |G n p-g p| := abs_sub_comm _ _
  let v : X → ℝ := fun x => ∫ y, g (x,y) ∂ν
  have hvi : Integrable v μ := hgi.integral_prod_left
  have hlim := hw v hvi
  have hconvert (f : X → ℝ) (hi : Integrable (fun p : X × Y => f p.1*g p) (μ.prod ν)) :
      (∫ p, f p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) = ∫ x, f x*v x ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_prod _ hi]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
      exact integral_const_mul (f x) (fun y => g (x,y))
  have he0 : (∫ p, b p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν)=0 := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ p, b p.1*g p ∂μ.prod ν)) := by
      simpa only [hconvert b hbi,hconvert (F _) (hFi _)] using hlim
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht hi0
  exact (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    ((Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hbb).mono fun p hp => mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1) hbi).mp he0
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: volume_image_bound
proof:

  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ × ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image

name: circleSum_one_lipschitz
proof:
by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro a b
  have h₁ := realDirection_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a.1 b.1
  have h₂ := realDirection_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a.2 b.2
  have h := dist_add_add_le (Real.cos a.1,Real.sin a.1) (Real.cos a.2,Real.sin a.2)

  have he (p : RealPlane) : circleSum 1 p =
      (Real.cos p.1,Real.sin p.1)+(Real.cos p.2,Real.sin p.2) := by simp [circleSum]
  rw [he a,he b]
  norm_num only [NNReal.coe_ofNat,NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] at *
  have ha : dist a.1 b.1 ≤ dist a b := by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hb : dist a.2 b.2 ≤ dist a b := by rw [Prod.dist_eq]; exact le_max_right _ _

name: circleSum_densityZero
proof:
by
  let F : RealPlane → RealPlane := fun q => x+circleSum 1 q
  have hreg : (1 : ℝ)*Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [one_mul] using hu
  obtain ⟨s,hso,hps,K,hK⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) hreg
  have ha : AntilipschitzWith (K+1) (s.domRestrict F) := by
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro a b
    have h := hK.le_mul_dist a b
    simp only [domRestrict] at h
    simp only [domRestrict,F,dist_add_left,NNReal.coe_add,NNReal.coe_one]
    nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := circleSum 1 a.1) (y := circleSum 1 b.1)]
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) hreg
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt F (L : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) (t,u) :=
    (circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).const_add x
  have him : F '' s ∈ 𝓝 (F (t,u)) := by
    rw [← hd.map_nhds_eq_of_equiv]
    exact image_mem_map (hso.mem_nhds hps)
  have hl : LipschitzWith 2 F := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun a b => by
    simpa only [F,dist_add_left] using circleSum_one_lipschitz.dist_le_mul a b
  apply (flatDensityZero_prod hD).transport hps him
    (show LipschitzWith 2 (s.domRestrict F) from fun a b => hl a.1 b.1) ha (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hAD] with q hq
  rintro ⟨hm,_⟩
  exact ⟨hq hm,mem_univ _⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => zero_le) ?_

  have hp : 0 < r := hr
  let B := Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm ⁻¹' A ∩ Metric.closedBall (Complex.equivRealProdCLM z) r

  have hfin : (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) B ≠ ⊤ :=

name: weak_strong_disjoint_single
proof:
by
  have hgi : Integrable g (μ) := Integrable.of_bound hg.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hgb p).1]; exact (hgb p).2)
  have hFi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p : X => F n p*g p) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hF n).mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      change ‖F n p*g p‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hFb n p).1 (hgb p).1)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 (hFb n p).2).trans (hgb p).2
  have hbi : Integrable (fun p : X => b p*g p) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hb.mul hg).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards [hbb] with p hp
    change ‖b p*g p‖ ≤ 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hgb p).1 hp.2).trans (hgb p).2
  have herr (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun p => ‖G n p-g p‖) (μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound ((hG n).sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ G n p-g p ∧ G n p-g p ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hGb n p).1,(hGb n p).2,(hgb p).1,(hgb p).2]
  have hi0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, F n p*g p ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun n => integral_nonneg fun p => mul_nonneg (hFb n p).1 (hgb p).1) _ hs
    intro n
    apply integral_mono_ae (hFi n) (herr n)
    filter_upwards [hz n] with p hp
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      F n p*g p = F n p*(g p-G n p) := by rw [mul_sub,hp,sub_zero]
      _ ≤ |g p-G n p| := by
        calc
          _ ≤ F n p*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (hFb n p).1
          _ ≤ 1*|g p-G n p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFb n p).2 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := one_mul _
      _ = |G n p-g p| := abs_sub_comm _ _
  have he0 : (∫ p, b p*g p ∂μ)=0 := tendsto_nhds_unique (hw g hgi) hi0
  exact (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    (hbb.mono fun p hp => mul_nonneg hp.1 (hgb p).1) hbi).mp he0

name: weak_strong_disjoint_single_eventual

by

  exact weak_strong_disjoint_single (fun n => hF (n+N)) hb (fun n => hG (n+N)) hg
    (fun n => hFb (n+N)) hbb (fun n => hGb (n+N)) hgb
    (fun v hv => (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr (hw v hv))
    ((tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mpr hs) (fun n => hN _ (Nat.le_add_left N n))

      α^2/4 ≤ diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
    intro z hz q hq
    have hp (a : Fin k) (ha : α<diskAverage c ε a z) : α/2≤diskAverage c ε a q := by
      have hh := (diskAverage_lipschitz hc hε a).dist_le_mul q z
      change |diskAverage c ε a q-diskAverage c ε a z|≤(4/ε)*dist q z at hh
      have hh' := (abs_le.mp hh).1
      have hd : dist q z<ρ/2 := hq
      have hmul : (4/ε)*dist q z<α/2 := by
        calc (4/ε)*dist q z < (4/ε)*(ρ/2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd (by positivity)
          _ = α/4 := by dsimp [ρ]; field_simp; ring
          _ < α/2 := by linarith
      linarith
    have hi := hp i (hCA hz).2.1
    have hj := hp j (hCA hz).2.2
    calc α^2/4 = (α/2)*(α/2) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hi hj (by positivity) (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q)
  have hdj : (↑C : Set ℂ).Pairwise (Disjoint on fun z => Metric.ball z (ρ/2)) := by
    intro z hz w hw hne
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro q hq hq'
    have hh := dist_triangle z q w
    have h₁ : dist q z<ρ/2 := hq
    have h₂ : dist q w<ρ/2 := hq'
    rw [dist_comm z q] at hh
    linarith [hsep hz hw hne]
  have hint : (C.card:ℝ)*(Real.pi*(ρ/2)^2*(α^2/4)) ≤
      ∫ q in Metric.ball x r, diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
    calc (C.card:ℝ)*(Real.pi*(ρ/2)^2*(α^2/4)) =
        ∑ z∈C, ∫ _q in Metric.ball z (ρ/2), (α^2/4) := by
          simp only [setIntegral_const,smul_eq_mul,volumeReal_ball _ (by positivity : 0≤ρ/2)]
          simp
      _ ≤ ∑ z∈C, ∫ q in Metric.ball z (ρ/2), diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro z hz
        apply setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_const (ball_ne_top z (ρ/2)))
          (diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j z (ρ/2)) measurableSet_ball
        exact hlow z hz
      _ = ∫ q in ⋃ z∈C, Metric.ball z (ρ/2), diskAverage c ε i q*diskAverage c ε j q := by
        exact (integral_biUnion_finset C (fun _ _ => measurableSet_ball) hdj
          (fun z _ => diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j z (ρ/2))).symm
      _ ≤ _ := setIntegral_mono_set (diskAverage_product_integrable hc hε i j x r)
        (Eventually.of_forall fun q => mul_nonneg (diskAverage_nonneg c ε i q) (diskAverage_nonneg c ε j q))
        (Eventually.of_forall (fun q hq => by
          obtain ⟨z,hz,hq⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hq
          exact hsub z hz hq))
  refine ⟨C,?_,?_⟩
  · intro q hq hi hj
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hd⟩ := hcover q ⟨hq,hi,hj⟩
    refine ⟨z,hz,?_⟩
    change dist q z<α*ε/4
    dsimp [ρ] at hd
    nlinarith [mul_pos hα hε]
  · have hconst : 0<Real.pi*α^3 := by positivity
    rw [← mul_div_assoc (256/(Real.pi*α^3)) _ ε]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hconst).mpr
    dsimp [ρ] at hint
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: hit_center
proof:
by
  by_contra hn
  have hzero : 0 ∉ (fun z => F z-y) '' Metric.ball y 4 := by
    rintro ⟨z,hz,he⟩
    apply hn
    exact ⟨z,hz,sub_eq_zero.mp he⟩
  obtain ⟨L,hLc,hL⟩ := Complex.exists_continuousOn_eqOn_exp_comp
    (ball_simplyConnected y (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4)) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (hc.sub continuousOn_const) hzero
  let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (t*Complex.I)
  have ec : Continuous e := by fun_prop
  have en (t : ℝ) : ‖e t‖ = 1 := by simp [e,Complex.norm_exp]
  let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => y+3*e t
  have γc : Continuous γ := by fun_prop
  have γmem (t : ℝ) : γ t ∈ Metric.ball y 4 := by
    norm_num [γ,Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm,en]
  let H : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (F (γ t)-y) / e t
  have Hc : Continuous H := (hc.comp_continuous γc γmem).sub continuous_const |>.div ec (fun t => Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have Hnear (t : ℝ) : ‖H t-3‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have he : e t ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have h : H t-3 = (F (γ t)-γ t)/e t := by dsimp [H,γ]; field_simp; ring
    rw [h,norm_div,en,div_one]
    exact hb _ (γmem t)
  have Hpos (t : ℝ) : 0 < (H t).re := by
    have : |(H t-3).re| ≤ 2 := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (H t-3)).trans (Hnear t)
    have := (abs_le.mp this).1
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  have Hslit (t : ℝ) : H t ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Or.inl (Hpos t)
  have logHc : Continuous (fun t => Complex.log (H t)) :=
    Hc.clog Hslit
  let d : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => L (γ t) - Complex.log (H t) - t*Complex.I
  have dc : Continuous d := ((hLc.comp_continuous γc γmem).sub logHc).sub (by fun_prop)
  have de (t : ℝ) : Complex.exp (d t) = 1 := by
    have hH : H t ≠ 0 := fun hz => by have := Hpos t; simp [hz] at this
    have hLe : Complex.exp (L (γ t)) = F (γ t)-y := hL (γmem t)
    simp only [d,Complex.exp_sub,Complex.exp_log hH,hLe]
    change (F (γ t)-y) / ((F (γ t)-y)/e t) / e t = 1
    have hF : F (γ t)-y ≠ 0 := fun hz => hzero ⟨_,γmem t,hz⟩
    have he : e t ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    field_simp
  have hconst : d 0 = d (2*Real.pi) :=
    Complex.isCoveringMap_exp.constOn_of_comp isPreconnected_univ dc.continuousOn
      (fun a _ b _ => Subtype.ext ((de a).trans (de b).symm)) (mem_univ _) (mem_univ _)
  have e0 : e 0 = 1 := by simp [e]
  have e2 : e (2*Real.pi) = 1 := by simp [e,Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I]
  have γeq : γ (2*Real.pi) = γ 0 := by dsimp [γ]; rw [e0,e2]
  have Heq : H (2*Real.pi) = H 0 := by dsimp [H]; rw [γeq,e0,e2]
  dsimp [d] at hconst
  rw [γeq,Heq] at hconst
  have hi := congrArg Complex.im hconst
  norm_num at hi
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
end PlanarCover

name: finite_partition_impossible
proof:
by
  classical
  let F : Q → ℂ := fun z => ∑ i,w i z • p i
  have Fc : Continuous F := by fun_prop
  have Fb (z : Q) : ‖F z-z.val‖≤2 := by
    have he : F z-z.val=∑ i,w i z • (p i-z.val) := by
      simp only [smul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.sum_smul,hs,one_smul,F]
    rw [he]
    calc
      ‖∑ i,w i z • (p i-z.val)‖ ≤ ∑ i,‖w i z • (p i-z.val)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i,w i z*2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        by_cases hi : w i z=0
        · simp [hi]
        · rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hn i z)]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hd i z hi) (hn i z)
      _ = 2 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hs]; ring
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0:ℂ) 1 ⊆ Set.range F := by
    intro y hy
    apply hit_center_subtype (F := F) ?_ Fc Fb
    intro z hz
    apply hQ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] at hy ⊢
    have hh := norm_add_le (z-y) y
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at hh
    have hz' : ‖z-y‖<4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hz
    exact hh.trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hnull : volume (⋃ a, ⋃ b, (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ))=0 :=
    measure_iUnion_null fun a => measure_iUnion_null fun b => affinePair_null _ _
  have hfsub : Set.range F ⊆ ⋃ a, ⋃ b, (affineSpan ℝ ({p a,p b} : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ) := by
    rintro _ ⟨z,rfl⟩
    exact barycenter_two p (fun i => w i z) (fun i => hn i z) (hs z) (hm z)
  have hz := measure_mono_null (hsub.trans hfsub) hnull
  exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))).ne' hz
end PlanarCover

    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun h => by
        by_cases hh : ‖h‖<δ
        · exact (hshift h hh).mono fun q hq _ => hq
        · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ hh' => (hh hh').elim
    · have hx : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | ‖z.1‖<δ} := measurableSet_lt measurable_fst.norm measurable_const
      have hy : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | z.2∈Metric.ball p r} := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.preimage measurable_snd
      have hz : MeasurableSet {z : ℂ × ℂ | c (z.2+z.1)=c z.2} :=
        measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp (measurable_snd.add measurable_fst)) (hc.comp measurable_snd)
      exact hx.imp (hy.imp hz)
  have hd := (measurePreserving_sub_prod (volume : Measure ℂ) volume).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hpair
  have he : ∀ᵐz : ℂ × ℂ∂volume.prod volume,
      z.1∈Metric.ball p s → z.2∈Metric.ball p s → c z.1=c z.2 := by
    filter_upwards [hd] with z hz h1 h2
    have hdist : ‖z.1-z.2‖<δ := by
      rw [←dist_eq_norm]
      have h := dist_triangle z.1 p z.2
      have h2' : dist p z.2<s := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using h2
      have h1' : dist z.1 p<s := h1
      linarith
    have hh := hz hdist (Metric.ball_subset_ball hsr h2)
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hh
  have hae := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod he
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqae⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae
    (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume p hs).ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae hae)
  refine ⟨s,hs,hsr,c q,?_⟩
  exact hqae.mono fun z hz hzs => (hz hq hzs).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: binary_two_edges

name: ae_translated_unit_pair
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u:=b-a) (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hab)
  have hh := (measurePreserving_add_right volume a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (weak_all_directions c hc hw t)
  filter_upwards [hh] with q hq
  simpa only [ht,show q+a+(b-a)=q+b by ring] using hq
/-- Local essential constancy inside two-color open regions, from the source's
actual four-edge paths. The directions are genuine unit directions landing in V. -/

name: binary_open_local_rigidity
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,δ,hδ,hinside⟩ := evenPath_local hU hV hp hpv hpw
  have hshift (h : ℂ) (hh : ‖h‖<δ) :
      ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈Metric.ball p r → c (q+h)=c q := by
    have hsmall := hinside p h (Metric.mem_ball_self hr) hh
    have hedges := evenPath_edges hv hw' hd hsmall.1 hsmall.2.1
    have hcm (i : Fin 5) := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (evenPath v w h i)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hUc.and hVc)
    have hne (i : Fin 4) := ae_translated_unit_pair hc hw (hedges i)
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hcm,ae_all_iff.mpr hne] with q hqc hqp hq
    have hi := (hinside q h hq hh).2.2
    have hcol (i : Fin 5) : c (q+evenPath v w h i)=a ∨ c (q+evenPath v w h i)=b := by
      have hii := hi i
      by_cases he : i.val%2=0
      · exact (hqc i).1 (by simpa only [he,ite_true] using hii)
      · exact (hqc i).2 (by simpa only [he,ite_false] using hii)
    have he02 := binary_two_edges (hcol 0) (hcol 1) (hcol 2) (hqp 0) (hqp 1)
    have he24 := binary_two_edges (hcol 2) (hcol 3) (hcol 4) (hqp 2) (hqp 3)
    change c (q+0)=c (q+evenPath v w h 2) at he02
    change c (q+evenPath v w h 2)=c (q+h) at he24
    simpa only [add_zero] using (he02.trans he24).symm
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_,i,hi⟩ := local_ae_translation_constant c hc hr hδ hshift
  exact ⟨s,hs,i,hi⟩

name: transverseDet_mul_unit
proof:
by
  have hh : v.re^2+v.im^2=1 := by
    calc
      v.re^2+v.im^2 = ‖v‖^2 := by rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hv]; norm_num
  calc
    transverseDet v (z*v) = (v.re^2+v.im^2)*z.im := by
      simp only [transverseDet,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im]
      ring
    _ = z.im := by rw [hh,one_mul]
/-- An open set meeting a unit circle contains two nonparallel unit directions
from its center. No regularity of the color classes is involved. -/

name: open_two_unit_directions
proof:
by
  have ht : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => p+(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v) := by fun_prop
  have hm : (fun t : ℝ => p+(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v) ⁻¹' V∈𝓝 0 := by
    apply ht.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    simpa only [Circle.exp_zero,Circle.coe_one,one_mul] using hV.mem_nhds hpv
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hm

  have hp := Real.pi_pos
  have hmin : 0 < min δ Real.pi := lt_min hδ hp
  have htp : 0<t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have htd : t<δ := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_left δ Real.pi]
  have htπ : t<Real.pi := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_right δ Real.pi]
  refine ⟨(Circle.exp t : ℂ)*v,hd ?_,by rw [norm_mul,Circle.norm_coe,hv,one_mul],?_⟩
  · simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos htp] using htd
  · rw [transverseDet_mul_unit hv]
    simpa [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin] using
      (ne_of_gt (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi htp htπ))

name: double_cos_circle
proof:
by
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp only [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,
      Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.sub_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.one_re,Complex.one_im,Complex.re_ofNat,Complex.im_ofNat,
      Real.cos_two_mul,Real.sin_two_mul] <;> ring
/-- The unit circle from one endpoint penetrates either prescribed radial side
near its equilateral neighbor. This is the constructive version of the source IFT step. -/

name: radial_unit_contact
proof:
by
  let a : ℝ := Real.pi/3
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2*Real.cos t
  let E : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)
  have hr : Continuous r := by fun_prop
  have hE : Continuous E := by fun_prop
  have hra : r a=1 := by norm_num [r,a,Real.cos_pi_div_three]
  have ha : 0<a ∧ a<Real.pi := by dsimp [a]; constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hn : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,0<r t ∧ |r t-1|<δ ∧ dist (E t) (E a)<δ ∧ 0<t ∧ t<Real.pi := by
    have h₁ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,0<r t := continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hr.continuousAt (by rw [hra]; norm_num)
    have h₂ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,|r t-1|<δ :=
      (hr.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa only [Pi.sub_apply,hra,sub_self,abs_zero] using hδ)
    have h₃ : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝 a,dist (E t) (E a)<δ :=
      (hE.dist continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa only [dist_self] using hδ)
    exact h₁.and (h₂.and (h₃.and ((eventually_gt_nhds ha.1).and (eventually_lt_nhds ha.2))))
  have hex : ∃t,(0<r t ∧ |r t-1|<δ ∧ dist (E t) (E a)<δ) ∧ (if b then 1<r t else r t<1) := by
    cases b
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,hat⟩ := ((hn.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and
          (self_mem_nhdsWithin : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝[>] a,t∈Ioi a)).exists
      refine ⟨t,⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,ht.2.2.1⟩,?_⟩
      have hc := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ha.1.le ht.2.2.2.2.le hat
      dsimp [r]
      have hh : 2*Real.cos a=1 := hra
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,hta⟩ := ((hn.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and
          (self_mem_nhdsWithin : ∀ᶠt in 𝓝[<] a,t∈Iio a)).exists
      refine ⟨t,⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,ht.2.2.1⟩,?_⟩
      have hc := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht.2.2.2.1.le ha.2.le hta
      dsimp [r]
      have hh : 2*Real.cos a=1 := hra
      linarith
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hside⟩ := hex
  have hEt : ‖E t‖=1 := by
    change ‖e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖=1
    rw [norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  have hmem := hstrip (E t) hEt ht.2.2 (r t) ht.1 ht.2.1 hside
  let v : ℂ := (r t:ℂ)*E t-e
  have hve : v=e*(Circle.exp (2*t) : ℂ) := by
    change ((2*Real.cos t : ℝ):ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ))-e=e*(Circle.exp (2*t) : ℂ)
    calc
      _ = e*((2*Real.cos t : ℂ)*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)-1) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [double_cos_circle]
  refine ⟨v,by rw [hve,norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul],?_⟩
  have hvq : (x+e)+v=x+(r t:ℂ)*E t := by dsimp [v]; ring
  exact hvq ▸ hmem
end EuclideanFiveColor

def radialSide (b : Bool) (ε : ℝ) : Set ℝ := if b then Ioo 1 (1+ε) else Ioo (1-ε) 1
def polarBox (x e : ℂ) (b : Bool) (ε : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  (fun rt : ℝ × ℝ => x+(rt.1:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ))) ''
    (radialSide b ε ×ˢ Ioo (-ε) ε)

name: radialSide_connected
proof:
by
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] <;> apply isConnected_Ioo <;> linarith

name: radialSide_abs
proof:
by
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at hr
  all_goals rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hr.1,hr.2]

name: mem_radialSide
proof:
by
  rw [abs_lt] at hr
  cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at * <;> constructor <;> linarith [hr.1,hr.2]

name: polarBox_connected
proof:
by
  apply ((radialSide_connected b hε).prod (isConnected_Ioo (by linarith : -ε<ε))).image
  fun_prop
/-- Arbitrarily small connected polar boxes on either side of a unit circle. -/

name: polarBox_small
proof:
by
  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun rt => x+(rt.1:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ))
  let E : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun rt => e*(Circle.exp rt.2 : ℂ)
  have hF : Continuous F := by fun_prop
  have hE : Continuous E := by fun_prop
  have hF0 : F (1,0)=x+e := by simp [F]
  have hE0 : E (1,0)=e := by simp [E]
  have hn : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),F rt∈W ∧ dist (E rt) e<δ ∧ 0<rt.1 ∧ |rt.1-1|<δ := by
    have h₁ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),F rt∈W := hF.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hW.mem_nhds (hF0 ▸ hp))
    have h₂ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),dist (E rt) e<δ :=
      (hE.dist continuous_const).continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa [hE0] using hδ)
    have h₃ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),0<rt.1 :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt continuous_fst.continuousAt (by norm_num)
    have h₄ : ∀ᶠrt in 𝓝 ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ),|rt.1-1|<δ :=
      (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousAt.eventually_lt_const (by simpa using hδ)
    exact h₁.and (h₂.and (h₃.and h₄))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hh⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨ε,hε,?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨⟨r,t⟩,⟨hr,ht⟩,rfl⟩
  have hrt : (r,t)∈Metric.ball ((1,0) : ℝ × ℝ) ε := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using radialSide_abs hr,by simpa [Real.dist_eq,abs_lt] using ht⟩
  have hz := hh hrt
  refine ⟨hstrip (E (r,t)) ?_ hz.2.1 r hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2 ?_,hz.1⟩
  · change ‖e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)‖=1
    rw [norm_mul,he,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  · cases b <;> dsimp [radialSide] at hr ⊢
    · exact hr.2
    · exact hr.1
/-- A polar box contains a complete one-sided radial strip, not just selected rays. -/

name: polarBox_contains_strip
proof:
by
  have he0 : e≠0 := by intro h; simp [h] at he
  have ha : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.arg (z/e)) e := by
    have hh : ContinuousAt Complex.arg (e/e) := Complex.continuousAt_arg (by
      simpa only [div_self he0] using Complex.one_mem_slitPlane)
    exact hh.comp (f := fun z : ℂ => z/e) (by fun_prop)
  have hn : ∀ᶠz in 𝓝 e,|Complex.arg (z/e)|<ε :=
    ha.abs.eventually_lt_const (by simpa [div_self he0] using hε)
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨min δ ε,lt_min hδ hε,?_⟩
  intro e' he' hdist r hr hb
  let t : ℝ := Complex.arg (e'/e)
  have ht : -ε<t ∧ t<ε := abs_lt.mp (hh (hdist.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))
  have heq : e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ)=e' := by
    have hnorm : ‖e'/e‖=1 := by rw [norm_div,he',he,div_one]
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (e'/e)
    rw [hnorm,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] at h
    change e*Complex.exp ((t:ℂ)*Complex.I)=e'
    rw [show Complex.exp ((t:ℂ)*Complex.I)=e'/e from h]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨(r,t),⟨mem_radialSide (hr.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) hb,ht⟩,?_⟩
  change x+(r:ℂ)*(e*(Circle.exp t : ℂ))=x+(r:ℂ)*e'
  rw [heq]
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: triple_orthogonal_cover
proof:
by
  classical
  have hex (i : Fin 3) : ∃t : Angles,direction t=Complex.I*v i := direction_exists
    (by rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,hv,one_mul])
  choose a ha using hex
  let B : Finset Angles := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i : Fin 3 => {a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)}
  have hmem (t : Angles) : t∈B ↔ ∃i : Fin 3,t=a i ∨ t=a i+(Real.pi : Angles) := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mem_biUnion,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hdouble (t : Angles) : t+(Real.pi : Angles)+(Real.pi : Angles)=t := by
    apply direction_injective
    simp only [direction_add_pi,neg_neg]
  refine ⟨B,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · calc B.card ≤ ∑i : Fin 3,({a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
         _ ≤ ∑_i : Fin 3,2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => by simpa using (Finset.card_insert_le (a _) ({a _+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles))
         _ = 6 := by norm_num
  · intro t
    rw [hmem,hmem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,hi|hi⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr (by rw [←hi,hdouble])⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (add_right_cancel hi)⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl|rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (hdouble _)⟩
  · intro t ht i hinner
    apply ht
    rw [hmem]
    rcases complex_unit_orthogonal (direction_norm t) (hv i) hinner with he|he
    · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (direction_injective (he.trans (ha i).symm))⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Or.inr (direction_injective ?_)⟩
      rw [direction_add_pi,ha,he]
      ring
/-- The actual three-interface data force the source's unique six-position
boundary orbit. This theorem does not assume local rigidity or orbit finiteness. -/

name: one_orbit_first_arc
proof:
by
  let U : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' Ioo φ (φ+Real.pi/3)
  have hU : IsPreconnected U := isPreconnected_Ioo.image _ continuous_quotient_mk'.continuousOn
  have hne : U.Nonempty := (nonempty_Ioo.mpr (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : φ<φ+Real.pi/3)).image _
  have hd : Disjoint U (angleBoundary s) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro q ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ hq
    rw [hboundary] at hq
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hq
    have he : (t : Angles)=((φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) := by
      have hx : sixAngle j=((j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) := by
        rw [sixAngle,←AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul,sixty]
      simpa only [hx,AddCircle.coe_add] using hj
    have htI : t∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := ⟨ht.1.le,by linarith [Real.pi_pos,ht.2]⟩
    have hjI : φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := by
      have hj0 : 0≤(j.val:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hj6 : (j.val:ℝ)<6 := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
      constructor
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hv := (AddCircle.coe_eq_coe_iff_of_mem_Ico htI hjI).mp he
    by_cases hz : j.val=0
    · simp only [hz,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] at hv
      linarith [ht.1]
    · have hj1 : (1:ℝ)≤j.val := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz
      nlinarith [ht.2,Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := angleEssential_connected hU hne hd
  exact ⟨b,fun t ht => hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩⟩

name: angleEssential_real_periodic
proof:

  apply propext

  rw [Bool.not_not] at hh

  have he : ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = (t : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)+(sixty : Angles) := by
    calc ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = ((t+sixty+sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
           congr 1
           dsimp [sixty]
           ring
         _ = _ := by rw [AddCircle.coe_add,AddCircle.coe_add]
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  exact hh.trans hh'

name: one_orbit_sectors
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := one_orbit_first_arc hboundary
  have hb' (t : ℝ) (ht : t∈Ioo (φ+Real.pi/3) (φ+2*(Real.pi/3))) :
      (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b) := by
    have hh := (angleEssential_shift hf ((t-Real.pi/3 : ℝ) : Angles) b).mpr
      (hb (t-Real.pi/3) ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
    simpa only [sixty,←AddCircle.coe_add,sub_add_cancel] using hh
  have hreduce (t : ℝ) : ∃r : ℝ,∃n : ℤ,0≤r ∧ r<2*(Real.pi/3) ∧
      t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) ∧ Real.sin (3*(t-φ))=Real.sin (3*r) := by
    let n : ℤ := ⌊(t-φ)/(2*(Real.pi/3))⌋
    let r : ℝ := (t-φ)-n*(2*(Real.pi/3))
    have he : t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) := by dsimp [r]; ring
    refine ⟨r,n,Int.sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg _ (by positivity),Int.sub_floor_div_mul_lt _ (by positivity),he,?_⟩
    have he' : 3*(t-φ)=3*r+(n:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) := by rw [he]; ring
    rw [he',Real.sin_add_int_mul_two_pi]
  refine ⟨b,?_,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hrpos : 0<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hr : r=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hr0
      simp only [hr,mul_zero,Real.sin_zero,lt_self_iff_false] at ht
    have hra : r<Real.pi/3 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_neg_pi_le
        (by linarith : 3*r-2*Real.pi≤0) (by linarith : -Real.pi≤3*r-2*Real.pi)
      rw [Real.sin_sub_two_pi] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf b).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hra : Real.pi/3<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith : 0≤3*r) (by linarith : 3*r≤Real.pi)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb' (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf (!b)).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
end EuclideanFiveColor

  have hfin : volume (A∩Metric.closedBall x r)≠⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top (measure_mono inter_subset_right)
  have hp := (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume x hr).ne'
  have he : Aᶜ∩Metric.closedBall x r=Metric.closedBall x r\(A∩Metric.closedBall x r) := by
    ext z; simp; tauto
  rw [he,measure_sdiff inter_subset_right (hA.inter measurableSet_closedBall).nullMeasurableSet hfin,
    ENNReal.sub_div (fun _ _ => hp),ENNReal.div_self hp (isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top]

name: state_densityZero

name: angularSum_swap

name: DensityOne.compl
proof:
by
  have ht := ENNReal.Tendsto.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ENNReal))) h (Or.inl (by finiteness))
  rw [tsub_self] at ht
  apply ht.congr'

name: DensityOne.inter

name: DensityOne.measure_ne_zero
proof:

  intro hz
  have hzero : (fun r => volume (A∩Metric.closedBall x r)/volume (Metric.closedBall x r))=fun _ : ℝ => (0:ENNReal) := by
    funext r
    rw [measure_mono_null inter_subset_left hz,ENNReal.zero_div]

name: densityOne_univ

name: DensityOne.iInter
proof:
by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hh (J : Finset ι) : DensityOne (⋂i∈J,A i) x := by
    induction J using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa using densityOne_univ x
    | @insert i J hi ih =>

name: finite_density_realization
proof:
by
  have hmem : DensityOne (⋂v,{q | c (q+z v)∈J v}) 0 := by
    apply DensityOne.iInter
    · intro v
      exact (J v).finite_toSet.measurableSet.preimage (hc.comp (measurable_id.add_const _))
    · intro v
      simpa only [zero_add,preimage_ofPred_eq] using (densityOne_translate (A := {q | c q∈J v}) (x := 0) (u := z v)).mpr (by simpa using hz v)
  have hproper : ∀ᵐ q : ℂ ∂volume, ∀v w, ‖z v-z w‖=1 → c (q+z v)≠c (q+z w) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro v
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro w
    by_cases hh : ‖z v-z w‖=1
    · obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists (u := z w-z v) (by simpa only [norm_sub_rev] using hh)
      have hd := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (z v)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
        (weak_all_directions c hc hw t)
      filter_upwards [hd] with q hq _
      simpa only [ht,show q+z v+(z w-z v)=q+z w by ring] using hq
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => fun h => (hh h).elim
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqp⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hmem.measure_ne_zero (ae_restrict_of_ae hproper)
  exact ⟨q,fun v => mem_iInter.mp hq v,hqp⟩

name: two_label_triangle_impossible
proof:
by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hp⟩ := finite_density_realization hc hw z (fun _ => J) hz
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v : Fin 3 => (⟨c (q+z v),hq v⟩ : J)) := by
    intro v w he
    by_contra hne
    exact hp v w (hd v w hne) (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_coe] at hcard
  omega
end EuclideanFiveColor
