name: bool_flip_two
proof:
by
  have h' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h
  filter_upwards [h,h'] with t ht ht'
  rw [show t+κ+κ=t+2*κ by ring,ht,Bool.not_not] at ht'
  exact ht'

name: bool_flip_three
proof:
by
  have h' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*κ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h
  filter_upwards [bool_flip_two h,h'] with t ht ht'
  rwa [show t+2*κ+κ=t+3*κ by ring,ht] at ht'

name: bool_flip_even
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*n*κ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (bool_flip_two h)
    filter_upwards [ih,h'] with t ht ht'
    rw [ht] at ht'
    convert ht' using 1
    norm_num
    congr 1
    ring

name: triangleAngle_nonparallel
proof:
by
  rw [add_comm,Real.sin_add_pi,neg_ne_zero]
  exact (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi triangleAngle_pos triangleAngle_lt_pi).ne'

name: two_state_impossible
proof:
by
  let f : ℝ → Bool := fun t => s (t : Angles)
  have hf : Measurable f := hs.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable
  have hflip' : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f (t+Real.pi/3)= !(f t) := by
    have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hflip
    simpa only [← AddCircle.coe_add] using hh
  have heven (n : ℕ) := bool_flip_even hflip' n
  have hπ : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f (t+Real.pi)= !(f t) := by
    simpa only [show 3*(Real.pi/3)=Real.pi by ring] using bool_flip_three hflip'
  have hden : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, ∀b : Bool, f t=b → LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} t := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro b
    exact ae_lineDensityZero_compl (measurableSet_eq_fun hf measurable_const)
  have hgood : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, ∀j : Fin 3,
      f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=f t ∧
      f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)= !(f (t+triangleAngle)) ∧
      (∀b : Bool,f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=b →
        LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧
      (∀b : Bool,f (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)=b →
        LineDensityZero {a : ℝ | f a≠b} (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro j
    have h₁ := heven j.val
    have h₂ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume triangleAngle).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (heven j.val)
    have h₃ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hπ
    have h₄ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hden
    have h₅ := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hden
    filter_upwards [h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄,h₅] with t ht₁ ht₂ ht₃ ht₄ ht₅
    refine ⟨ht₁,?_,ht₄,?_⟩
    · change f (t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))+Real.pi)= !(f (t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))) at ht₃
      rw [show t+(triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=t+triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) by ring,ht₂] at ht₃
      simpa only [show t+triangleAngle+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi = t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring] using ht₃
    · simpa only [show t+(2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)=t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring] using ht₅
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠt : ℝ in ae volume, f t=f (t+triangleAngle) := by
    by_contra hh
    have hn : ∀ᵐt : ℝ ∂volume, f t≠f (t+triangleAngle) := not_frequently.mp hh
    have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s t≠s (t+(triangleAngle : Angles)) := by
      apply ae_angular_of_ae_line
      · exact (measurableSet_eq_fun hs (hs.comp (measurable_id.add_const _))).compl
      · simpa only [f,← AddCircle.coe_add] using hn
    exact (ne_of_gt (equal_triangleAngle_positive hs hflip))
      (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)
  obtain ⟨t,hteq,htgood⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually hgood).exists
  apply two_label_triangle_impossible hc hw (sourceTriangle x t) (Finset.univ\(J∪K)) hcard
    (sourceTriangle_pair x t)
  intro j
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂,h₃,h₄⟩ := htgood j
  rw [← hteq] at h₂
  have hne : Real.sin ((t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)-(t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))≠0 := by
    rw [show (t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)+Real.pi+triangleAngle)-(t+2*(j:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))=Real.pi+triangleAngle by ring]
    exact triangleAngle_nonparallel
  have hd : DensityOne {q | c q∉J∪K} (sourceTriangle x t j) := by
    cases hb : f t
    · have ha := h₃ false (h₁.trans hb)
      have hb' := h₄ true (by simpa [hb] using h₂)
      exact states_densityOne hc hw hJ hK ha hb' hne
    · have ha := h₃ true (h₁.trans hb)
      have hb' := h₄ false (by simpa [hb] using h₂)
      simpa only [Finset.union_comm,sourceTriangle] using states_densityOne hc hw hK hJ ha hb' hne
  simpa only [Finset.mem_sdiff,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using hd
end EuclideanFiveColor

variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def FourCenter (x : ℂ) : Prop :=
  TransitionEdge c 0 1 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 1 2 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 2 3 x ∧ TransitionEdge c 3 0 x

name: four_palette_admissible
proof:
by
  filter_upwards [palette_nonempty c hc x,palette_cardinality c hc hw x,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.1,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.1,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.2.1,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hx.2.2.2] with t ht hcard h01 h12 h23 h30
  refine ⟨ht,hcard.2,?_⟩
  intro e
  fin_cases e <;> simp only [fourEdge] <;> assumption
def fourState (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Fin 3 := fourCanonical (palette c hc x t)

name: fourState_measurable
proof:
by
  change Measurable (fun t => if 4∈palette c hc x t then (0:Fin 3) else if 0∈palette c hc x t then 1 else 2)
  exact Measurable.ite (by simpa only [mem_palette,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using paletteSet_measurable c hc x 4) measurable_const
    (Measurable.ite (by simpa only [mem_palette,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using paletteSet_measurable c hc x 0) measurable_const measurable_const)

name: fourState_group
proof: (four_palette_admissible c hc hw hx).mono fun _ ht => four_admissible_group _ ht

name: fourState_represents
proof:
by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fourState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_group c hc hw hx)
  filter_upwards [hh] with t ht hts
  change fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s at hts
  exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp (ht (by simpa only [hts] using hi))

name: fourState_changes
proof:
by
  have hgp := fourState_group c hc hw hx
  filter_upwards [hgp,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hgp,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd he
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := fourGroup_nonempty (fourState c hc x t)
  have hi' : i∈palette c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) := hu (by simpa only [sixty,he] using hi)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht hi) hi'

name: three_exclude_flip
proof: by decide

name: fourState_diagonal_positive
proof:
by
  by_contra! hn
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure, fourState c hc x t≠s :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 ∧ r≠s ∧ ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=r := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠0 ∧ (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠s ∧
      ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=(if s=1 then 2 else 1) from by decide) s hs
  let f : Angles → Bool := fun t => if fourState c hc x t=0 then false else true
  have hf : Measurable f := Measurable.ite
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hrep (v : Bool) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | f (t : Angles)=v} (if v then fourGroup r else fourGroup 0) := by
    refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_group c hc hw hx),
      angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot] with t ht htn htv
    change f (t : Angles)=v at htv
    apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp
    apply ht
    cases v
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by simpa [f] using htv
      simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using hi
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=r := hr.2.2 _ (by simpa [f] using htv) htn
      simpa only [hz,ite_true] using hi
  have hcard : (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup r)).card≤2 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1))).card≤2 from by decide) s hs
  apply two_state_impossible hc hw x (fourGroup 0) (fourGroup r) hcard f hf (hrep false) (hrep true)
  filter_upwards [hnot,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (Real.pi/3 : ℝ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot,
      fourState_changes c hc hw hx] with t ht hu hne
  exact three_exclude_flip _ _ s hs ht hu hne
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: varying_pullback_L1
proof:
by
  have hfixed := tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual hT hS hmT hmS ht hf
  have hbound : Tendsto (fun n => (C : ℝ)*(∫ y, ‖g n y-f y‖ ∂ν)+
      ∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero,add_zero] using (hgf.const_mul (C : ℝ)).add hfixed
  apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hbound
  filter_upwards [hmT] with n hn
  have hgT := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) hn (hg n)
  have hfT := integrable_comp_of_map_le (hT n) hn hf
  have hfS := integrable_comp_of_map_le hS hmS hf
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖g n (T n x)-f (T n x)‖+‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ :=
      integral_mono (hgT.sub hfS).norm ((hgT.sub hfT).norm.add (hfT.sub hfS).norm)
        (fun x => norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _)
    _ = (∫ x, ‖g n (T n x)-f (T n x)‖ ∂μ)+(∫ x, ‖f (T n x)-f (S x)‖ ∂μ) :=
      integral_add (hgT.sub hfT).norm (hfT.sub hfS).norm
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (integral_norm_comp_le (hT n) hn ((hg n).sub hf)) le_rfl

name: indicator_inter_positive
proof:
by
  have hpos : 0<(μ A).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hp.ne' (measure_ne_top _ _)
  have ht := hBA.add hDA
  rw [add_zero] at ht
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hpos)] with n hn
  by_contra hh
  have hz : μ (B n∩D n)=0 := nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (le_of_not_gt hh)
  have hiA : Integrable (A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator hA
  have hiB : Integrable ((B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator (hB n)
  have hiD : Integrable ((D n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) μ := (integrable_const _).indicator (hD n)
  have hi := integral_mono_ae hiA ((hiB.sub hiA).norm.add (hiD.sub hiA).norm) ?_
  · simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
    rw [integral_add (hiB.sub hiA).norm (hiD.sub hiA).norm,integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) hA,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hi
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hi) hn
  · filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with x hx
    by_cases ha : x∈A
    · by_cases hb : x∈B n
      · have hd : x∉D n := fun hd => hx ⟨hb,hd⟩
        simp [ha,hb,hd]
      · by_cases hd : x∈D n <;> simp [ha,hb,hd]
    · simp only [Pi.add_apply,Set.indicator_of_notMem ha]
      positivity
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: circleEndpoint_identity_neighborhood
proof:
by
  let V := (circleInverseHomeo h).source
  have ha : (a,u)∈V := (circleSum_strict 1 (a,u)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  let I := (fun v : ℝ => (v,u)) ⁻¹' V
  refine ⟨I,(circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const),ha,?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have he : circleTarget (samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1,v)=circleSum 1 (v,u) := by
    simp [circleTarget,samplingParameter,circleSum,add_comm]
  have hv' : (v,u)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).source := hv
  have ht : circleSum 1 (v,u)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hv'
  refine ⟨he ▸ ht,?_⟩
  rw [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_eq h ht]
  exact congrArg Prod.fst ((circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hv')

name: near_identity_circle_in
proof:
by
  let p := samplingParameter 0 (direction (u : Angles)) 1
  have he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (a,u) := by
    simp [p,circleTarget,samplingParameter,circleSum,add_comm]
  have ha : Real.sin (a-u)≠0 := by rwa [← neg_sub u a,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  obtain ⟨P,I,hP,hp,hI,hai,hIp,K,hK,hctrl⟩ := circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood h he rfl ha
  obtain ⟨J,hJ,haj,hid⟩ := circleEndpoint_identity_neighborhood h
  have hcv : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (p,a),circleEndpoint h q∈V := by
    apply (circleEndpoint_strict h he).continuousAt
    simpa only [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_at] using hV.mem_nhds haV
  obtain ⟨P₁,hP₁,I₁,hI₁,hsubV⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hcv
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
    (inter_mem ((hI.inter hJ).mem_nhds ⟨hai,haj⟩) hI₁)
  let ε := min δ 1
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min hδ (by norm_num)
  let T : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n v => circleEndpoint h (samplingParameter 0 (w n) 1,v)
  have hparam := samplingParameter_tendsto (x := 0) hw tendsto_const_nhds
  have hT (n : ℕ) : Measurable (T n) :=
    (circleEndpoint_measurable h).comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  refine ⟨ε,hε,min_le_right _ _,max K 1,le_max_right _ _,T,hT,?_,?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have hvI := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1
    have hh := (circleInverse_continuousAt h (hid v hvI.2).1).fst.tendsto.comp
      (circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hparam.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds))
    have hid' := (hid v hvI.2).2
    change Tendsto (fun n => T n v) atTop (𝓝 (circleEndpoint h (p,v))) at hh
    simpa only [p,hid'] using hh
  · filter_upwards [hparam.eventually (hP.mem_nhds hp),hparam.eventually hP₁] with n hn hnV
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
      intro v z
      have hv := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) v.2)).1.1
      have hz := (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) z.2)).1.1
      exact ((hK _ hn).le_mul_dist ⟨v,hv⟩ ⟨z,hz⟩).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left K 1) dist_nonneg)
    · intro v hv
      exact (hctrl _ hn v (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1.1).2.2
    · intro v hv
      exact hsubV ⟨hnV,(hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).2⟩
    · intro v hv
      have ht := (hctrl _ hn v (hsub ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ 1)) hv)).1.1).1
      have hh := circleInverse_sampling h ht
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,angularSum,zero_add,angleChart] at hh
      change w n+direction (v : Angles)=direction (T n v : Angles)+
        direction (((circleInverse h (circleTarget (samplingParameter 0 (w n) 1,v))).2) : Angles) at hh
      rw [hh,add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact Circle.norm_coe _
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: nonparallel_neighborhood
proof:
by
  have hf : Continuous (fun q : ℝ×ℝ => Real.sin (q.2-q.1)) :=
    Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)
  have ho : IsOpen {q : ℝ×ℝ | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0} :=
    isOpen_compl_singleton.preimage hf
  have hh : {q : ℝ×ℝ | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0}∈𝓝 (a,b) := ho.mem_nhds h

  refine ⟨Metric.ball a ε,Metric.isOpen_ball,Metric.mem_ball_self hε,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hs.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds b hε)] with n hn
  intro v hv
  exact @hsub (v,s n) (show max (dist v a) (dist (s n) b)<ε from max_lt hv hn)

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor

name: strict_state_sequence_local_false
proof:
by
  let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => direction (b n : Angles)-direction (d n : Angles)
  have hdir : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => direction (v : Angles)) := direction_continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi))
  have hwt : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 (direction (u : Angles))) := by
    rw [hu]
    exact (hdir.tendsto b₀ |>.comp hb).sub (hdir.tendsto d₀ |>.comp hd)
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hparb⟩ := nonparallel_neighborhood hab hb
  obtain ⟨W,hW,haW,hpard⟩ := nonparallel_neighborhood had hd
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ1,C,hC,T,hT,hTlim,hctrl⟩ := near_identity_circle_in hau hwt hW haW
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hηV⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hV.mem_nhds haV)
  let ε := min δ η
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min hδ hη
  let I := Metric.ball a ε
  let E := Metric.closedBall a 1
  have hIE : I⊆E := (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_left δ η).trans hδ1)).trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hIδ : I⊆Metric.ball a δ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ η)
  have hIV : I⊆V := (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right δ η)).trans hηV
  let μ := volume.restrict I
  let ν := volume.restrict E
  have hEc : IsCompact E := isCompact_closedBall a 1
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ν := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hEc.measure_ne_top
  have : IsFiniteMeasure μ := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hEc.measure_ne_top (measure_mono hIE))
  have : ν.WeaklyRegular := Measure.WeaklyRegular.restrict_of_measure_ne_top hEc.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hS : AntilipschitzWith C (I.domRestrict id) := by
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro v z
    change dist v.1 z.1≤(C:ℝ)*dist v.1 z.1
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (1:ℝ)≤C by exact_mod_cast hC) (dist_nonneg (x := v.1) (y := z.1))
  have hmS : μ.map id≤(C:ENNReal) •ν := line_map_restrict_volume_le measurable_id hEc.measurableSet hS hIE
  have hmT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, μ.map (T n)≤(C:ENNReal) •ν := by
    filter_upwards [hctrl] with n hn
    apply line_map_restrict_volume_le (hT n) hEc.measurableSet
      (AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist fun v z => hn.1.le_mul_dist ⟨v,hIδ v.2⟩ ⟨z,hIδ z.2⟩)
    exact hn.2.1.mono_left hIδ
  have hiD : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) ν := (integrable_const _).indicator hD
  have hiA (n : ℕ) : Integrable ((A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) ν := (integrable_const _).indicator (hA n).1
  have hlimT : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ,Tendsto (fun n => T n v) atTop (𝓝 (id v)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with v hv
    exact hTlim v (hIδ hv)
  have hcomp := varying_pullback_L1 hT measurable_id hmT hmS hlimT hiD hiA (hL1 E hEc)
  have hdirect : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖ ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_nonneg fun v => norm_nonneg _) _
      (by simpa only [mul_zero] using (hL1 E hEc).const_mul (C:ℝ))
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => integral_norm_comp_le measurable_id hmS ((hiA n).sub hiD)
  have hpre (n : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (T n ⁻¹' A n) := (hA n).1.preimage (hT n)
  have hcompeq (n : ℕ) (v : ℝ) : (T n ⁻¹' A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v =
      (A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (T n v) := by
    by_cases hv : T n v∈A n <;> simp [hv]
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,0<μ (A n∩T n ⁻¹' A n) := by
    apply indicator_inter_positive hD (fun n => (hA n).1) hpre ?_ hdirect
    · simpa only [hcompeq,id_eq] using hcomp
    · simpa only [μ,Measure.restrict_apply hD,I] using hpos ε hε
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hbp,hdp,hp⟩ := (hctrl.and (hparb.and (hpard.and hpositive))).exists
  have hqmp : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (T n) μ volume :=
    line_antilipschitz_qmp (hT n)
      (AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist fun v z => hn.1.le_mul_dist ⟨v,hIδ v.2⟩ ⟨z,hIδ z.2⟩)
  have hden := ae_lineDensityZero_compl (hA n).1
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ v ∂μ,v∈I ∧ (v∈A n → LineDensityZero (A n)ᶜ v) ∧
      (T n v∈A n → LineDensityZero (A n)ᶜ (T n v)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball,ae_restrict_of_ae hden,hqmp.ae hden] with v hv hd₁ hd₂
    exact ⟨hv,hd₁,hd₂⟩
  obtain ⟨v,hvA,hvI,hvden,hTvden⟩ := ((frequently_ae_mem_iff.mpr hp.ne').and_eventually hgood).exists
  have h₁ := states_densityOne hc hw (hA n) (hB n) (hvden hvA.1) (hbden n) (hbp v (hIV hvI))
  have h₂ := states_densityOne hc hw (hA n) (hB n) (hTvden hvA.2) (hdden n)
    (hdp (T n v) (hn.2.2.1 (hIδ hvI)))
  have he : {z | c z∉J∪K}={z | c z=X} := by ext z; exact hlabels (c z)
  rw [he] at h₁ h₂
  apply weak_density_proper c hc hw X _ h₁ h₂
  have hdist := hn.2.2.2 v (hIδ hvI)
  convert hdist using 1
  congr 1
  simp only [angularSum,angleChart,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,w]
  ring
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: complex_unit_orthogonal
proof:
by
  have hr : (e*star v).re=0 := by
    rw [real_inner_comm,Complex.inner] at h
    exact h
  have hn : ‖e*star v‖=1 := by rw [norm_mul,norm_star,he,hv,one_mul]
  have hs : (e*star v).im^2=1 := by
    have hh := Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq (e*star v)
    rw [hn] at hh
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply,hr,zero_mul,zero_add,one_pow] at hh
    nlinarith
  have him : (e*star v).im=1 ∨ (e*star v).im= -1 := by
    exact sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp (by simpa only [one_pow] using hs)
  have hmul : star v*v=1 := by
    change (starRingEnd ℂ) v*v=1
    rw [Complex.conj_mul']
    simp only [hv,one_pow,Complex.ofReal_one]
  rcases him with him|him
  · left
    have hz : e*star v=Complex.I := Complex.ext (by simpa using hr) (by simpa using him)
    calc e = (e*star v)*v := by rw [mul_assoc,hmul,mul_one]
         _ = Complex.I*v := congrArg (·*v) hz
  · right
    have hz : e*star v= -Complex.I := Complex.ext (by simpa using hr) (by simpa using him)
    calc e = (e*star v)*v := by rw [mul_assoc,hmul,mul_one]
         _ = -Complex.I*v := congrArg (·*v) hz

  have hf : {t | ⟪direction t,v⟫=0}.Finite := by
    apply ((Set.toFinite {Complex.I*v,-Complex.I*v}).preimage (f := direction) hd.injOn).subset
    intro t ht
    rcases complex_unit_orthogonal (direction_norm t) hv ht with ht|ht <;> simp [ht]
  exact measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (hf.measure_zero angularMeasure)

  filter_upwards [circleOperator_difference_ae (colorCutoff_memLp c hc i x R) h] with q hq hB
  exact hq.trans (colorCutoff_circleDifference c hc i x q h R hB hh)

name: transition_mass_energy
proof:
by
  filter_upwards [colorError_ae c hc i x R hh,colorError_ae c hc j x R hh,
    ae_density_actual c hc,ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_density_actual c hc),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))] with q hi hj hq hqs hqh hqhs hT
  have he_i : ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2=(colorMass c i q-colorMass c i (q+h))^2 := by
    rw [hi hT.1,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  have he_j : ‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2=(colorMass c j q-colorMass c j (q+h))^2 := by
    rw [hj hT.1,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs]
  rw [he_i,he_j]
  have h0 := colorMass_own_zero c hc hw hq hqs
  have h1 := colorMass_own_zero c hc hw hqh hqhs
  rcases hT.2 with ⟨hqi,hqj⟩ | ⟨hqj,hqi⟩
  · rw [hqi] at h0
    rw [hqj] at h1
    rw [h0,h1]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (colorMass c i (q+h))]
  · rw [hqj] at h0
    rw [hqi] at h1
    rw [h0,h1]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (colorMass c j (q+h))]
include hc in

name: transition_small_mass
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hfreq⟩ := transition_abundance c he hR
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun h : ℂ =>
      (‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2)/‖h‖) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simp only [add_div]
    simpa only [add_zero] using (colorError_smoothing c hc i x R).add (colorError_smoothing c hc j x R)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ),
      (‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2)/‖h‖<ε^2*a :=
    (hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity))).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hnorm : ∀ᶠ h in 𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ), ‖h‖<1 :=
    (continuous_norm.tendsto (0:ℂ)).eventually (by simpa using (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)))
      |>.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨h,hab,hsm,hhn,hne⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually (hsmall.and (hnorm.and self_mem_nhdsWithin))).exists
  have hnpos : 0<‖h‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  let E : ℂ → ℝ := fun q => ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2
  have hEi : Integrable (fun q => ‖colorError c hc i x R h q‖^2) volume :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _)).mp (Lp.memLp _)
  have hEj : Integrable (fun q => ‖colorError c hc j x R h q‖^2) volume :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable _)).mp (Lp.memLp _)
  have hInt : (∫ q, E q ∂volume) < ε^2*volume.real (transitionSet c i j x R h) := by
    rw [show (∫ q, E q ∂volume) = ‖colorError c hc i x R h‖^2+‖colorError c hc j x R h‖^2 by
      dsimp only [E]
      rw [integral_add hEi hEj,← planeL2_norm_sq,← planeL2_norm_sq]]
    have hs := (div_lt_iff₀ hnpos).mp hsm
    have hab' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab (sq_pos_of_pos hε)
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hqs,henergy⟩ := exists_energy_small volume (transitionSet_measurable c hc i j x R h)
    (transitionSet_finite c i j x R h) (hEi.add hEj)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun q => add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
    ((ae_typicalSampling c hc (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).and (transition_mass_energy c hc hw i j x R hhn)) hInt
  refine ⟨q,hq.1,hqs.1,?_⟩
  have hm := hqs.2 hq
  change E q<ε^2 at henergy
  change (colorMass c i q+colorMass c j q)^2≤E q at hm
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

name: all_parameters_product_zero

by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : T => ⟪f,shiftL2 (d t) f⟫) :=
    continuous_const.inner ((shiftL2_continuous f).comp hd)
  have hz : (fun t : T => ⟪f,shiftL2 (d t) f⟫) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 0 := by
    filter_upwards [ho] with t ht
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
    filter_upwards [shiftL2_ae (d t) f,ht] with x hx hh
    simpa [RCLike.inner_apply,mul_comm,hx] using hh
  have he := (hc.ae_eq_iff_eq μ continuous_const).mp hz

    simpa only [hx] using hh

name: weak_all_directions
proof:
by
  have ho : ∀ᵐ t ∂angularMeasure, ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), c z ≠ c (z+direction t) := by
    apply (Measure.ae_ae_comm ?_).mp (Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hweak.2)
    exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (hc.comp measurable_fst)
      (hc.comp (measurable_fst.add (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)))).compl
  have hz (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ) : ∀ t : Angles, ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ),
      truncatedVector c hc i n z*truncatedVector c hc i n (z+direction t)=0 := by
    apply all_parameters_product_zero angularMeasure direction direction_continuous
    · filter_upwards [truncatedVector_ae c hc i n] with z hz
      rw [hz]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
    · filter_upwards [ho] with t ht
      filter_upwards [ht,truncatedVector_ae c hc i n,
        (measurePreserving_add_right volume (direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (truncatedVector_ae c hc i n)] with z hne h1 h2
      rw [h1,h2]
      by_cases h : z ∈ truncatedClass c i n
      · have hh : z+direction t ∉ truncatedClass c i n := fun hh => hne (h.1.trans hh.1.symm)
        simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hh]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
  intro t
  have hi : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ), ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((truncatedClass c i n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z)*
      ((truncatedClass c i n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (z+direction t))=0 := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hz i n t,truncatedVector_ae c hc i n,
      (measurePreserving_add_right volume (direction t)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (truncatedVector_ae c hc i n)] with z h0 h1 h2
    simpa only [h1,h2] using h0
  filter_upwards [hi] with z hz
  intro he
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ‖z‖ ‖z+direction t‖)
  have h1 : z ∈ truncatedClass c (c z) n := ⟨rfl,by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn).le⟩
  have h2 : z+direction t ∈ truncatedClass c (c z) n := ⟨he.symm,by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn).le⟩
  have h0 := hz (c z) n
  simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h1,Set.indicator_of_mem h2] at h0

name: densityOne_disjoint

  have hle : (1 : ENNReal)+1 ≤ 1 := le_of_tendsto hh (by

    rw [← ENNReal.add_div,← measure_union₀ (hB.inter measurableSet_closedBall).nullMeasurableSet
      (hd.mono inter_subset_left inter_subset_left)]
    apply (ENNReal.div_le_iff (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume x hr).ne'
      ((isCompact_closedBall x r).measure_ne_top)).mpr

  norm_num at hle

      volume (A ∩ Metric.closedBall (x+u) r) := by
    rw [← he,← Set.preimage_inter,measure_preimage_add_right]
  have h2 (r : ℝ) : volume (Metric.closedBall x r) = volume (Metric.closedBall (x+u) r) := by
    rw [← he,measure_preimage_add_right]

by

name: covariance_norm_left
proof:
by
  have hp := conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq v
  have h1 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ ≤ (bound w : ℝ)*‖l2 μ v‖ :=
    (conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq _).trans (l2_mul_norm_le μ v (act (φ g) w)
      (fun x => norm_le_bound w _))
  have h2 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤
      (bound w : ℝ)*‖l2 μ v‖ := by
    have h := l2_norm_mul_le (μ.map q) (act (φ g) (conditional μ q w)) (conditional μ q v)
      (fun y => expect_bound _ w (norm_le_bound w) (φ g +ᵥ y))
    rw [mul_comm (act _ _) _] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (bound w).coe_nonneg)
  rw [covariance_apply, map_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ +
        ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: covariance_norm_right
proof:
by
  have hn : ‖l2 μ (act (φ g) w)‖ = ‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    rw [l2_act]
    exact (Amenable.Koopman.action μ (φ g)).norm_map _
  have h1 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ ≤ (bound v : ℝ)*‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    have h := (conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq (v*act (φ g) w)).trans
      (l2_norm_mul_le μ v _ (norm_le_bound v))
    rwa [hn] at h
  have hp : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤ ‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    have he := (l2_eq_iff (μ.map q) _ _).mpr (conditional_act μ q hq hqcov (φ g) w)
    rw [← he, ← hn]
    exact conditional_norm_l2_le μ q hq _
  have h2 : ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ ≤
      (bound v : ℝ)*‖l2 μ w‖ := by
    exact (l2_norm_mul_le (μ.map q) _ _ (expect_bound _ v (norm_le_bound v))).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (bound v).coe_nonneg)
  rw [covariance_apply, map_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w))‖ +
        ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q v * act (φ g) (conditional μ q w))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: meanNorm_zero_of_dense
proof:
by
  apply Family.meanNorm_eq_zero_of_approx
  intro ε hε
  have hden : 0 < C+1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨h,hh,hdist⟩ := hd f (ε/(C+1)) (div_pos hε hden)
  refine ⟨T h, hS h hh, fun g => ?_⟩
  have he : ε/(C+1)*(C+1) = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ ε/(C+1) := (div_pos hε hden).le
  calc
    _ ≤ C * ‖l2 μ (f-h)‖ := hT f h g
    _ ≤ C*(ε/(C+1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist.le hC
    _ ≤ ε := by nlinarith

variable [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X] [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
  [AddAction G X] [AddAction G Y] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G Y]
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
variable (q : X → Y) (hq : Measurable q) [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map q)]
variable (hqcov : ∀ g : G, (fun x => q (g +ᵥ x)) =ᵐ[μ] (fun x => g +ᵥ q x))
omit [StandardBorelSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] in
include hq hqcov in

name: covariance_zero_of_dense
proof:
by
  have hw (v : Func X) (hv : v∈S) (w : Func X) :
      Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) = 0 := by
    apply meanNorm_zero_of_dense μ (μ.map q) M S hd (covariance μ q φ v)
      (C := 2*(bound v : ℝ)) (by positivity) _ (hS v hv) w
    intro w w' g
    have he : covariance μ q φ v w g - covariance μ q φ v w' g = covariance μ q φ v (w-w') g :=
      congrArg (fun F : Family G Y => F g) (covariance_sub_right μ q φ v w w').symm
    rw [he]
    exact covariance_norm_right μ q hq hqcov φ v (w-w') g
  apply meanNorm_zero_of_dense μ (μ.map q) M S hd (fun v => covariance μ q φ v w)
    (C := 2*(bound w : ℝ)) (by positivity) _ (fun v hv => hw v hv w) v
  intro v v' g
  have he : covariance μ q φ v w g - covariance μ q φ v' w g = covariance μ q φ (v-v') w g :=
    congrArg (fun F : Family G Y => F g) (covariance_sub_left μ q φ v v' w).symm
  rw [he]
  exact covariance_norm_left μ q hq φ (v-v') w g

name: factor_preserving

  rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_vadd g) hq]
  calc
    _ = μ.map (q ∘ (fun x => g +ᵥ x)) := Measure.map_congr (hqcov g).symm

name: covariance_tensor
proof:
by
  have ht : tensor a₁ a₂ * act (φ g) (tensor b₁ b₂) = tensor (a₁*act (φ g) b₁) (a₂*act (φ g) b₂) := by
    rw [← tensor_act, tensor_mul]
  have h₁ := conditional_tensor μ q hq a₁ a₂
  have h₂ := (factor_preserving μ q hq hqcov (φ g)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
    (conditional_tensor μ q hq b₁ b₂)
  have h₃ := conditional_tensor μ q hq (a₁*act (φ g) b₁) (a₂*act (φ g) b₂)
  filter_upwards [h₁,h₂,h₃] with y hy₁ hy₂ hy₃
  change conditional _ _ (tensor a₁ a₂ * act (φ g) (tensor b₁ b₂)) y -
    conditional _ _ (tensor a₁ a₂) y * conditional _ _ (tensor b₁ b₂) (φ g +ᵥ y) = _
  rw [ht, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃]
  dsimp only [Family.mul_apply, Family.sub_apply, Family.conditional_apply,
    Family.const_apply, Family.orbit_apply, mul_apply, sub_apply, act_apply, Pi.mul_apply]

name: covariance_tensor_mean_zero
proof:
by
  let A₁ := Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₁ * Family.orbit φ b₁)
  let A₂ := Family.conditional μ q (Family.const a₂ * Family.orbit φ b₂)
  let B₁ := Family.const (conditional μ q a₁) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₁)
  let B₂ := Family.const (conditional μ q a₂) * Family.orbit φ (conditional μ q b₂)
  have h₁ : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₁-B₁) = 0 := covariance_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs a₁ b₁
  have h₂ : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₂-B₂) = 0 := covariance_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp φ hs a₂ b₂
  rw [Family.meanNorm_congr (μ.map q) M (covariance_tensor μ q hq hqcov φ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂)]
  change Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (A₁*A₂-B₁*B₂) = 0

def codeCell (n : ℕ) (c : Code n) : Func X := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x => if code X n x = c then (1:ℂ) else 0, ?_, 1, ?_⟩
  · exact measurable_const.piecewise ((measurable_code n) (measurableSet_singleton c)) measurable_const
  · intro x; dsimp only; split_ifs <;> simp

name: tensor_code_finite
proof:
by
  classical
  let T : Code n × Code n → Func (X×Y) := fun c =>
    tensor (a c • codeCell (X := X) n c.1) (codeCell (X := Y) n c.2)
  have hsum : F = ∑ c, T c := by
    ext z
    rw [he, func_sum_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (pairCode n z)]
    · simp [T, tensor_apply, codeCell, pairCode]
    · intro c _ hc
      have hn : code X n z.1 ≠ c.1 ∨ code Y n z.2 ≠ c.2 := by
        contrapose! hc
        exact Prod.ext hc.1.symm hc.2.symm
      rcases hn with hn | hn <;> simp [T, tensor_apply, codeCell, hn]
    · simp
  rw [hsum]
  exact FiniteTensor.sum _ _ (fun _ _ => .tensor _ _)

name: finiteTensor_dense
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨n,a,ha,_,he⟩ := bounded_rectangles ν f (measurable f) (bound f)
    (bound f).coe_nonneg (norm_le_bound f) ε hε
  let h : Func (X×Y) := ⟨fun z => a (pairCode n z),
    (measurable_of_countable a).comp (measurable_pairCode n), 2*bound f,
    fun z => by simpa only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat] using ha (pairCode n z)⟩
  refine ⟨h, tensor_code_finite n a h (fun _ => rfl), ?_⟩
  have hh : ‖l2 ν (f-h)‖^2 < ε^2 := by
    rw [norm_l2_sq]
    exact he
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (l2 ν (f-h))]

name: pairVanishing_of_covariance
proof:
by
  intro φ hs v w hw
  have he0 : l2 μ (project μ q hq w) = l2 μ 0 := hw.trans (map_zero _).symm
  have hp : project μ q hq w =ᵐ[μ] (0 : Func X) := (l2_eq_iff μ _ _).mp he0
  have he (g : G) : covariance μ q φ v w g =ᵐ[μ.map q] conditional μ q (v*act (φ g) w) := by
    apply (covariance_center μ q hq hqcov φ v w g).trans
    apply conditional_congr μ q hq
    filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_vadd (φ g) μ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hp] with x hx
    change v x * (w (φ g +ᵥ x) - project μ q hq w (φ g +ᵥ x)) = v x*w (φ g +ᵥ x)
    change project μ q hq w (φ g +ᵥ x) = 0 at hx
    rw [hx, sub_zero]
  have hmean := hc φ hs v w
  have hnorm : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (covariance μ q φ v w) =
      Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ w)) :=
    Family.meanNorm_congr _ _ he
  rw [hnorm] at hmean
  have hseq : Family.toL2 (μ.map q) (Family.conditional μ q (Family.const v * Family.orbit φ w)) =
      pairSequence μ q hq φ v w := by ext g; rfl
  unfold Family.meanNorm at hmean
  rwa [hseq] at hmean
end

by

name: centered_conditional_mean_zero
proof:
by
  let ρ := RelativeProduct.law μ q hq
  have : VAddInvariantMeasure G (X×X) ρ :=
    RelativeProduct.law_invariant_add μ q hq (fun g => measurePreserving_vadd g μ) hqcov
  let t : ι → Func (X×X) := fun i => tensor (f i) (bmConj (f i))
  let F : Family G (X×X) := ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (θ+φ i) (t i)

    obtain ⟨j,hj,hf⟩ := hc

    (hq.comp measurable_fst) (square_equivariant μ q hq hqcov) M
    (square_pairVanishing μ q hq hqcov M hp) s (fun i => θ+φ i) t ha htc
  unfold Family.meanNorm

    rw [hF, real_inner_comm, l2_inner, hc1, one_mul, integral_act,
      integral_tensor_self μ q hq]

name: conditional_multiple_mean_zero
proof:
by
  let a : ι → Family G X := fun i => Family.orbit (φ i) (f i)
  let b : ι → Family G X := fun i => Family.orbit (φ i) (project μ q hq (f i))
  have hb (g : G) : conditional μ q ((∏ i∈s, b i) g) =ᵐ[μ.map q]
      (∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (conditional μ q (f i))) g := by
    simp only [Family.prod_apply, Family.orbit_apply]
    apply (conditional_congr μ q hq (f := ∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (project μ q hq (f i)))
      (g := comp (∏ i∈s, act (φ i g) (conditional μ q (f i))) q hq) ?_).trans
      (conditional_lift μ q hq _)
    filter_upwards [prod_act_project_lift μ q hq hqcov s φ f g] with x hx
    simpa only [func_prod_apply, Finset.prod_apply] using hx
  have hrep : Family.meanNorm (μ.map q) M (Family.conditional μ q
      ((∏ i∈s, a i) - ∏ i∈s, b i)) = 0 := by
    rw [AlgebraReplacement.prod_sub_prod s a b, Family.conditional_sum]
    apply Family.meanNorm_sum_zero
    intro t ht
    have hts : t ⊆ s := Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ht)
    have htn : t.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ht)
    rw [AlgebraReplacement.mixed_prod s t hts]
    let w : ι → Func X := fun i => if i∈t then f i-project μ q hq (f i) else project μ q hq (f i)
    have he : (∏ i∈s, if i∈t then a i-b i else b i) = ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (w i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      by_cases hit : i∈t
      · simp only [hit, ↓reduceIte, w, a, b]
        apply Family.ext
        intro g
        exact (act_sub _ _ _).symm
      · simp only [hit, ↓reduceIte, w, b]
    rw [he]
    apply centered_conditional_mean_zero μ q hq hqcov M hp s φ θ w ha
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := htn
    refine ⟨j,hts hj,?_⟩
    simp only [w, hj, ↓reduceIte]
    exact center_project_l2 μ q hq (f j)
  rw [Family.conditional_sub] at hrep
  rw [Family.meanNorm_congr (μ.map q) M (F := Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, a i) -
      Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, b i)) (H := Family.conditional μ q (∏ i∈s, a i) -
      ∏ i∈s, Family.orbit (φ i) (conditional μ q (f i))) (fun g => by
        filter_upwards [hb g] with y hy
        simp only [Family.sub_apply, sub_apply, Family.conditional_apply]
        rw [hy])] at hrep
  exact hrep

    { toFun := fun v => M.map (pairing V v)
      map_add' := by
        intro v w
        have he : pairing V (v+w) = pairing V v + pairing V w := by ext; simp [inner_add_right]
        rw [he, map_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c v
        have he : pairing V (c • v) = c • pairing V v := by ext; simp [inner_smul_right]
        rw [he, map_smul]; rfl }
    (M.map (normFn V)) (fun v => M.pairing_bound V v)

def vector (V : G →ᵇ H) : H := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm (M.pairingMap V)

name: vector_pair
proof: InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply

name: vector_norm_le
proof:
by
  rw [vector, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  apply (M.pairingMap V).opNorm_le_bound (M.positive _ (fun x => by simp))
  exact M.pairing_bound V

name: vector_add
proof:
by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [inner_add_left, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (V+W) v = pairing V v + pairing W v := by ext; simp [inner_add_left]
  rw [he, map_add]

name: vector_smul
proof:
by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [real_inner_smul_left, M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (c • V) v = c • pairing V v := by ext; simp [real_inner_smul_left]
  rw [he, map_smul]; rfl

name: vector_shift
proof:
by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [M.vector_pair, M.vector_pair]
  exact M.invariant g (pairing V v)

name: vector_map
proof:
by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
  rw [M.vector_pair, ← L.adjoint_inner_right, M.vector_pair]
  congr 1; ext x
  exact (L.adjoint_inner_right (V x) v).symm

def squareNorm (V : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ := normFn V * normFn V
omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_apply
proof:
by
  simp [squareNorm, pow_two]

name: jensen
proof:
by
  let c := M.vector V
  have he : squareNorm (V - BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c) =
      squareNorm V - (2 : ℝ) • pairing V c + BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (‖c‖^2) := by
    ext x
    simp only [squareNorm_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.sub_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.const_apply,
      BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, pairing_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
  have hp := M.positive (squareNorm (V - BoundedContinuousFunction.const G c)) (fun x => by
    rw [squareNorm_apply]; positivity)
  rw [he, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, M.map_const, ← M.vector_pair] at hp
  change 0 ≤ M.map (squareNorm V) - 2 * inner ℝ c c + ‖c‖^2 at hp
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hp
  dsimp [c] at hp
  linarith
end Mean

open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def cross (V W : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun x => inner ℝ (V x) (W x))
    (V.continuous.inner W.continuous) (‖V‖ * ‖W‖) (fun x => by
      exact (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul (V.norm_coe_le_norm x) (W.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: cross_apply
proof:
rfl

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: cross_comm
proof:
by
  ext x; exact real_inner_comm _ _

omit [AddCommGroup G] [DiscreteTopology G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_add
proof:
by
  ext x
  simp only [squareNorm_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, cross_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [norm_add_sq_real]; ring

omit [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: squareNorm_shift
proof:
M.invariant g (squareNorm V)

def correlation (V W : G →ᵇ H) : G →ᵇ ℝ :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
    (fun g => M.map (cross (shift G g V) W)) continuous_of_discreteTopology
    (‖V‖ * ‖W‖) (fun g => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← M.map_const (‖V‖ * ‖W‖)]
      apply M.abs_le
      intro x
      exact (norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
        (mul_le_mul (V.norm_coe_le_norm (x+g)) (W.norm_coe_le_norm x) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)))

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_apply
proof:
rfl

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_add
proof:
by
  ext g
  simp only [correlation_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1; ext x
  simp only [cross_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, inner_add_right]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_zero
proof:
by
  ext g
  change M.map (cross (shift G g V) (0 : G →ᵇ H)) = 0
  have he : cross (shift G g V) (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by ext; simp
  rw [he, map_zero]

omit [CompleteSpace H] in

name: correlation_shift
proof:
by
  ext h
  change M.map (cross (shift G h V) (shift G g W)) =
    M.map (cross (shift G (h+-g) V) W)
  rw [← M.invariant (-g) (cross (shift G h V) (shift G g W))]
  congr 1; ext x
  simp only [shift_apply, cross_apply]
  congr 2 <;> abel

/-- Invariant-mean van der Corput: positivity and finite translates suffice.
There is no exchange of iterated means. -/

name: vector_eq_zero_of_correlation_nonpos
proof:
by
  classical
  let C : ℝ := M.map (squareNorm V) + 2
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    have := M.positive (squareNorm V) (fun x => by rw [squareNorm_apply]; positivity)
    dsimp [C]; linarith
  have hW (n : ℕ) : ∃ W : G →ᵇ H, M.vector W = (n : ℝ) • M.vector V ∧
      M.map (M.correlation V W) ≤ 0 ∧ M.map (squareNorm W) ≤ (n : ℝ)*C := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have he : M.vector (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by
          apply ext_inner_right ℝ; intro v
          rw [M.vector_pair, inner_zero_left]
          have he : pairing (0 : G →ᵇ H) v = 0 := by ext; simp
          rw [he, map_zero]
        simpa using he
      · simp [M.correlation_zero]
      · have he : squareNorm (0 : G →ᵇ H) = 0 := by ext; simp
        simp [he]
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨W, hv, hwc, hwe⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := M.exists_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hwc zero_lt_one)
      refine ⟨W+shift G g V, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [M.vector_add, M.vector_shift, hv]
        simp [Nat.cast_add, add_smul]
      · rw [M.correlation_add, map_add, M.correlation_shift, M.invariant]
        linarith
      · rw [squareNorm_add, map_add, map_add, map_smul, M.squareNorm_shift,
          cross_comm W _, ← M.correlation_apply V W g]
        have hn : ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ)+1 := by simp
        rw [hn]
        dsimp [C] at *
        change M.map (squareNorm W) + M.map (squareNorm V) + 2 * M.correlation V W g ≤
          ((n : ℝ)+1) * (M.map (squareNorm V) + 2)
        change M.correlation V W g < 1 at hg
        nlinarith
  have hn (n : ℕ) (hp : 0 < n) : (n : ℝ) * ‖M.vector V‖^2 ≤ C := by
    obtain ⟨W, hw, _, he⟩ := hW n
    have hj := (M.jensen W).trans he
    rw [hw, norm_smul, Real.norm_natCast] at hj
    have hnr : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hnr).mp
    nlinarith
  by_contra hv
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖M.vector V‖^2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hv)
  obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 0 (C / ‖M.vector V‖^2))
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn')
  have hratio := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn'
  have hbad := (div_lt_iff₀ hnorm).mp hratio
  have hgood := hn n hn0
  linarith

end

open scoped BoundedContinuousFunction
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G]
variable (M : Mean G)
variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]

def orbit (U : G → H ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] H) (v : H) : G →ᵇ H :=
  BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun g => U g v)
    continuous_of_discreteTopology ‖v‖ (fun g => le_of_eq ((U g).norm_map v))

omit [AddCommGroup G] [CompleteSpace H] in

name: orbit_apply
proof: rfl

name: vector_orbit_invariant
proof:
by
  change (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap (M.vector (orbit U v)) = _
  rw [← M.vector_map (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap]
  have he : (U g).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuousBounded G (orbit U v) =
      shift G g (orbit U v) := by
    ext h
    change U g (U h v) = U (h+g) v
    rw [add_comm h g, hU]
  rw [he, M.vector_shift]

name: vector_orbit_pair_fixed
proof:
by
  rw [M.vector_pair]
  have he : pairing (orbit U v) w = BoundedContinuousFunction.const G (inner ℝ v w) := by
    ext g
    change inner ℝ (U g v) w = inner ℝ v w
    calc
      inner ℝ (U g v) w = inner ℝ (U g v) (U g w) := by rw [hw g]
      _ = inner ℝ v w := (U g).inner_map_map v w
  rw [he, M.map_const]

/-- The mean ergodic projection criterion, valid for every positive invariant
mean and without an assumption that the group has a distinguished generator. -/

name: vector_orbit_eq_zero
proof:
by
  have hf := M.vector_orbit_invariant U hU v
  have hi := M.vector_orbit_pair_fixed U v (M.vector (orbit U v)) hf
  rw [hv _ hf] at hi
  exact inner_self_eq_zero.mp hi

end EuclideanFiveColor.Amenable.Mean

section Action
variable {G X E : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X]
  [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] (μ : Measure X)
  [VAddInvariantMeasure G X μ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

def linear (g : G) : Lp E 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ :=
  Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ (fun x => g +ᵥ x) (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

name: linear_add
proof:
by
  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => (g+h) +ᵥ x) _ f =
    Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => g +ᵥ x) _
      (Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => h +ᵥ x) _ f)
  have he : (fun x : X => (g+h) +ᵥ x) =
      (fun x => h +ᵥ x) ∘ (fun x => g +ᵥ x) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← add_vadd, add_comm]
  simpa only [he] using Lp.compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply f
    (measurePreserving_vadd h μ) (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

name: linear_zero
proof:
by
  change Lp.compMeasurePreserving (fun x => (0 : G) +ᵥ x) _ f = f
  have he : (fun x : X => (0 : G) +ᵥ x) = id := funext (fun x => zero_vadd G x)
  simpa only [he] using Lp.compMeasurePreserving_id_apply f

def action (g : G) : Lp E 2 μ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective (linear μ g) (fun f =>
    ⟨linear μ (-g) f, by rw [← linear_add, add_neg_cancel, linear_zero]⟩)

name: action_apply
proof: rfl

name: action_add
proof: linear_add μ g h f

name: coe_action
proof:
Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving f (measurePreserving_vadd g μ)

variable {G X E : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace X]
  [AddAction G X] [MeasurableConstVAdd G X] (μ : Measure X)
  [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [ErgodicVAdd G X μ]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated E]

omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [CompleteSpace E] in

name: ae_eq_const_of_fixed
proof:
by
  apply exists_eventuallyEq_const_of_forall_separating MeasurableSet
  intro A hA
  have := ErgodicVAdd.aeconst_of_forall_preimage_vadd_ae_eq (G := G)
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable f).measurable hA) (fun g => by
      have ha := coe_action μ g f
      rw [hf g] at ha
      exact ha.symm.mono (fun x hx =>
        propext (show f (g +ᵥ x) ∈ A ↔ f x ∈ A by change f (g +ᵥ x) = f x at hx; rw [hx])))
  exact eventuallyEmptyOrUniv_iff.mp this

name: inner_fixed_zero
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ae_eq_const_of_fixed (G := G) μ w hw
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  calc
    (∫ x, inner ℝ (v x) (w x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, inner ℝ c (v x) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (hc.mono (fun x hx => by dsimp only at hx ⊢; rw [hx, real_inner_comm]))
    _ = inner ℝ c (∫ x, v x ∂μ) := integral_inner ((Lp.memLp v).integrable (by norm_num)) c
    _ = 0 := by rw [hv, inner_zero_right]

name: vector_orbit_zero

Lp E 2 μ) (Mean.orbit (action (G := G) (E := E) μ) v) = 0 :=
by
  apply M.vector_orbit_eq_zero (H := Lp E 2 μ) (action (G := G) (E := E) μ)
    (action_add (G := G) (E := E) μ) v
  exact inner_fixed_zero (G := G) (E := E) μ v hv

name: list_of_uniform_atoms
proof:
by
  classical
  let e := S.equivFin
  let g : Fin S.card → G := fun i => (e.symm i).val
  have heq := Measure.ae_mem_finset_iff.mp hsupp
  have ha : a = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    have hn : (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hc; exact zero_ne_one hc
    calc
      a = 1*a := by simp
      _ = ((S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * S.card)*a := by rw [ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hn (by simp)]
      _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, hc, mul_one]
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  calc
    κ = ∑ d ∈ S, κ {d} • Measure.dirac d := heq
    _ = ∑ d ∈ S, (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.dirac d :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => by rw [hmass d hd, ha])
    _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ d ∈ S, Measure.dirac d := Finset.smul_sum.symm
    _ = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort S (fun d => Measure.dirac d)]
      exact (Equiv.sum_comp e.symm (fun d : S => Measure.dirac d.val)).symm

name: constant_uniform_lists
proof:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y₀, S₀, hS₀, _, _, hc₀⟩ := hf.exists
  let m := S₀.card
  have hm : 0 < m := Finset.card_pos.mpr hS₀
  have haT : a ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, ENNReal.mul_top (by exact_mod_cast hm.ne')] at hc₀
    exact ENNReal.top_ne_one hc₀
  have hlist : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ∃ g : Fin m → G,
      κ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) := by
    filter_upwards [hf] with y hy
    obtain ⟨S, _hS, hSa, hSupp, hc⟩ := hy
    have hcard : S.card = m := by
      have hh : (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) = (m : ℝ≥0∞) :=
        (ENNReal.mul_right_inj ha.ne' haT).mp (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hc.trans hc₀.symm)
      exact_mod_cast hh
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := list_of_uniform_atoms (κ y) S a hSa hSupp hc
    have hh : (∑ j : Fin S.card, Measure.dirac (g j)) =
        ∑ i : Fin m, Measure.dirac (g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i)) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp (finCongr hcard.symm) (fun j => Measure.dirac (g j))).symm
    refine ⟨fun i => g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i), ?_⟩
    calc
      κ y = (S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin m, Measure.dirac (g (Fin.cast hcard.symm i)) := hg.trans (congrArg ((S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ·) hh)
      _ = _ := by congr 2; exact_mod_cast hcard
  let g : Y → Fin m → G := fun y => if h : ∃ g : Fin m → G,
      κ y = (m : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • ∑ i, Measure.dirac (g i) then h.choose else fun _ => Classical.choice inferInstance
  refine ⟨m, hm, g, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlist] with y hy
  simpa only [g, dite_eq_left hy] using hy.choose_spec

end EuclideanFiveColor.UniformEnumeration

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.DifferenceInvariant
variable {G Y : Type*} [CommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace G]
  [MeasurableMul₂ G] [MeasurableInv G] [MeasurableSpace Y]

noncomputable def differenceLaw (ν : Measure Y) (κ : Kernel Y G) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : Measure G :=
  ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2)

name: invariant
proof:
by
  have hprod : (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (Prod.map T T)) = ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν) := by
    ext s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply (hT.prodMap hT) hs,
      Measure.bind_apply ((hT.prodMap hT) hs) (κ ×ₖ κ).aemeasurable,
      Measure.bind_apply hs (κ ×ₖ κ).aemeasurable]
    calc
      (∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) y ((Prod.map T T) ⁻¹' s) ∂ν) =
          ∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) (R y) s ∂ν := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [he] with y hy
        rw [Kernel.prod_apply, Kernel.prod_apply, hy,
          Measure.map_prod_map _ _ hT hT, Measure.map_apply (hT.prodMap hT) hs]
      _ = ∫⁻ y, (κ ×ₖ κ) y s ∂ν := hR.lintegral_comp (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs)
  have hdiv : Measurable (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) := measurable_fst.div measurable_snd
  refine ⟨hT, ?_⟩
  rw [differenceLaw, Measure.map_map hT hdiv]
  calc
    (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (T ∘ (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2))) =
        ((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map ((fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) ∘ Prod.map T T) := by
      congr 1
      funext p
      exact map_div T p.1 p.2
    _ = (((κ ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ ν).map (Prod.map T T)).map (fun p : G × G => p.1 / p.2) :=
      (Measure.map_map hdiv (hT.prodMap hT)).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [hprod]

end EuclideanFiveColor.DifferenceInvariant

/-! The scalar finite bounded-module approximation in (source-4), and its
finite-vector consequence. All functions are measurable bounded representatives. -/
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation
open MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K Y W : Type*} [SMul K Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace W]

def Scalar (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Y → ℂ, Measurable H → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ C) →
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

def Vector (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (H : Y → Fin m → ℂ), Measurable H →
  (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ C) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → Fin m → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

name: pi_dist_sq_le_sum
proof:
by
  have hs : 0 ≤ ∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hn : dist a b ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    intro i
    change ‖a i - b i‖ ≤ _
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    apply (Real.le_sqrt (dist_nonneg) hs).mpr
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (dist (a j) (b j))) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hs, Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑ i, dist (a i) (b i)^2), dist_nonneg (x := a) (y := b)]

name: vector_of_scalar
proof:
K) ν q) : Vector (K := K) ν q := by
  classical
  intro m H hH hHb ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (m+1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  have hcoord (j : Fin m) : ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → ℂ),
      0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
        Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y) j) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
        (∫ y, dist (H (k • y) j) (∑ i, a (q y) i * Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < δ^2 := by
    apply hs (fun y => H y j) ((measurable_pi_iff.mp hH) j) _ δ hδ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hHb
    exact ⟨C, fun y => (norm_le_pi_norm (H y) j).trans (hC y)⟩
  choose r B C Hf hB hC hHm hHb hA using hcoord
  let I := (j : Fin m) × Fin (r j)
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card I) ≃ I := (Fintype.equivFin I).symm
  let V : I → Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun s y => Pi.single s.1 (Hf s.1 s.2 y)
  have hV (s : I) : Measurable (V s) := by
    apply Measurable.of_eval
    intro j
    by_cases h : s.1 = j
    · subst j
      simpa [V] using hHm s.1 s.2
    · simp only [V, Pi.single_apply, Ne.symm h, ite_false]
      exact measurable_const
  have hVnorm (s : I) (y : Y) : ‖V s y‖ ≤ ‖Hf s.1 s.2 y‖ := by
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    intro j
    by_cases h : s.1 = j
    · subst j; simp [V]
    · simp [V, h]
  refine ⟨Fintype.card I, ∑ j, B j, ∑ j, C j, fun i => V (e i),
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hB j), Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hC j),
    fun i => hV (e i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    change (∑ i, (fun s : I => ‖V s y‖) (e i)) ≤ _
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp e (fun s : I => ‖V s y‖)]
    calc
      ∑ s : I, ‖V s y‖ ≤ ∑ s : I, ‖Hf s.1 s.2 y‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun s _ => hVnorm s y)
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖Hf j i y‖ := Fintype.sum_sigma _
      _ ≤ ∑ j, C j := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hHb j y)
  · intro k
    choose a ham hab hai hae using fun j => hA j k
    let a' : W → I → ℂ := fun w s => a s.1 w s.2
    have hap (w : W) : ‖fun i => a' w (e i)‖ ≤ ∑ j, B j := by
      rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hB j))]
      intro i
      exact ((norm_le_pi_norm (a (e i).1 w) (e i).2).trans (hab (e i).1 w)).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hB j) (Finset.mem_univ _))
    have ham' : Measurable (fun w i => a' w (e i)) := by
      apply Measurable.of_eval
      intro i
      exact (measurable_pi_iff.mp (ham (e i).1)) (e i).2
    let A : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => ∑ s : I, a' (q y) s • V s y
    have hAeq (y : Y) (j : Fin m) : A y j = ∑ i, a j (q y) i * Hf j i y := by
      change (∑ s : I, a' (q y) s • V s y) j = _
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
      simp [a', V, Pi.single_apply]
    have hAm : Measurable A := by
      apply Measurable.of_eval
      intro j
      simp_rw [hAeq]
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ((measurable_pi_iff.mp (ham j)) i |>.comp hq).mul (hHm j i))
    have hem : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2) ν :=
      ((hH.comp (measurable_const_smul k)).dist hAm |>.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hsint : Integrable (fun y => ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2) ν := by
      apply integrable_finsetSum
      intro j _
      simpa only [hAeq] using hai j
    have hbound (y : Y) : dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2 ≤ ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 :=
      pi_dist_sq_le_sum _ _
    have hint : Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2) ν :=
      hsint.mono' hem (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (dist (H (k • y)) (A y)))] using hbound y))
    have hbudget : (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (A y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ y, ∑ j, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 ∂ν := integral_mono hint hsint hbound
        _ = ∑ j, ∫ y, dist (H (k • y) j) (A y j)^2 ∂ν := integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => by simpa only [hAeq] using hai j)
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin m, δ^2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by simpa only [hAeq] using (hae j).le)
        _ = (m : ℝ) * δ^2 := by simp
        _ < ε^2 := by
          dsimp [δ]
          have hm : (0 : ℝ) < m+1 := by positivity
          rw [div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hm)]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m : ℝ), sq_pos_of_pos hε]
    have hAe (y : Y) : (∑ i, a' (q y) (e i) • V (e i) y) = A y :=
      Equiv.sum_comp e (fun s => a' (q y) s • V s y)
    refine ⟨fun w i => a' w (e i), ham', hap, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hAe] using hint
    · simpa only [hAe] using hbudget

end EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation

name: factor_smul_preserving
proof:
by
  refine ⟨measurable_const_smul k, ?_⟩
  rw [Measure.map_map (measurable_const_smul k) hp]
  calc
    μ.map ((fun y : Y => k • y) ∘ p) = μ.map (p ∘ (fun x : X => k • x)) :=
      Measure.map_congr ((hpe k).mono fun _ hx => hx.symm)
    _ = (μ.map (fun x : X => k • x)).map p :=
      (Measure.map_map hp (measurable_const_smul k)).symm
    _ = μ.map p := by rw [measurePreserving_smul k μ |>.map_eq]

name: relative_difference_invariant
proof:
by
  have he := KernelSupport.condDistrib_equivariant μ b p hb hp
    (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (fun d : D => k • d)
    (measurable_const_smul k) (measurePreserving_smul k μ) (hpe k) (hbe k)
  exact DifferenceInvariant.invariant (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun y : Y => k • y) (KernelSupport.factor_smul_preserving μ p hp hpe k)
    (scalarHom (kCoeff k)) (measurable_const_smul k) he

name: finite_encoding_approximation_of_compact
proof:
K) (μ.map p) q) :
    FiniteEncodingApproximation μ p q b m := by
  classical
  let H₀ : Y → Fin m → ℂ := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) m
  have hH₀ : Measurable H₀ :=
    PhaseEncoding.measurable_kernelEncoding _ _ (measurable_eval_coe 1) m
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := PhaseEncoding.exists_encoding_bound m
  have hHB : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hg] with y hy
    have he := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_eq_encoding (condDistrib b p μ) (eval 1) m hm y (g y) hy
    change ‖PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ) (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) m y‖ ≤ max A 0
    rw [he]
    exact (hA (fun i => eval 1 (g y i))).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  let H : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => if ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0 then H₀ y else 0
  have hH : Measurable H := hH₀.piecewise (measurableSet_le hH₀.norm measurable_const) measurable_const
  have hHbound : ∀ y, ‖H y‖ ≤ max A 0 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : ‖H₀ y‖ ≤ max A 0
    · simpa only [H, ite_eq_left hy] using hy
    · simp only [H, ite_eq_right hy, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  have hHeq : H =ᵐ[μ.map p] H₀ := hHB.mono fun y hy => ite_eq_left hy
  have hv := CompactApproximation.vector_of_scalar (μ.map p) q hq hc
  intro γ hγ
  obtain ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, _hHm, hHf, ha⟩ := hv m H hH ⟨max A 0, hHbound⟩ γ hγ
  refine ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, hHf, ?_⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨a, _ham, hab, hai, hae⟩ := ha k
  have hker := KernelSupport.condDistrib_equivariant μ b p hb hp
    (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (MeasurableEquiv.smul k) (fun d : D => k • d)
    (measurable_const_smul k) (measurePreserving_smul k μ) (hpe k) (hbe k)
  have hcov := PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding_covariance (μ.map p) (condDistrib b p μ)
    (fun y : Y => k • y) (fun d : D => k • d) (measurable_const_smul k)
    (fun d => (eval 1 d : ℂ)) (measurable_eval_coe 1) m hker
  have heq : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map p, H (k • y) =
      PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ) (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m y := by
    filter_upwards [(KernelSupport.factor_smul_preserving μ p hp hpe k).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hHeq,
      hcov] with y hy hc'
    exact hy.trans (by simpa only [Function.comp_def, eval_smul_one] using hc')
  have he : (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) =ᵐ[μ.map p]
      (fun y => dist (PhaseEncoding.kernelEncoding (condDistrib b p μ)
        (fun d => (eval (kCoeff k) d : ℂ)) m y) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) := by
    filter_upwards [heq] with y hy
    rw [hy]
  have hai' := hai.congr he
  refine ⟨a, hab, hai'.comp_measurable hp, ?_⟩
  rw [← integral_map hp.aemeasurable hai'.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← integral_congr_ae he]
  exact hae

/-- The complete source successor implication. The predecessor assertion is
universal in the equivariant wild map, as required by the transfinite induction. -/

name: relative_singularity_successor
proof:
K) (μ.map p) q)
    (hprev : ∀ b : X → D, Measurable b →
      (∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, b (k • x) = k • b x) → IsWild (μ.map b) →
      DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ) C = 0) :
    DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) C = 0 := by
  by_contra hn
  have hpos : 0 < RelativeCenters.differenceLaw (μ.map p) (condDistrib d p μ) C :=
    pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbe, hbw, a, ha, hf⟩ := exact_finite_center_reduction μ d p hd hp hde hpe hwild hpos
  obtain ⟨m, hm, g, hg⟩ := UniformEnumeration.constant_uniform_lists (μ.map p)
    (condDistrib b p μ) a ha (hf.mono fun y ⟨S, hS, hSa, hSupp, hcS, _⟩ =>
      ⟨S, hS, hSa, hSupp, hcS⟩)
  have hcomp : ∀ k : K, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (q ∘ p) (k • x) = k • (q ∘ p) x := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hpe k, ae_of_ae_map hp.aemeasurable (hqe k)] with x hx hy
    simp only [Function.comp_def, hx, hy]
  have hpwild : IsWild (DifferenceFourier.differenceLaw (μ.map (q ∘ p)) (condDistrib b (q ∘ p) μ)) :=
    ⟨relative_difference_invariant μ b (q ∘ p) hb (hq.comp hp) hbe hcomp,
      hprev b hb hbe hbw⟩
  exact finite_uniform_successor_contradiction μ p q b hp hq hb m hm g hg hpwild
    (finite_encoding_approximation_of_compact μ p q b hp hq hb hpe hbe m hm g hg hc)

variable {K Y Z W : Type*} [SMul K Y] [SMul K Z]
  [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W]

def At (ν : Measure Y) (q : Y → W) (m : ℕ) (H : Y → Fin m → ℂ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (B C : ℝ) (Hf : Fin r → Y → Fin m → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (Hf i)) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i, ‖Hf i y‖ ≤ C) ∧
    ∀ k : K, ∃ a : W → Fin r → ℂ, Measurable a ∧ (∀ w, ‖a w‖ ≤ B) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2) ν ∧
      (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (∑ i, a (q y) i • Hf i y)^2 ∂ν) < ε^2

name: lift_at
proof:
K) (ν.map p) q) : At (K := K) ν (q ∘ p) m H ε := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, B, C, Hf, hB, hC, hHm, hHf, ha⟩ := hc m H₀ hH₀ hB₀ (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨r, B, C, fun i => Hf i ∘ p, hB, hC, fun i => (hHm i).comp hp,
    fun y => hHf (p y), ?_⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨a, ham, hab, hai, hae⟩ := ha k
  let F : Y → Fin m → ℂ := fun y => ∑ i, a (q (p y)) i • Hf i (p y)
  have hFm : Measurable F := by
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (((measurable_pi_iff.mp ham) i).comp (hq.comp hp)).smul ((hHm i).comp hp))
  let e₁ : Y → ℝ := fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y))^2
  let e₂ : Y → ℝ := fun y => dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y)^2
  have heq : (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (p (k • y)))^2) =ᵐ[ν] e₁ :=
    (hpe k).mono fun y hy => by simp only [e₁, hy]
  have hi₁ : Integrable e₁ ν := ((hpres k).integrable_comp hi.aestronglyMeasurable |>.mpr hi).congr heq
  have he₁ : (∫ y, e₁ y ∂ν) < (ε/2)^2 := by
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => dist (H y) (H₀ (p y))^2)
        (ν.map (fun y : Y => k • y)) := by
      rw [(hpres k).map_eq]
      exact hi.aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [← integral_congr_ae heq, ← integral_map (hpres k).measurable.aemeasurable hm,
      (hpres k).map_eq]
    exact he
  have hi₂ : Integrable e₂ ν := hai.comp_measurable hp
  have he₂ : (∫ y, e₂ y ∂ν) < (ε/2)^2 := by
    change (∫ y, dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (∑ i, a (q (p y)) i • Hf i (p y))^2 ∂ν) < _
    rw [← integral_map hp.aemeasurable hai.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact hae
  have hmajor (y : Y) : dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2 ≤ 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y) := by
    have ht := dist_triangle (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y)
    have hx := dist_nonneg (x := H (k • y)) (y := H₀ (k • p y))
    have hy := dist_nonneg (x := H₀ (k • p y)) (y := F y)
    have hz := dist_nonneg (x := H (k • y)) (y := F y)
    dsimp [e₁, e₂]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (dist (H (k • y)) (H₀ (k • p y)) - dist (H₀ (k • p y)) (F y))]
  have himaj : Integrable (fun y => 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y)) ν := (hi₁.add hi₂).const_mul 2
  have hint : Integrable (fun y => dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2) ν :=
    himaj.mono' (((hH.comp (measurable_const_smul k)).dist hFm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq] using hmajor y)
  refine ⟨a, ham, hab, hint, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∫ y, dist (H (k • y)) (F y)^2 ∂ν) ≤ ∫ y, 2*(e₁ y + e₂ y) ∂ν :=
      integral_mono hint himaj hmajor
    _ = 2*((∫ y, e₁ y ∂ν) + ∫ y, e₂ y ∂ν) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hi₁ hi₂]
    _ < ε^2 := by nlinarith

end EuclideanFiveColor.CompactApproximation

name: not_sameRay_smul_lift
proof:
by
  intro h
  have haz : a • lift z ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero ha.ne' (lift_ne_zero z)
  have hbw : b • lift w ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero hb.ne' (lift_ne_zero w)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, he⟩ := h.exists_pos_left haz hbw
  have hfst := congrArg WithLp.fst he
  have hsnd := congrArg WithLp.snd he
  simp only [WithLp.smul_fst, lift_fst, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hfst
  simp only [WithLp.smul_snd, lift_snd, smul_smul, hfst] at hsnd
  exact hzw ((smul_right_injective ℂ hb.ne') hsnd)

name: strictConvex_norm_lift
proof:
by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro z _ w _ hzw a b ha hb hab
  change ‖lift (a • z + b • w)‖ < a • ‖lift z‖ + b • ‖lift w‖
  rw [lift_affine z w a b hab]
  have := norm_add_lt_of_not_sameRay (not_sameRay_smul_lift hzw ha hb)
  simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ha, abs_of_pos hb,
    smul_eq_mul] using this

noncomputable def kernel (s t : ℂ) : ℝ := ‖lift (s - t)‖ - ‖lift (-t)‖

noncomputable def objective (μ : Measure ℂ) (s : ℂ) : ℝ := ∫ t, kernel s t ∂μ

name: kernel_diff_bound

name: objective_lipschitz
proof:
by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro s s'
  rw [Real.dist_eq, objective, objective, ← integral_sub (integrable_kernel μ s)
    (integrable_kernel μ s')]
  calc
    |∫ t, kernel s t - kernel s' t ∂μ| ≤ ∫ t, |kernel s t - kernel s' t| ∂μ :=
      abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ _ : ℂ, ‖s - s'‖ ∂μ := by
      apply integral_mono ((integrable_kernel μ s).sub (integrable_kernel μ s')).abs
        (integrable_const _)
      exact fun t => kernel_diff_bound s s' t
    _ = (1 : ℝ≥0) * dist s s' := by simp [dist_eq_norm]

name: continuous_objective

name: kernel_strict_convex
proof:
by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro z _ w _ hzw a b ha hb hab
  have hn : z - t ≠ w - t := sub_left_injective.ne hzw
  have h := strictConvex_norm_lift.2 (Set.mem_univ (z - t))
    (Set.mem_univ (w - t)) hn ha hb hab
  have ht : a • t + b • t = t := by rw [← add_smul, hab, one_smul]
  have he : a • (z - t) + b • (w - t) = a • z + b • w - t := by
    calc
      _ = a • z + b • w - (a • t + b • t) := by
        simp only [smul_sub]
        abel
      _ = _ := by rw [ht]
  dsimp only at h
  rw [he] at h
  dsimp only [kernel]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
  have hc : a * ‖lift (-t)‖ + b * ‖lift (-t)‖ = ‖lift (-t)‖ := by
    rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  nlinarith only [h, hc]

name: objective_strict_convex
proof:
by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
  intro z hz w hw hzw a b ha hb hab
  have hk (t : ℂ) := (kernel_strict_convex t).2 hz hw hzw ha hb hab
  have hf := integrable_kernel μ (a • z + b • w)
  have hg := ((integrable_kernel μ z).smul a).add ((integrable_kernel μ w).smul b)
  change (∫ t, kernel (a • z + b • w) t ∂μ) <
    a • (∫ t, kernel z t ∂μ) + b • (∫ t, kernel w t ∂μ)
  rw [← integral_smul, ← integral_smul, ← integral_add]
  · refine lt_of_le_of_ne (integral_mono hf hg fun t => (hk t).le) ?_
    intro he
    have heq := (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le hf hg
      (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hk t).le)).mp he
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := heq.exists
    exact (hk t).ne ht
  · exact (integrable_kernel μ z).smul a
  · exact (integrable_kernel μ w).smul b

name: norm_lift_le
proof:
by
  calc
    ‖lift z‖ ≤ ‖lift z - lift 0‖ + ‖lift 0‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _
    _ = ‖z‖ + 1 := by simp [norm_lift_sub, norm_lift]

name: kernel_lower
proof:
by
  have hst : ‖s - t‖ ≤ ‖lift (s - t)‖ := WithLp.norm_snd_le ℝ (lift (s - t))
  have hs : ‖s‖ ≤ ‖s - t‖ + ‖t‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _
  have ht := norm_lift_le (-t)
  simp only [norm_neg] at ht
  dsimp only [kernel]
  linarith

name: exists_ball_mass
proof:
by
  by_contra! h
  have hm (n : ℕ) : μ (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (measure_ne_top _ _) (by norm_num)).mp
    simpa [measureReal_def] using h n
  have hc : (⋃ n : ℕ, Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (n : ℝ)) = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro z
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖z‖
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hn.le⟩
  have hmono : Monotone (fun n : ℕ => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (Nat.cast_le.mpr hij)
  have he : μ (⋃ n : ℕ, Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (n : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [hmono.measure_iUnion]
    exact iSup_le hm
  rw [hc, measure_univ] at he
  norm_num at he

name: objective_lower
proof:
by
  classical
  let B := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R
  let v := 2 * ‖s‖ - (2 * R + 1)
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet
  have hi : Integrable (B.indicator (fun _ : ℂ => v)) μ :=
    (integrable_const v).indicator hB
  have hp (t : ℂ) : -‖s‖ + B.indicator (fun _ : ℂ => v) t ≤ kernel s t := by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ B
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
      have ht' : ‖t‖ ≤ R := by simpa [B, Metric.mem_closedBall] using ht
      have hlo := kernel_lower s t
      dsimp only [v]
      linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, add_zero]
      exact (abs_le.mp (kernel_bound s t)).1
  calc
    _ = ∫ t : ℂ, -‖s‖ + B.indicator (fun _ : ℂ => v) t ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hi, integral_const,
        integral_indicator_const v hB]
      simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul]
      dsimp only [v, B]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := integral_mono ((integrable_const _).add hi) (integrable_kernel μ s) hp

name: linear_norm_coercive
proof:
by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => a * ‖z‖) (cocompact ℂ) atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop ha (tendsto_norm_cocompact_atTop (E := ℂ))
  exact tendsto_atTop_add_const_right (cocompact ℂ) b ht

name: objective_coercive
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_ball_mass μ
  have hp : 0 < 2 * μ.real (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)) - 1 := by linarith
  have ht := linear_norm_coercive (2 * μ.real (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)) - 1)
    (-(μ.real (Metric.closedBall 0 (n : ℝ)) * (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1))) hp
  apply tendsto_atTop_mono (objective_lower μ (n : ℝ))
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using ht

name: exists_unique_minimizer
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (continuous_objective μ).exists_forall_le (objective_coercive μ)
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  exact (objective_strict_convex μ).eq_of_isMinOn (fun x _ => ht x)
    (fun x _ => hs x) (Set.mem_univ t) (Set.mem_univ s)

(exists_unique_minimizer (μ : Measure ℂ)).choose_spec.2 z hz

name: denseSeq_inf_eq_min
proof:
by
  have hb : BddBelow (Set.range (fun n => f (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq X n))) :=
    ⟨f x, by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; exact hx _⟩

      (isClosed_le continuous_const hf) (fun n => ciInf_le hb n)

name: minValue_eq
proof: denseSeq_inf_eq_min _ (continuous_objective _) _ (center_minimizes μ)

name: exists_min_on_closed
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hCn
  apply (continuous_objective (μ : Measure ℂ)).continuousOn.exists_isMinOn' hC hx
  apply Filter.Eventually.filter_mono inf_le_left
  exact (objective_coercive (μ : Measure ℂ)).eventually
    (eventually_ge_atTop (objective (μ : Measure ℂ) x))

name: measurable_center
proof:
by
  classical
  apply measurable_of_isClosed
  intro C hC
  by_cases hne : C.Nonempty
  · let : Nonempty C := hne.to_subtype
    let mC (μ : ProbabilityMeasure ℂ) : ℝ :=
      ⨅ n, objective (μ : Measure ℂ) (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq C n).val
    have hmC : Measurable mC := Measurable.iInf fun _n => measurable_objective _
    have he : center ⁻¹' C = {μ | mC μ = minValue μ} := by
      ext μ
      obtain ⟨z, hzC, hz⟩ := exists_min_on_closed μ hC hne
      have hm : mC μ = objective (μ : Measure ℂ) z :=
        denseSeq_inf_eq_min (fun t : C => objective (μ : Measure ℂ) t.val)
          ((continuous_objective _).comp continuous_subtype_val) ⟨z, hzC⟩
          (fun t => hz t.val t.property)
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hm, minValue_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact le_antisymm (hz _ h) (center_minimizes μ z)
      · intro h
        have hzm : ∀ t, objective (μ : Measure ℂ) z ≤ objective (μ : Measure ℂ) t :=
          fun t => h.trans_le (center_minimizes μ t)
        rwa [center_unique μ hzm] at hzC
    rw [he]
    exact measurableSet_eq_fun hmC measurable_minValue
  · have he : C = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
    simp [he]

name: kernel_translate
proof:
by
  have h₁ : s + v - (t + v) = s - t := by abel
  have h₂ : -(t + v) = -v - t := by abel

name: objective_translate
proof:
by

    (continuous_id.add_const v).aemeasurable
  rw [objective, integral_map hm (continuous_kernel _).aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [kernel_translate]
  exact integral_sub (integrable_kernel _ _) (integrable_kernel _ _)

name: center_translate
proof:
by
  apply Eq.symm
  apply center_unique
  intro t
  have he : t = (t - v) + v := by abel
  change objective (Measure.map (fun t : ℂ => t + v) (μ : Measure ℂ)) (center μ + v) ≤
    objective (Measure.map (fun t : ℂ => t + v) (μ : Measure ℂ)) t
  rw [objective_translate, he, objective_translate]
  exact sub_le_sub_right (center_minimizes μ (t - v)) _

name: center_orthogonal

name: measurable_frequencyMeasure
proof:
by
  classical
  apply Measure.measurable_of_measurable_coe
  intro s hs
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : (ProbabilityMeasure G × G) × G =>
      if p.2 / p.1.2 ∈ e.ordinary ∧ e.coordinate (p.2 / p.1.2) ∈ s
      then (1 : ℝ≥0∞) else 0) := by
    apply Measurable.ite _ measurable_const measurable_const
    exact (e.measurableSet_ordinary.preimage
      (measurable_snd.div (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))).inter
      (hs.preimage (e.measurable_coordinate.comp
        (measurable_snd.div (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))))
  have h := hm.lintegral_kernel_prod_right' (κ := parameterKernel (G := G))
  convert h using 1
  ext p
  rw [e.frequencyMeasure_apply _ _ hs]
  have hset : MeasurableSet {d : G | d / p.2 ∈ e.ordinary ∧
      e.coordinate (d / p.2) ∈ s} :=
    (e.measurableSet_ordinary.preimage (measurable_id.div_const p.2)).inter
      (hs.preimage (e.measurable_coordinate.comp (measurable_id.div_const p.2)))
  rw [show parameterKernel p = (p.1 : Measure G) from rfl]
  simpa only [Set.indicator_apply, Pi.one_apply, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using
    (lintegral_indicator_one (μ := (p.1 : Measure G)) hset).symm

      e.frequencyMeasure (p.1 : Measure G) p.2 Set.univ) :=

    letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ((μ : Measure G)[|e.coset z]) :=
